english: habitually complaining
example_en: One gets unsettled, depressed, and inclined to be querulous.
example_zh: 有的人变得心绪不宁，神情沮丧，动不动就爱发牢骚。

english: mechanical or unthinking routine or repetition
example_en: He is very skeptical about the value of rote learning.
example_zh: 他非常怀疑死记硬背是否有用。

english: to plan with cleverness or ingenuity
example_en: They somehow contrived to lose tens of thousands of applications.
example_zh: 他们精心策划故意遗失了数万份申请书

english: dealing with or affecting a great variety of different things
example_en: The negotiations have a wide-ranging scope with emphasis on trade and investment liberalization and facilitation.
example_zh: 谈判涵盖的范畴广泛，重点是贸易和投资的自由化及便利化。

english: to confuse completely
example_en: An apple tree producing square fruit is baffling experts.
example_zh: 一棵结方形苹果的树令专家大惑不解。

english: a symbolic representation
example_en: The contrast in their personalities reminded me of the biblical allegory of Cain and Abel.
example_zh: 二人性格的反差让我想起来《圣经》里该隐和亚伯的寓言。

english: directly forward
to say in a very strong and definite way
example_en: In spite of all you say, I still aver that his report is true.
example_zh: 不管你怎么说, 我还是断言他的报告是真实的。

english: flagrantly wicked or impious
example_en: The EU reckons that Intel's use of such rebates was nefarious.
example_zh: 欧盟认为，英特尔利用返点促销用意恶毒。

english: to recruit someone to join one's party, institution, or cause
example_en: Do not proselytize your work or ideas.
example_zh: 不要变节你的工作或观念

english: to feel or express annoyance or ill will at
example_en: Many conscripts resent having to do their military service.
example_zh: 许多应征入伍者对被迫服兵役愤愤不平

english: to increase or improve
example_en: BBC backing for the scheme will enhance its credibility.
example_zh: 英国广播公司对这一计划的支持将提高其可信度。

english: dissent or deviation from a dominant theory, opinion, or practice
example_en: He was burned at the stake for heresy.
example_zh: 他因为信奉异端思想而以火刑处死。

english: done or said in a natural and often sudden way and without a lot of thought or planning
example_en: The audience burst into spontaneous applause.
example_zh: 观众自发地鼓起掌来。

english: having no personal reference or connection
example_en: We must be as impersonal as a surgeon with his knife
example_zh: 我们必须像外科医生拿手术刀时一样冷静客观，不受任何感情影响。

english: not usual
example_en: He showed exceptional musical ability.
example_zh: 他显示出特殊的音乐才能。

english: turbulent, stormy
example_en: Somehow the marriage lasted for eight tempestuous months.
example_zh: 不管怎么说，那场婚姻还是维持了 8 个月，其间双方的关系一直很紧张。

english: extremely or excessively particular, exacting, or meticulous in taste or standards
example_en: Even the most finicky eater will find something appetizing here.
example_zh: 即使是最挑剔的食客在这里也会找到让人胃口大开的美食。

english: to come together
example_en: The capitalists amass great wealth by exploiting workers.
example_zh: 资本家剥削工人而积累了巨额财富。

english: to adopt an air of condescension toward
example_en: Don't you patronize me!
example_zh: 别在我面前摆出一副屈尊俯就的样子！

english: to turn away or aside
example_en: Efforts are being made to avert war and find a diplomatic solution.
example_zh: 各方正在为避免战争、寻求外交解决途径而作出积极的努力。

english: torment, vex
example_en: Todd could take it, whereas I'm harrowed by it.
example_zh: 托德可以忍受，但是我却感到很痛苦。

english: to compose out of materials from other documents
example_en: The album was compiled from live recordings from last year's tour.
example_zh: 这套唱片选辑由去年巡回演出的实况录音汇编而成。

english: to make a ritual of
example_en: Ritualize your transition at the close of the workday.
example_zh: 以仪式化的方式去结束这一天的工作。

english: of or relating to trees
example_en: Squirrels are arboreal creatures.
example_zh: 松鼠是树栖动物。

english: a way of using humor to show that someone or something is foolish, weak, bad, etc.
example_en: The novel is a stinging satire on American politics.
example_zh: 这部小说是对美国政治的尖锐讽刺。

english: the power of choosing or determining
example_en: We like to think that everything we do and everything we think is a product of our volition.
example_zh: 我们愿意认为我们所做和所想的一切都是出于自己的意志。

english: existing from the time a person or animal is born
example_en: Correct ideas are not innate in the mind.
example_zh: 人的正确思想不是自己头脑中固有的。

english: expressing praise or admiration for someone or something
example_en: Meg's mother Susan Jordan was not complimentary about her daughter in the biography she wrote.
example_zh: 梅格的妈妈在书中自己写到：自己是不应该被女儿称赞的。

english: to dislike greatly and often with disgust or intolerance
example_en: You loathe the smell of greasy food when you are seasick.
example_zh: 当你晕船时，你会厌恶油腻的气味。

english: very thorough
example_en: He has made an exhaustive study of t he problem.
example_zh: 他对这个问题进行了彻底的研究。

english: painfully affecting the feelings
example_en: In fact, they are probably the most poignant and important experience.
example_zh: 事实上，它们可能是你最深刻最重要的人生阅历。

english: to attract and hold the attention of by being interesting, pretty, etc.
example_en: For 40 years she has captivated the world with her radiant looks.
example_zh: 40年来，她那令人惊艳的美貌让全世界为之痴迷。

english: to put on
example_en: Today's bikini offers more support, and the body-conscious woman is able to don a bikini in confidence.
example_zh: 今天的比基尼给人体多一些支撑，让担心自己身材的女士有自信穿上它。

english: the physical or social setting in which something occurs or develops
example_en: They stayed, safe and happy, within their own social milieu.
example_zh: 他们幸福无忧地呆在自己的社交圈子里

english: to give an omen or anticipatory sign of
example_en: The change did not portend a basic improvement in social conditions.
example_zh: 该变化没有预示社会状况的基本改观。

english: a systematic plan for
having no plan, order, or direction
example_en: The books had been piled on the shelves in a haphazard fashion.
example_zh: 书架上的书堆放得杂乱无序。

english: having or showing a lack of intelligence or serious thought
example_en: When you feel vacuous and unhappy, you can do some labour, such as cleaning the house, tables and windows .
example_zh: 感到空虚不快乐的时候你可以劳动一下，比如打扫房子，抹抹桌子，窗子啥的。

english: coming from outside
example_en: For many people the Church was a symbol of external authority.
example_zh: 对许多人来讲，教堂是外来权威的象征

english: capable of being easily led, taught, or controlled
example_en: He could easily manage his tractable and worshipping younger brother.
example_zh: 他能轻而易举地管住听话并且崇拜自己的弟弟。

english: of very great weight
example_en: He's slow and ponderous, and can pick up and put down objects nearby.
example_zh: 它行动迟缓笨重，可以拿起或者放下旁边的物件。

english: to make impossible by necessary consequence: rule out in advance
example_en: We try to preclude any possibility of misunderstanding.
example_zh: 我们努力排除任何误解的可能性。

english: to assign value or merit to
example_en: But a curious thing has happened in the half-century since his death — those who opposed him now valorize him.
example_zh: 但是自从他去世半个世纪以来，一件奇怪的事情发生了—那些反对他的人现在对他评价很高。

english: devotion or loyalty to a person, group, or cause
example_en: The constitution requires members of parliament to take an oath of allegiance.
example_zh: 宪法规定，议员必须宣誓效忠。

english: to say in a strong and definitive way that someone or something is bad or wrong
example_en: Political leaders united yesterday to condemn the latest wave of violence.
example_zh: 政界领袖昨日联合起来对最近激增的暴力事件予以谴责。

english: to give up or leave entirely
example_en: To forsake good for the sake of gold is not for me.
example_zh: 我不干这种见利忘义的事。

english: existing or occurring at the same time
example_en: The two simultaneous shots sounded like one.
example_zh: 那同时发出的两声枪响听起来像是一响.

english: a heavy burden
example_en: For today's politicians, the treaty is becoming a millstone.
example_zh: 对今天的政治家而言，该条约正成为一大包袱。

english: too important and respected to be changed, criticized, etc.
example_en: Freedom of the press is sacrosanct.
example_zh: 新闻自由是神圣不可侵犯的。

english: to prevent from doing something
creating disunity or dissension
example_en: Abortion has always been a divisive is sue.
example_zh: 人工流产一直是个引发争议的问题。

english: not wise or sensible
example_en: We deplore this lamentably ill-advised decision.
example_zh: 我们强烈反对这个拙劣的、欠考虑的决定。

english: to express sorrow, mourning, or regret for often demonstratively
example_en: The royal members lamented the passing of aristocratic society.
example_zh: 王室家族成员悲叹贵族社会的消失。

english: having qualities appropriate to or usually associated with a man
example_en: He looked masculine and masterful.
example_zh: 他看起来很有男子汉气概和驾驭能力。

english: of a commonplace or repetitious character
example_en: So many days are routine and uninteresting, especially in winter.
example_zh: 太多的日子都是平淡和无趣，尤其是在冬季。

english: done in a quiet and secret way to avoid being noticed
example_en: His furtive behavior aroused our suspicion.
example_zh: 他鬼鬼祟祟的行为引起了我们的怀疑。

english: causing someone to feel sad or without hope
example_en: All in all, it appeared that a pretty depr essing summer awaited Jones.
example_zh: 总之，等待琼斯的似乎是一个相当令人沮丧的夏天。

english: very strong, clear, and effective
example_en: His comment was trenchant and perceptive.
example_zh: 他的评论既一针见血又鞭辟入里。

english: to oppose or challenge especially in a direct and forceful way
example_en: This was the first time he had confronted an armed robber.
example_zh: 这是他第一次面对一个武装劫匪。

english: to change level, strength, or value frequently
example_en: Body temperature can fluctuate if you are ill.
example_zh: 人患病后体温可能会上下波动。

english: luck that takes the form of finding valuable or pleasant things that are not looked for
example_en: Some of the best effects in my garden have been the result of serendipity.
example_zh: 我园子里最珍贵的几件物品是机缘巧合之下意外所得。

english: to take on an aggressively defensive attitudes
example_en: His hair bristled with anger.
example_zh: 他怒发冲冠。

english: the beginning of something
example_en: Most of the passes have been closed with the onset of winter.
example_zh: 随着冬天的来临，大多数的关卡都已经关闭。

english: of basic importance
example_en: As a salesman, your cardinal rule is to do everything you can to satisfy a customer.
example_zh: 作为推销员，最基本的原则是竭尽全力让顾客满意。

english: not focusing the mind on a matter
example_en: The government has said it was an inadvertent error.
example_zh: 政府声称那是因疏忽造成的过失。

english: to bring legal action against for redress or punishment of a crime or violation of law
example_en: The police decided not to prosecute.
example_zh: 警方决定不予起诉。

english: showing or expressing deference
example_en: She gets excessively deferential to authorities, even when rejecting their views.
example_zh: 即便当她想反对权威的观点的时候，她也表现得过度顺从于权威。

english: bring about, cause
example_en: Something vital must have occasioned this visit.
example_zh: 肯定有什么重大的事导致了这次访问。

english: not healthy or normal
example_en: It's morbid to dwell on cemeteries and such like.
example_zh: 不厌其烦地谈论墓地以及诸如此类的事是一种病态。

english: brilliantly lively, stimulating, or witty
example_en: You can hardly expect scintillating conversation from a kid that age.
example_zh: 你几乎想不到那么点儿的孩子会说出妙趣横生的话来。

english: a diverse assortment or mixture
example_en: Japan won the Men's 200 metre individual medley.
example_zh: 日本赢得了男子200米个人混合泳比赛

english: used to describe someone who allows things to happen or who accepts what other people do or decide without trying to change anything
example_en: His passive attitude made things easier for me.
example_zh: 他的被动态度使我办起事来容易多了。

english: to keep from doing what he or she wants to do
example_en: Wine or sugary drinks inhibit digestion.
example_zh: 葡萄酒或含糖饮料抑制消化。

english: to be better than
example_en: Sometimes small firms can outdo big business when it comes to customer care.
example_zh: 在顾客服务方面，有时小企业可能优于大企业。

english: to cause to vibrate in a definite pattern
example_en: Missile deployment did much to further polarize opinion in Britain.
example_zh: 在英国，导弹部署极大地导致了意见进一步分化。

english: a sharp cleavage
example_en: The failure of any process in meiosis can result in chromosome mal- disjunction.
example_zh: 这个过程中,任何一个环节的错误都可能会导致染色体的异常分离。

english: conflicting with accepted standards of good conduct or good taste
example_en: Carrie could not ignore his indecorous behavior though she loved him very much.
example_zh: 尽管凯莉非常爱他却无法忽视他那有失体统的行为。

english: to completely do away with
example_en: Slavery was abolished in the United States in 1865.
example_zh: 美国1865年废除了奴隶制度。

english: a great success or achievement
example_en: The winning team returned home in triumph .
example_zh: 球队凯旋而归。

english: able to be discussed and changed before an agreement or decision is made
example_en: He warned that his economic program for the country was not negotiable.
example_zh: 他告诫说他为国家制订的经济计划是不容商榷的。

english: an opinion or idea formed without proof or sufficient evidence
example_en: That was a conjecture, not a fact.
example_zh: 那只是猜测，不是事实。

english: to give support or maintain loyalty
example_en: Sikhs were expected to adhere strictly to the religious rules concerning appearance.
example_zh: 锡克教徒应当严格遵守该教对外表的规定。

english: a disastrous event marked by great loss and lasting distress and suffering
example_en: The recent flooding in the south was a calamity.
example_zh: 最近南方的洪水是一场灾难。

english: having an air of easy unconcern or indifference
example_en: Denis tried to look nonchalant and uninterested.
example_zh: 丹尼斯竭力表现出漠不关心、不感兴趣的样子。

english: food for animals especially when taken by browsing or grazing
example_en: Gregarious species forage in flocks from colonies or roosts.
example_zh: 群居动物从聚居地或栖息地成群结队地外出觅食。

english: interchangeable
example_en: Financial innovation and globalisation have made capital fungible.
example_zh: 金融创新与全球化已使得资本变得可以替代。

english: to actively second and encourage
example_en: You've done enough to be charged with attempt to aid and abet.
example_zh: 你所作的一切足以被控教唆犯罪。

english: a feeling of great happiness and excitement
example_en: There was euphoria after the elections .
example_zh: 选举后一片兴高采烈。

english: to reduce to minute particles or to a fine spray
example_en: For proper combustion it is necessary to atomize the propellants.
example_zh: 为了有效地进行燃烧，推进剂必须雾化

english: take back, cancel
example_en: Trade Union leaders have demanded the government rescind the price rise.
example_zh: 工会领导已经要求政府阻止价格上涨。

english: a deserter from one faith, cause, or allegiance to another
example_en: When he was doing underground work he was arrested because a renegade informed against him.
example_zh: 他做地下工作时，曾因叛徒告密而被捕

english: personal belongings
example_en: All my fishing paraphernalia is in the car.
example_zh: 我的钓鱼用品都在汽车里。

english: a feeling of contempt for someone or something regarded as unworthy or inferior
example_en: Jackie disdained the servants that her millions could buy.
example_zh: 杰姬鄙视那些她用钱就可以收买的奴仆

english: to advance beyond the usual or proper limits
example_en: We will never allow anybody to encroach upon China's territorial integrity and sovereignty.
example_zh: 中国的领土和主权绝不允许任何人侵犯

english: to make noble
to fall or drop suddenly in amount, value, etc. （
example_en: Mengniu and Yili have seen their shares plummet since the incident broke.
example_zh: 自事件发生以来，蒙牛和伊利的股票大幅下跌.

english: able to be understood in more than one way
example_en: This agreement is very ambiguous and open to various interpretations.
example_zh: 这份协议非常含糊，可以有多种解释。

english: to coax with flattery
example_en: They find means to approach to me and blandish to me.
example_zh: 他们总是想尽一切办法来接近我,讨好我。

english: a show of intention to inflict harm
example_en: In my view you are a menace to the public.
example_zh: 在我看来，你对公众是个威胁。

english: to move on unsteadily
example_en: It was sad to watch the old woman stagger out with the big bundle and disappear.
example_zh: 目送老妇人扛着一大包衣服蹒跚而去，实在令人心酸。

english: strong and healthy
example_en: The Secretary of State has made a robust defence of the agreement.
example_zh: 国务卿对这项协议进行了强有力的辩护

english: to pass or flow slowly through or as if through small openings or interstices
example_en: He saw there was a big hole in the back of the man's head, blood was still oozing from it.
example_zh: 他看到这个男人后脑勺上有道大口子，血还在往外渗。

english: matters relating to the life or culture of ancient times
example_en: The museum contains the remains of Chinese antiquity.
example_zh: 博物馆藏有中国古代的遗物。

english: a cooperative relationship (as between two persons or groups)
example_en: One consequence for coral reefs is that the symbiosis between the corals and algae that constitute a living reef is breaking down.
example_zh: 珊瑚礁面临的一个后果是，构成活珊瑚礁的珊瑚和藻类之间的共生关系正在瓦解。

english: to give energy or excitement to
example_en: Your enthusiasm will energize not just you, but also other people around you.
example_zh: 而且你的热情不仅会点燃你自己，还包括你身边的其他人。

english: not easily apprehended or understood
example_en: The chaplain tingled with a weird, occult sensation of having experienced the identical situation before in some prior time or existence.
example_zh: 牧师心头猛地一动，出现了一种神秘古怪的感觉，好象从前某个时候曾经经历过同样的情景似的。

english: edible
example_en: Ethyl lactate is one kind of comestible synthetic spicery.
example_zh: 乳酸乙酯是一种食用合成香料。

english: to place or set firmly in something else
example_en: They used to kind of embed it in the glass.
example_zh: 他们往往把它嵌在玻璃里。

english: someone or something that washes or protects something
example_en: Farmers should be guardians of the countryside.
example_zh: 农民应是乡村的保卫者。

english: a product of one’s creative effort
example_en: The record was the brainchild of rock star Bob Geldof.
example_zh: 这张唱片是摇滚歌星鲍勃·格尔多夫的心血之作。

english: to agree to or approve of something
example_en: The director has given her assent to the proposals.
example_zh: 负责人已表示同意提案。

english: experienced or realized through imaginative or sympathetic participation in the experience of another
chinese: 间接体验他人感受的，产生
example_en: Lots of people use television as their vicarious form of social life.
example_zh: 许多人从电视中间接感受社会生活。

english: merciless, cruel
example_en: The President was ruthless in dealing with any hint of internal political dissent.
example_zh: 在处理任何内部政治分歧的苗头时，总统都毫不留情。

english: having or wielding force, authority, or influence
example_en: The World Health Organization WHO is warning about resistance to drugs which were once so potent.
example_zh: WHO对那些曾经很有效的抗生素的耐药性发出了警告。

english: complete and confident composure or self- assurance
example_en: The whole cast executed the production with truly professional aplomb.
example_zh: 全体演职人员以一种真正的专业精神，从容不迫地开始了影片的制作。

english: to utter slanderous and abusive statements against
example_en: He was vilified, hounded, and forced into exile by the FBI.
example_zh: 他遭到了联邦调查局的诬蔑和追捕，被迫流亡国外。

english: to agree to a request or a demand
example_en: Any country of the Union which has signed this Act may ratify it, and, if it has not signed it, may accede to it.
example_zh: 本联盟任何国家已在本议定书上签字者，可以批准本议定书，未签字者可以加入本议定书。

english: to represent in a clear and obvious way
example_en: Toyota, a company that used to embo dy Japan's reputation for quality, is enmeshed in a safety and public relati ons nightmare.
example_zh: 曾作为日本质量象征的丰田汽车（Toyota），如今陷入了一场安全与公关梦魇。

english: a strong support or protection
example_en: The House of Lords is the only bulwark of democracy in this country.
example_zh: 在这个国家，上议院是唯一的民主堡垒

english: to make ill-humored or discontented
to spread apart
in a position of less power or authority than someone else
example_en: Sixty of his subordinate officers followed his example.
example_zh: 他的60个下级官员都以他为榜样。

english: guided by materialism and disdainful of intellectual or artistic values
example_en: The method borrowed from the Chinese pharmacy, which many of our comrades are very fond of, is really the most crude, infantile and philistine of all.
example_zh: 现在许多同志津津有味于这个开中药铺的方法，实在是一种最低级、最幼稚、最庸俗的方法。

english: a person who does not behave the way most people behave
example_en: Victoria stood out as a dazzling non- conformist.
example_zh: 维多利亚以令人惊叹的打破陈规者的形象而引人注目。

english: secret or dishonest behavior or activity
example_en: Ask any student about academic skullduggery and the response is startlingly nonchalant.
example_zh: 随便问一位学生对于学术欺骗的看法,其若无其事的态度会让你非常震惊.

example_zh: 过去几年，这家公司一直在努力从硬件和内部部署软件提供商转型成云计算和服务供应商。

english: present and capable of emerging or developing but not now visible, obvious, active, or symptomatic
example_en: Advertisements attempt to project a latent meaning behind an overt message.
example_zh: 广告试图传达一种隐藏在公开信息里的潜在意义。

english: to associate with another or others for mutual benefit
example_en: The two airlines will cooperate on ticketing and schedules.
example_zh: 两家航空公司将在票务和航班安排上展开合作。

english: not readily ruled, disciplined, or managed
example_en: It's not good enough just to blame the unruly children.
example_zh: 对难管教的孩子只是责备是不够的。

english: unexciting
impaired by damp or mildew
example_en: The musty aroma of incense made her head swim.
example_zh: 熏香发霉的气味令她感到头晕。

english: to create an equal balance between two things
example_en: Prices have risen in order to offset the increased cost of materials.
example_zh: 为补偿原料成本的增加而提高了价格。

english: harmful to living things
example_en: Many household products give off noxious fumes.
example_zh: 很多家用产品散发有害气体。

english: lasting a very short time
example_en: The evanescent post-war economic boom was quickly followed by a deep recession.
example_zh: 大萧条紧随短暂的战后经济繁荣而来。

english: unable to move
example_en: He lay inert with half-closed eyes.
example_zh: 他半睁着双眼一动不动地躺着。

english: lasting only for a short time
example_en: In the final analysis, most of life's joys are transitory.
example_zh: 归根结底，尘世间的欢乐大多是过眼烟云，转瞬即逝。

english: favoring or inclined to start quarrels or wars
example_en: His bellicose disposition alienated his friend.
example_zh: 他生性好斗，他的朋友们都疏远了他。

english: an estate inherited from one's father or ancestor
chinese: 我离开了父母的家，放弃了我的房产和

english: appearing ready to collapse
example_en: They entered the shop, which was a curious ramshackle building.
example_zh: 他们进了商店，那是幢破烂不堪的奇特建筑。

english: lacking flavor, zest, interest, animation, or spirit
example_en: She made a vapid comment about the weather.
example_zh: 她对天气作了一番平淡无奇的评论。

english: the quality or state of not thinking you are better than other people
to do away with as completely as if by pulling up by the roots
example_en: These insects are very difficult to eradicate.
example_zh: 这些昆虫很难根除。

english: talking or writing about many different things in a way that is not highly organized
example_en: His own toast was discursive and overlong, though rather touching.
example_zh: 他自己的祝酒词虽然也颇为动人,但是比较松散而冗长。

english: free, unrestrained
someone or something that is very strongly disliked
example_en: Racial prejudice is an anathema to me.
example_zh: 对我来说，种族歧视非常可恶。

english: morally crude, undeveloped, or unregenerate
example_en: Certain words are vulgar and not acceptable in polite society.
example_zh: 有些字眼较粗俗，不为上流社会所接受

english: easily notice or seen
example_en: It is important that China play an increasingly prominent role on climate change.
example_zh: 中国在气候变化问题上发挥日益突出的重要作用。

english: insulting or abusive language
example_en: Crowley maintained a stream of invective and abuse against Waite.
example_zh: 克劳利连珠炮似的对韦特骂个不停。

english: supple enough to bend freely or repeatedly without breaking
example_en: As your baby grows bigger, his bones become less pliable.
example_zh: 随着宝宝的成长，其骨骼的柔韧性会降低。

english: to speak or write in high praise of
example_en: Leaders from around the world eulogized the Egyptian president.
example_zh: 全世界的领导人都致悼词称颂那位埃及总统。

english: the quality or state of being kin
example_en: In different societies and cultures, there must be different systems of kinship terms.
example_zh: 在不同的社会和文化中，有不同的亲属关系称谓。

english: a person who is very strict and demands obedience from others
example_en: They discover that the new teacher is a martinet.
example_zh: 他们发现新来的老师非常严格。

english: marked by keen caution, cunning, and watchfulness especially in detecting and escaping danger
example_en: Bankers are keeping a wary eye on the outcome.
example_zh: 银行家们对结果保持高度谨慎。

english: having or showing perception, comprehension, or shrewdness especially in practical matters
example_en: He is known for his political savvy and strong management skills.
example_zh: 他以政治悟性和强势的管理手腕出名。

english: a chaotic situation
example_en: Pandemonium broke out as they ran into the street shouting.
example_zh: 他们叫嚷着冲到大街上，大街上顿时乱作一团。

english: to damage the reputation of
example_en: They spread disinformation in order to discredit politicians.
example_zh: 他们散布假消息，企图败坏政治家的名声。

english: to speak or perform without preparation
example_en: Uncle Richard intoned a chapter from the Bible and improvised a prayer.
example_zh: 理查德叔叔吟诵了《圣经》中的一章，又即兴作了一段祈祷文。

english: not having all that is needed or expected
example_en: He analyzed his game and found it wanting.
example_zh: 他分析了他的比赛，发现还有待改进。

english: to criticize severely
example_en: His first high-budget movie, called 'Brain Donors', was panned by the critics.
example_zh: 他的第一部高成本制作电影《撞板三舞男》遭到恶评。

english: not clear in meaning
example_en: He looked at her vague shape through the frosted glass.
example_zh: 他透过雾蒙蒙的眼镜注视着她模糊的身形。

english: an offensive exhalation or smell
example_en: The sources, components and output of effluvium derived from municipal wastewater treatment plants were introduced in this paper.
example_zh: 这篇论文介绍了城市污水处理厂臭气来源、成分及产量。

english: messy or untidy
example_en: The old beggar was dirty and unkempt.
example_zh: 那个老乞丐蓬头垢面。

english: to damage by rubbing, grinding or scraping
example_en: Their gossips abraded her into restlessness.
example_zh: 他们的流言蜚语使她心烦意乱。

english: a person who predicts the future by magical, intuitive, or more rational means
of or relating to the theater or the presentation of plays
example_en: These are the prizes given for the most outstanding British theatrical performances of the year.
example_zh: 这些奖项将要颁发给本年度英国最杰出的戏剧表演作品。

english: a person whom one knows but who is not a particularly close friend
example_en: She is not my friend, just an acquaintance.
example_zh: 她不是我的朋友，只是一个熟人。

english: to become unsteady, feeble, or spiritless
example_en: Her confidence had never flagged.
example_zh: 她的信心从未减弱。

english: damaging or harmful
example_en: Petty crime is having a deleterious effe ct on community life.
example_zh: 轻微罪行正对社区生活产生有害影响。

english: a thing done with ease
example_en: For me, the GRE was really a cinch.
example_zh: 对我来说，GRE考试真是小菜一碟。

english: to cancel (an order) especially by giving a new order
example_en: The general countermand the orders issued in his absence.
example_zh: 将军撤销了他不在时所发布的命令。

english: a strong feeling of not liking something
example_en: He had an aversion to getting up early.
example_zh: 他十分讨厌早起。

english: to end or stop by force
example_en: The regime ruthlessly suppresses all dissent.
example_zh: 这个政权残酷压制所有不同意见。

english: something that is made up of different things
example_en: The low mountains were a patchwork of green and brown.
example_zh: 低矮的群山上，绿色和棕色混杂着。

english: to move with a violent twist
example_en: She wrenched her knee when she fell.
example_zh: 她跌倒时把膝盖扭伤了。

english: spread out over a large space
example_en: His talk was so diffuse that I missed his point.
example_zh: 他的谈话漫无边际, 我抓不住他的要点

english: too evident to be doubted
example_en: His brilliance renders this film an indubitable classic.
example_zh: 他的出色表现让这部电影成为了毋庸置疑的经典。

english: to bring to maturity or self-sufficiency usually through nurturing care
example_en: It's really not easy for a widowed mother to rear up four children.
example_zh: 一个寡母要抚养4个孩子成人确实不易

english: serving one's own interests often in disregard of the truth or the interests of others
example_en: They suggest that my motives for proposing reform are self-serving and mercenary.
example_zh: 他们暗示说我之所以提议改革是贪图金钱，想谋取私利。

english: to give permission or consent to
example_en: The new drug has not yet been licensed in the US.
example_zh: 这种新药尚未在美国获得许可。

english: having a sharp or bitter quality
example_en: They directed their most astringent attacks at me.
example_zh: 他们对我作最为严厉的攻击

english: expressing personal opinions or beliefs as if they are certainly correct and cannot be doubted
to excite or elate to the point of enthusiasm or frenzy
example_en: He does not drink at all; a little wine will intoxicate him.
example_zh: 他根本不喝酒，因为一点酒就能使他醉

english: likely to do something
example_en: When he speaks on the air, listeners are apt to mistake him for a white man.
example_zh: 他在广播中的说话声会让观众以为他是白人。

english: to fight or speak publicly in support of
example_en: He has always championed the cause of human rights.
example_zh: 他一直在为支持人权而斗争。

english: one that assumes false identity or title for the purpose of deception
example_en: That he was not a God at all, but merely an imposter.
example_zh: 他只不过是一个伪装者，根本就不是神

english: awkward, clumsy
example_en: Mark Cuban's best player is still a tall gawky German guy.
example_zh: 马克库班的最好的球员依然是那个迟钝的德国大个儿.

english: to accept readily or gladly
to cause to exist or to develop
example_en: The issue engendered continuing controversy.
example_zh: 这个问题引起了不断的争论。

english: requiring much time, attention, or effort from someone
example_en: Products should be designed to meet the exacting standards of today's marketplace.
example_zh: 产品的涉及应当符合当今市场严格的标准。

english: to secretly damage or destroy equipment, vehicles ,etc…
example_en: He accused the opposition of trying to sabotage the election.
example_zh: 他谴责反对派企图暗中破坏选举的进行

english: to want very much
dull, irksome, and fatiguing work
example_en: He spent his life in pointlessly tiresome drudgery.
example_zh: 他的一生都在做毫无意义的烦人的苦差事。

english: having many twists and turns
example_en: The Lot river follows a winding and tortuous course.
example_zh: 洛特河的河道蜿蜒曲折。

english: deliberate purposive planning
example_en: They wanted to design a machine that was both attractive and practical.
example_zh: 他们想设计一种既美观又实用的机械。

english: involving a lot of violence, confusion, or disorder
example_en: It's been a tumultuous day at the international trade negotiations in Brussels.
example_zh: 那是布鲁塞尔国际贸易谈判中纷乱的一天。

english: the act of giving or delivering something to people
example_en: Inflation is considered to be undesirabl e because of its adverse effects on inc ome distribution.
example_zh: 通货膨胀被认为是有害的，因为它会对收入分配产生不利影响。

english: to agree to stop fighting, hiding, resisting, etc., because you know that you will not win or succeed
example_en: The rebel soldiers were forced to surrender.
example_zh: 叛军被迫投降。

english: a temporary madness
example_en: The country was gripped by a frenzy of nationalism.
example_zh: 这个国家笼罩在民族主义的狂热中。

english: side by side
example_en: Mary ran abreast of him toward the river.
example_zh: 玛丽和他并肩朝河边跑去。

english: to stop short and refuse to proceed
example_en: We get strong indications that his agent would balk at that request.
example_zh: 我们得到的强烈暗示是他的经纪人会回避那个要求。

english: to strike out, obliterate, or mark for deletion
example_en: His name was expunged from the reco rd books.
example_zh: 他的名字被从档案簿中删去了。

english: very unwilling to spend money
example_en: Even the parsimonious Littler paid for drinks all round.
example_zh: 即便是吝啬鬼利特勒，无论在哪里喝酒也都是付钱的。

english: to use for a particular purpose or to do something
example_en: The firm employs about 100 men.
example_zh: 这家公司大约雇了100人。

english: the state of being near
chinese: 吸引他到该地区的原因是那里靠近伦敦
example_en: What drew him to the area was its proximity to central London.
example_zh: 吸引他到该地区的原因是那里靠近伦敦市中心。

english: easily annoyed or angered and likely to argue
example_en: He was seen as truculent, temperamental, too unwilling to tolerate others.
example_zh: 他们认为他性格好斗, 性情暴躁, 不大能容人。

english: one who excels in the technique of an art
example_en: He was gaining a reputation as a remarkable virtuoso.
example_zh: 作为一位技艺非凡的大师，他声名远扬

english: to deal with or manage wrong or ignorantly
example_en: The equipment could be dangerous if mishandled.
example_zh: 这套设备如果使用不当会有危险。

english: to petition for help or support
example_en: The judge invoked an international law that protects refugees.
example_zh: 法官援用了一项保护难民的国际法律。

english: exaggeratedly or childishly emotional
example_en: The most common writing theme in the western newspaper is obituary report which is rich in content, varied in style, and sentimental in expression but not mawkish as well.
example_zh: 西方报纸上常见的讣闻，内容丰富、形式多样，哀而不伤。

english: to present as evil or diabolic
example_en: Each side began to demonize the othe r.
example_zh: 双方都开始把对方妖魔化。

english: to instill with boldness or courage
example_en: But the union's stance could embolden other critics.
example_zh: 但工会的姿态可能会为其他批评人士壮胆。

english: a cause of trouble
example_en: Some people blame all his vexation for bad luck rather than lacking of competence.
example_zh: 有些人把自己所有的苦恼都归咎于运气不佳, 而不认为是缺乏能力。

english: very interesting
example_en: There is no compelling reason to believe him.
example_zh: 没有令人信服的理由让人相信他。

english: respect that is given to someone who is admired
example_en: The Chinese make a point of their personal honor.
example_zh: 中国人特别重视个人荣誉。

english: a departure from or rejection of something
to see beforehand
example_en: No one can foresee what will happen in the future.
example_zh: 谁也无法预见到将来会发生什么事。

english: support, substantiate
example_en: The report is underpinned by extensive research.
example_zh: 这份报告以广泛的研究为基础。

english: to provoke impatience, anger, or displeasure in
example_en: Their attitude irritates me.
example_zh: 他们的态度激怒了我。

english: to bring into harmony
example_en: He became very attuned to all the suffering around him.
example_zh: 他变得对周围的苦难有强烈的共鸣。

english: sure to happen
example_en: Most unions see privatization as an inevitable prelude to job losses.
example_zh: 大多数工会认为私有化会不可避免地导致失业。

english: marked by simplicity, frugality, or avoidance of luxury and comfort
example_en: Even expedition ships, where spartan accommodation is almost a point of pride, are offering creature comforts.
example_zh: 即使是以简朴为傲的探险船上也能提供舒适性。

english: to reduce in size, quantity, or volume as if by squeezing
example_en: The four debates will be compressed into an unprecedentedly short eight- day period
example_zh: 这4场辩论将被压缩到短短8天的时间，这是前所未有的。

english: to be earlier or older than
example_en: That event antedated World War Ⅱ.
example_zh: 那事件发生在第二次世界大战之前。

english: of or relating to fields or lands or their tenure
example_en: Since the agrarian reform polarization has taken place among the peasants.
example_zh: 在土地改革后，农民发生了分化。

english: easy or possible to get or use
example_en: There are three small boats available for hire.
example_zh: 有3艘小船可供出租。

english: to feel or express sympathy
to make happy or satisfied
example_en: Jay Gatsby did that to gratify his girlfriend's vanity.
example_zh: 盖茨比做那事是要满足他女友的虚荣心

english: to name or dedicate (something, such as a ship) by a ceremony
example_en: She was born in March and christened in June.
example_zh: 她3月份出生，6月洗礼时取了名。

english: to take intense pleasure or satisfaction
example_en: Christmas revels with feasting and dancing were common in England.
example_zh: 圣诞节的狂欢歌舞在英国是很常见的。

english: immediately
example_en: The agreement between us is terminated forthwith.
example_zh: 我们之间的协议立即终止。

english: difficult and unpleasant to do or deal with
example_en: My household duties were not particularly onerous.
example_zh: 我的家务活并不繁重。

english: to add notes or comments to
example_en: Historians annotate, check and interpret the diary selections.
example_zh: 历史学家们对这本日记选集进行了注释、检查和阐释。

english: extraordinary in bulk, quantity, or degree
example_en: This business generates cash in prodigious amounts.
example_zh: 这生意带来大量现金。

english: to stop from moving through or going by
example_en: For years the country has tried to block imports of various cheap foreign products.
example_zh: 多年来，这个国家一直竭力阻挠各种廉价外国产品的进口。

english: to read and mark
a sudden overpowering fright
example_en: Office workers fled in panic as the fire took hold.
example_zh: 火势起来时，办公室人员惊慌逃出。

english: to get revenge
example_en: Christie retaliated by sending his friend a long letter detailing Carl's utter incompetence.
example_zh: 为了报复，克里斯蒂给他朋友寄了一封长信，细述卡尔完全不称职。

english: spirited, brave
example_en: Huang Jiguang's gallant deed is known by all Chinese.
example_zh: 中国人皆知黄继光的英勇事迹。

english: be sufficient
example_en: One example will suffice to illustrate the point.
example_zh: 举一个例子就足以说明这一点。

english: to make major changes or improvements to
example_en: They have tried to reinvent their retail stores.
example_zh: 他们一直在尝试改造他们的零售店。

english: to make less painful, severe, etc.
example_en: To assuage his wife's grief, James took her on a tour of Europe.
example_zh: 为了缓和妻子的悲痛，杰姆斯带她去了欧洲旅游。

english: very devoted or loyal to a person, belief, or cause
example_en: He's a staunch supporter of controls on government spending.
example_zh: 他坚决支持控制政府开支。

english: a difficult, perplexing, or trying situation
example_en: Hank explained our predicament.
example_zh: 汉克说明了我们的艰难处境。

english: to promise to give up or to stop doing
example_en: Wells was not likely to forswear the faith of a lifetime.
example_zh: 威尔斯决不会背弃他毕生的信仰。

english: matchless, incomparable
example_en: People say: “ Guilin's scenery is peerless in the world. ” It was not until I visited the place that I found it really worthy of the reputation.
example_zh: 人们都说“桂林山水甲天下”，到桂林一看，果然名不虚传。

english: to show or suggest something that will happen or exist at a future time
example_en: The wall through Berlin was finally ruptured, prefiguring the reunification of Germany.
example_zh: 柏林墙终于倒塌了，预示着德国的重新统一。

english: causing death
example_en: There was a fatal flaw in the plan.
example_zh: 计划中有一个致命的缺陷。

english: likely to change in a very sudden or extreme way
example_en: He has a volatile temper.
example_zh: 他脾气反复无常。

english: marked by, responding to, or expressing the softer emotions
example_en: Her voice was tender, full of pity.
example_zh: 她的声音很温柔，充满了怜爱。

english: to reduce drastically especially in number
example_en: The pollution could decimate the river' s thriving population of kingfishers.
example_zh: 污染可能会造成河边大量繁殖的翠鸟大批死亡。

english: excessively acquisitive especially in seeking to hoard riches
example_en: They are avaricious and will do anything for money.
example_zh: 他们很贪婪，愿意为了钱做任何事情。

english: simple and plain
an area within which someone or something has authority, influence, or knowledge
example_en: These are questions that lie outside / that do not come within the purview of our inquiry.
example_zh: 这些问题不在我们的调查范围之内.

english: to make (someone) ashamed or embarrassed
example_en: She had been beaten and humiliated by her husband.
example_zh: 她遭到丈夫的殴打和羞辱。

english: calm and in control of your emotions
example_en: Laura was very calm and composed.
example_zh: 劳拉看上去十分沉着冷静。

english: markedly short and abrupt
example_en: They received a characteristically brusque reply from him.
example_zh: 他们从他那里得到的是简短的答复，他一贯都是那样的。

english: the cooperative relationship of colleagues
example_en: His collegiality also signals an end to the imperial premierships of recent decades.
example_zh: 他的共同掌权方式也标志着近几十年帝国主义首相制的终结。

english: deprive of strength
example_en: That bout of pneumonia enfeebled her.
example_zh: 那次肺炎的发作使她虚弱了。

english: to display clearly
example_en: His conversation evinces great courage.
example_zh: 他的谈话显示了很大的勇气。

english: occurring every day
example_en: Television has become part of our quotidian existence.
example_zh: 电视已成为我们日常生活的一部分。

english: branch, offshoot
example_en: Public relation of police is a ramification of modern public relations.
example_zh: 警察公共关系是现代公共关系的衍生物

english: following one’s own capricious, wanton, or depraved inclinations
example_en: Wayward students are always getting into trouble.
example_zh: 任性的学生老是惹麻烦。

english: culminating point
example_en: He has reached the zenith of his career.
example_zh: 他已经达到了他事业的顶峰。

english: meant to be humorous or funny

english: disgusting or distasteful by reason of excess
example_en: Her cheap, cloying scent enveloped him.
example_zh: 她那廉价香水的甜腻气味一下子包围了他。

english: a shout of disapproval or contempt
example_en: The audience booed as she started her speech.
example_zh: 她一开始讲话，听众便发出一阵嘘声。

english: varying in pitch from the proper tone of a melody
example_en: Moe was having fun banging the drums and singing off-key.
example_zh: 莫自得其乐地一边敲着鼓，一边不成调地唱着歌。

english: to talk boastfully
example_en: The player is always bragging about his prowess as a cricketer
example_zh: 这名运动员总是吹嘘自己板球球技的高超。

english: to happen as a result
example_en: Trouble will ensue if wind of this scandal gets out.
example_zh: 这件丑事一露出风声便会招来麻烦。

english: the quality or state of not supporting either side in an argument, fight, war, etc.
chinese: 他们在这场危机中丢弃了中立立场。
example_en: They had thrown their neutrality overboard in the crisis.
example_zh: 他们在这场危机中丢弃了中立立场。

english: discreetly cautious
to provide with what is needed
example_en: She furnished him with the facts surrounding the case.
example_zh: 她向他提供了与案件有关的事实。

english: into parts
example_en: The debate is tearing Wall Street asunder.
example_zh: 这场争论令华尔街分崩离析。

english: tending or intended to evade: equivocal
example_en: They decided to take evasive action.
example_zh: 他们决定采取回避行动。

english: following one after the other in a series
example_en: Jackson was the winner for a second successive year.
example_zh: 杰克逊已经是连续第二年获胜了。

english: causing damage or injury
example_en: Poor eating habits are detrimental to health.
example_zh: 不良的饮食习惯对健康有害。

english: a small piece of paper that allows one to get a service or product for free or at a lower price
example_en: Bring the coupon below to any Tecno store and pay just £ 10.99.
example_zh: 持下面的优惠券到任意一家Tecno专卖店，只需付10.99英镑。

english: putting an end to debate or question especially by reason of irrefutability
example_en: Her attorneys claim there is no conclu sive evidence that any murders took place.
example_zh: 她的律师声称并无确凿证据表明发生了谋杀。

english: scream
example_en: The phone shrilled, making her jump.
example_zh: 电话铃声刺耳地响起，惊得她跳了起来

english: friendly social atmosphere
example_en: The comity needs sincerity to measure , but the sincerity is offer by comity.
example_zh: 友谊需真诚来衡量，而真诚由友谊来奉献。

english: to hinder from passage, action, or operation
showing or characterized by a superior attitude towards others
example_en: The Chinese court assumed an aloof and patronizing attitude toward these Westerners, keeping them confined to the southern port cities of Macao and later, Canton.
example_zh: 中国朝廷对这些西方人采取的是冷漠和施恩的态度，把他们限制在南部的港口城市：澳门以及和后来的广州。

english: done, made, or accomplished piece by piece or in a fragmentary way
example_en: Instead of the government's piecemeal approach, what is needed is a radical shake-up of 16-19 education.
example_zh: 需要的不是政府零敲碎打的措施，而是要对16至19岁年龄段的教育进行彻底变革。

english: of moderate or low quality, value, ability, or performance
example_en: His school record was mediocre.
example_zh: 他在学校成绩平平。

english: causing or tending to cause sadness or depression of mind or spirit
example_en: The general watched the process with an air of melancholy.
example_zh: 将军神情忧郁地望着队列经过。

english: roughly outlined
example_en: He gave us a very sketchy account of his visit.
example_zh: 他跟我们非常粗略地讲了他参观的情况

english: the principle or practice of complete abstinence from alcoholic drinks
example_en: Teetotalism is against nature.
example_zh: 滴酒不沾是违背天性的。

english: broodingly morose
example_en: The princess looked glum but later cheered up.
example_zh: 公主看起来闷闷不乐，但后来又振作起来。

english: to exceed in number
example_en: The demonstrators were heavily outnumbered by the police.
example_zh: 示威者人数远不及警察人数。

english: to refuse to acknowledge as one's own
example_en: Those comments were later disowned by an official army spokesman.
example_zh: 这些话随后遭到了军方一位官方发言人的否认。

english: to praise in a very strong and enthusiastic way
example_en: Angela Bassett has won critical acclaim for her excellent performance.
example_zh: 安吉拉·贝塞特凭借其出色的表演赢得了评论界的好评。

english: marked by unruly or aggressive noisiness
example_en: Ms Chen finds it hard to manage a class of obstreperous students.
example_zh: 面对一班吵闹的学生，陈老师感到难以管束。

english: relating to a subject in an appropriate way
example_en: He asks questions that are germane and central to the issue.
example_zh: 他问了一些与论点有密切关系的重要问题。

english: a person who falsely pretends to know or be something in order to deceive people
example_en: He was exposed as a charlatan.
example_zh: 他被揭穿，原来是个骗子。

english: relaxed and casual in style or manner
childish, silly
example_en: The story is simple, even puerile.
example_zh: 故事很简单，甚至有些幼稚。

english: to include or consist of
chinese: 工作小组由国会领导人、内阁首脑和行
example_en: The task force is comprised of congres sional leaders, cabinet heads and adm inistration officials.
example_zh: 工作小组由国会领导人、内阁首脑和行政官员组成。

english: a principle, belief, or doctrine generally held to be true
example_en: Non-violence and patience are the central tenets of their faith.
example_zh: 非暴力和忍耐是他们的信仰的核心原则

english: to make less angry
example_en: He tried to find ways of mollifying her.
example_zh: 他想方设法安慰她。

english: the state or condition of not having enough of something
example_en: There was a dearth of reliable information on the subject.
example_zh: 关于这个课题缺乏可靠资料。

english: attractive, tempting
example_en: The mellow wine and fruit are so inviting.
example_zh: 醇酒和熟透了的水果是这样诱人。

english: becoming angry very easily
example_en: He had an irascible temper.
example_zh: 他脾气易怒。

english: more interested in reading books and studying than doing more physical activities
example_en: He had a bookish and rather shy look.
example_zh: 他外表有点学究气，相当害羞。

english: marked by display of feeling
example_en: We came from the English tradition of not being demonstrative.
example_zh: 我们继承了英国人轻易不表露感情的传统。

english: in a low position, manner, or degree
example_en: He was irked by his lowly status.
example_zh: 他为自己地位卑微而恼恨。

english: following the current fashion or style
example_en: She is a dainty, chic woman with wide- set eyes and the neck of a ballerina.
example_zh: 她是一个秀丽时髦的女人，有一对大眼睛，同样有着芭蕾舞女演员一样的脖子

english: to make go away or end
example_en: The President is attempting to dispel t he notion that he has neglected the ec onomy.
example_zh: 有人认为总统忽视了经济，总统正试图消除这种看法。

english: causing unnecessary fear or anxiety that something unpleasant or dangerous is going to happen
example_en: Some people are inclined to dismiss such questions as alarmist.
example_zh: 有些人倾向于将这样的问题斥为耸人听闻.

english: to dissolve out by the action of a percolating liquid
example_en: The water percolating through the soil may leach out minerals.
example_zh: 经土壤过滤的水会滤掉矿物质。

english: to give, convey, or grant from or as if from a store
example_en: The ability to impart knowledge and command respect is the essential qualification for teachers.
example_zh: 具备传授知识并赢得尊敬的能力是对教师的基本要求。

english: to lower in grade, rank, or status
to make necessary
too bad to be corrected or repaired
example_en: The move would cause irreparable harm to the organization.
example_zh: 这一举动将给该组织带来不可补救的损害。

english: to wander from the direct course or way
example_en: Her grey hair straggled in wisps about her face.
example_zh: 她那灰白的头发一缕缕地披散在脸旁。

english: hard, harsh, or severe in manner or character
example_en: The police are planning sterner measures to combat crime.
example_zh: 警方正制订更严厉的措施打击犯罪活动

english: a retaliatory act
example_en: They did not want to give evidence for fear of reprisals.
example_zh: 他们因为害怕报复而不想作证。

english: not polite
a person or thing that receives help or an advantage from something
example_en: The main beneficiaries of pension equality so far have been men.
example_zh: 迄今为止，退休金均等政策的主要受益者一直是男性。

english: excluding by exception
example_en: Barring accidents, I believe they will succeed.
example_zh: 不出意外的话，我相信他们会成功的。

english: to cause to be very interested in
to bring to bear especially with sustained effort or lasting effect
example_en: He exerted considerable influence on the thinking of the scientific community on these issues.
example_zh: 他极大地影响了科学界对这些问题的看法。

english: a checking of progress
example_en: The breakdown in talks represents a temporary setback in the peace process.
example_zh: 谈判破裂意味着和平进程暂时受阻。

english: a sense of common purpose with respect to a group
example_en: Morale perked up immediately at the good news.
example_zh: 这个好消息立刻振作起大家的士气。

english: in a badly damaged or deteriorated condition
example_en: The frost has blighted roses.
example_zh: 霜降使玫瑰枯萎了。

english: having or preceding from authority
example_en: Amanda launched into an authoritative disquisition about contracts.
example_zh: 阿曼达就合约给出了权威性的阐述。

english: a fundamental and inevitably true value
example_en: This book reveals some verities of human nature.
example_zh: 这本书关于人性的一些事实。

english: to bring about or carry out (something, such as a crime or deception)
example_en: You begin to ask yourself what kind of person perpetrated this crime.
example_zh: 你开始自问是什么样的人犯下这样的罪行。

english: working closely and well together
example_en: Little attempt was made to integrate the parts into a coherent whole.
example_zh: 在把各部分结合成一个连贯的整体方面几乎未作任何尝试。

english: free from agitation of mind or spirit
example_en: The tranquil atmosphere of the inn allows guests to feel totally at home.
example_zh: 这家客栈的宁静氛围让客人们感到宾至如归。

english: astonishing, overwhelming
example_en: The results from this unit are staggering.
example_zh: 这个团队得出的结果令人吃惊。

english: to promise the performance of by a pledge
example_en: Mr Dudley has pledged to give any award to charity.
example_zh: 达德利先生已承诺将任何所获的损害赔偿额都捐给慈善机构。

english: it can be argued
example_en: Arguably, 1932 was the year of greatest achievement at the Laboratories.
example_zh: 可以说1932年是该实验室最有收获的一年。

english: to say that is larger or greater than it really is
example_en: The authors no doubt overstated their case with a view to catching the public's attention.
example_zh: 作者们毫无疑问地夸大了他们的情形以吸引公众的注意力。

english: to drive danger or attack away from
example_en: He has hired a lawyer to defend him a gainst the allegations.
example_zh: 他已聘请了一位律师针对这些指控为自己辩护。

english: being, living, or going alone or without companions
example_en: He led a solitary life.
example_zh: 他过着独居生活。

english: not to be avoided or evaded
example_en: Job creation has become an imperative for the government.
example_zh: 创造就业机会是政府必须做的事。

english: to express scornfully one's low opinion of
example_en: To assert this is to denigrate the effectiveness of the police.
example_zh: 坚持这一点就是贬低警方的办事能力。

english: strikingly out of the ordinary
example_en: His fast-paced novels are full of bizarre situations and madcap antics.
example_zh: 他那些快节奏的小说里充满了怪诞的场景和荒唐的行为。

english: a large amount of money and possessions
example_en: The purpose of industry is to create wealth.
example_zh: 勤劳的目的是致富。

english: very complicated
example_en: The operations can be quite involved, requiring many procedures in order to restructure the anatomy.
example_zh: 手术可能会十分复杂，需要许多步骤来重建结构。

english: to control and use the natural force or power of something
example_en: Harness your nervous energy and transform it into vitality and enthusiasm.
example_zh: 要控制你的紧张情绪并把它变成活力和热情。

english: a chief support
example_en: As the US economy has slowed, Asian exporting firms - a mainstay of the region's economies - have been hard hit.
example_zh: 美国经济的放缓，对于作为该地区经济支柱的亚洲出口公司来说是一个沉重的打击。

english: restricted or peculiar to a locality or region
example_en: Street crime is virtually endemic in larg e cities.
example_zh: 街头犯罪近乎是大城市的通病。

english: out of date or old- fashioned
example_en: It is a shame such things have come to seem so anachronistic.
example_zh: 遗憾的是这类事物最终流于不合时宜了

english: to assail by words or argument
example_en: All that Cheney has done was to impugn Obama's policies.
example_zh: 切尼所做的一切都是指责奥巴马的政策

english: existing or being something in name or form only
example_en: As he was still not allowed to run a company, his wife became its nominal head.
example_zh: 因为他仍未获准经营公司，他妻子成了名义上的老板。

english: complacently or inanely foolish
example_en: Why did the fatuous King send Qu Yuan into exile?
example_zh: 昏庸的楚王为什么把屈原流放了?

english: the act of maintaining in good condition
example_en: Even if expansion plans are put on hold, existing grids will require repair and constant upkeep.
example_zh: 即使（电力）扩张计划被搁置，现有电网将需要不断保养和维修。

english: required to be responsible for something
example_en: President Barack Obama yesterday promised that BP would be held accountable if it had broken US laws.
example_zh: 美国总统巴拉克-奥巴马昨日许诺，如果BP触犯了美国法律，将追究其责任

english: lacking distinctive or interesting qualities
example_en: She lived in a nondescript suburban apartment block.
example_zh: 她住在一个毫无特征的市郊公寓楼里。

english: a source of relief or consolation
physiologically immature or undeveloped
example_en: We can curb juvenile delinquency by education.
example_zh: 我们可以通过教育来控制少年犯罪。

english: base one something that is not true or real
example_en: It seemed an idealistic and illusory dream.
example_zh: 那似乎是个不切实际的幻梦。

english: to ask humbly and earnestly of
example_en: She supplicated the judge for protection.
example_zh: 她恳求法官保护。

english: to speak to in a way that expresses disapproval or criticism
example_en: My wife admonished me for taking risks with my health.
example_zh: 我的妻子责备我不应拿自己的健康冒险

english: notably polite or polished in manner
example_en: He tried hard to be urbane.
example_zh: 他极力作出彬彬有礼的神态。

english: causing the body or part of the body to become weaker or less able to function as time passes
example_en: Parkinson's disease is a degenerative disorder, which attacks parts of the bra in that control movement.
example_zh: 帕金森病是退化性疾病，它袭击大脑中控制运动的部分。

english: easily affected, influenced, or harmed by something
example_en: Some of these plants are more susceptible to frost damage than others.
example_zh: 这些植物中有一些较其他的易受霜冻危害。

english: to engage in contemplation or reflection
example_en: That's when I try to meditate or do some deep-breathing exercises.
example_zh: 这时我就会试着沉思或者做些深呼吸练习。

english: made, shown, or done in a way that is not easily seen or notices
example_en: They have been supplying covert milit ary aid to the rebels.
example_zh: 他们一直在暗地里向叛乱者提供军事支援。

english: important, consequential
loving peace
example_en: The Liberals were traditionally seen as
example_zh: the more pacific party. 传统上，自由党人被认为更加爱好和平。

english: not genuine, sincere, or authentic
example_en: He had managed to create the entirely spurious impression that the company was thriving.
example_zh: 他设法制造出一种彻头彻尾的假象，让人误以为公司一派兴旺。

english: in the wrong way
example_en: Their instincts warned them something was amiss.
example_zh: 他们直觉上感到有什么地方不对劲儿。

english: used to describe things that touch each other or are immediately next to each other
example_en: Its vineyards are virtually contiguous with those of Ausone.
example_zh: 其葡萄园差不多与着欧颂堡的葡萄园相邻。

english: an untrue statement that is made to damage someone’s reputation
example_en: This is a malicious calumny.
example_zh: 这完全是恶意诽谤。

english: to cause to execute tactical movements（
example_en: The pilot was able to maneuver the crippled aircraft out of the hostile area.
example_zh: 飞行员成功地操纵严重损坏的飞机驶出敌区。

english: the quality or state of being dual or of having a dual nature
example_en: The nature of a state is a social man rather than an economic man, with a dualism of being both self-interested and altruistic.
example_zh: 国家的本性不是经济人，而是社会人，具有利己和利他的双重性。

english: to make no longer necessary
example_en: This deferral would obviate pressure on the rouble exchange rate.
example_zh: 这一延期将消除卢布汇率面临的压力。

english: irreproachable
incapable of being taken by assault
example_en: The Bundesbank's seemingly impregnable position has begun to weaken.
example_zh: 德意志联邦银行看似不可撼动的地位开始削弱了。

english: a strong feeling of excitement and enthusiasm
example_en: The speech aroused nationalist fervor.
example_zh: 这个演讲喚起了民族主义热情。

english: something that prevents or blocks movement from one place to another
example_en: The Yangtze river is a natural barrier to the north-east.
example_zh: 长江是东北方向的一道天然屏障。

english: threadbare and faded from wear
example_en: The old man was shabby and unkempt.
example_zh: 老头蓬头垢面，衣衫褴褛。

english: the state of being joined in some activity or effort
example_en: What will be the effect of the alliance between IBM and Apple?
example_zh: 若IBM公司和苹果公司联手将会有什么效果呢？

english: not having or showing a desire to be noticed, praised, etc.
example_en: He's a man of few words, very polite and unassuming.
example_zh: 他话不多，很有礼貌，为人谦和。

english: imperfectly formed or formulated
example_en: Once people are found out cancered, except few inchoate can be cured by operation, most of others are uncurable.
example_zh: 人们一旦发现患上癌症，除个别早期可以手术治疗外，其它大部分是无法治愈的。

english: degraded, sordid
example_en: It’s well known that the world of entertainment has its seamy side: drug abuse, corruption, alcoholism.
example_zh: 众所周知，演艺界有其肮脏的一面：滥用毒品、堕落腐化、酗酒等等。

english: nimbleness, dexterity
example_en: His intellect and mental agility have never been in doubt.
example_zh: 他的才智和机敏从未受到怀疑。

english: unlimited power over a country
example_en: These people cherish their independence and sovereignty.
example_zh: 这些人民珍视他们的独立和主权。

english: extreme hatred or dislike
example_en: People always hold this abominable be havior in detestation.
example_zh: 这种恶劣作风一向叫人厌恶。

english: very excited about and interested in something
example_en: We are keen that our school should get involved too.
example_zh: 我们盼着自己的学校也参与其中。

english: having knowledge or experience
example_en: Those in business are not, on the whol e, conversant with basic scientific prin ciples.
example_zh: 总的来说，那些从商的人并不太熟悉基本的科学原理。

english: showing or feeling very strong emotions
example_en: He made an impassioned appeal for peace.
example_zh: 他慷慨陈词，呼吁和平。

english: to refuse to admit or approve
example_en: The president vetoed the economic package passed by Congress.
example_zh: 总统否决了国会通过的一揽子经济计划

english: of a kind that can be remitted
example_en: Her poverty had been a venial fault for two gallant gentlemen.
example_zh: 她的贫穷对那两位殷勤的绅士而言，只是一个微不足道的缺点。

english: of a timid disposition
example_en: He is a reclusive, timorous creature.
example_zh: 他是个离群索居、胆小羞怯的家伙。

english: coming and going at intervals
example_en: After three hours of intermittent rain, the game was cancelled.
example_zh: 雨断断续续地下了3个小时之后，比赛被取消了。

english: a person who has previously occupied a position or office to which another has succeeded
example_en: He maintained that he learned everything he knew from his predecessor Kenneth Sisam.
example_zh: 他坚称他所知道的一切都获自前任肯尼思·赛瑟姆。

english: free from care, anxiety, or seriousness
of or relating to the kitchen or cookery
example_en: She was keen to acquire more advanced culinary skills.
example_zh: 她热切渴望学到更高超的烹饪技巧。

english: the condition of having a healthy mind
example_en: His behavior was so strange that I began to doubt his sanity.
example_zh: 他行为怪异，我有点怀疑他是否神智正常。

english: marked by flawless craftsmanship or by beautiful, ingenious, delicate, or elaborate execution
example_en: The Indians brought in exquisite beadwork to sell.
example_zh: 印第安人带了精美的珠饰来卖。

english: happening completely by chance without being planned
example_en: Any resemblance to actual persons, places or events is purely coincidental.
example_zh: 如与真人、真实地点或真实事件有雷同之处，纯属巧合。

english: the act or process of becoming worse
example_en: The recent deterioration has been cau sed by an apparently endless recession.
example_zh: 看似永无止境的经济衰退导致了最近的恶化。

english: extremely costly, rich, luxurious, or magnificent
example_en: We dined in sumptuous surroundings.
example_zh: 我们在富丽堂皇的环境中用餐。

english: having a shy or sweetly innocent quality

example_en: The attack wasn't just a figment of my i magination.
example_zh: 袭击可不是我凭空想象出来的。

english: a concluding section that rounds out the design of a literary work
example_en: Fortinbras speaks the epilogue in Shakespeare's Hamlet.
example_zh: 在莎士比亚的《哈姆雷特》中，由福丁布拉斯念收场白。

english: friendly, sociable, and congenial
example_en: He is an educated, amiable and decent man.
example_zh: 他是个有教养、和蔼可亲的正人君子。

english: tremendous in size, volume, or degree
example_en: That is a gargantuan challenge.
example_zh: 这是一个巨大的挑战。

english: a feeling of unity between people who have the same interests, goals, etc.
example_en: The great friendship and militant solidarity between the peoples of our two countries are unbreakable.
example_zh: 我们两国人民的伟大友谊与战斗团结是坚不可摧的。

english: sincerely and honestly felt or experienced
example_en: Fake designer watches are sold at a fraction of the price of the genuine article .
example_zh: 伪造的设计师名牌手表以真品若干分之一的价格出售。

english: having only one side
example_en: Unpopular policies such as unilateral disarmament were ditched.
example_zh: 诸如单边裁军之类不得人心的政策已被废除了。

english: not exciting or interesting
of the best and most characteristic
example_en: If you can buy only one case at auction, it should be vintage port.
example_zh: 如果你在拍卖会上只能买一箱酒，那就应该是优质的波尔图葡萄酒。

english: having or occurring in great variety
example_en: Spain is a composite of multifarious traditions and people.
example_zh: 西班牙是多种传统和多个民族的合成体

english: to give pain or trouble to
example_en: She was aggrieved at the insult.
example_zh: 她因被侮辱而觉得感情上受到伤害。

english: friendly joking about or with somebody
example_en: Prince Charles does not escape raillery from others.
example_zh: 查尔斯王子也难逃人们善意的玩笑。

english: unable to understand or think clearly
example_en: People are confused about all the different labels on food these days.
example_zh: 人们如今被那些五花八门的食物标签搞得稀里糊涂。

english: the quality or state of something that is not easily changed or likely to change
example_en: NATO had charted a new course for stability and cooperation in Europe.
example_zh: 北约制订了保持欧洲稳定与合作的新计划。

english: to cause to come
example_en: Her screams drew passers-by to the scene.
example_zh: 她的惊叫声把过路人吸引到了现场。

english: the doctrine that pleasure or happiness is the sole or chief good in life
example_en: The age of hedonism is being ushered out by a new era of temperance.
example_zh: 享乐主义时代正让位于一个注重节制的时代。

english: to slow the movement, progress, or action of
example_en: The bad weather hampered rescue operations.
example_zh: 恶劣的天气阻碍了救援工作的进行。

english: to become worse as time passes
example_en: The chops will fester and go to waste.
example_zh: 猪排会腐烂，给糟蹋掉。

english: a sickness or illness
example_en: The pharmacist can assist you with the treatment of common ailments.
example_zh: 药剂师能帮你治疗一般的小病。

english: the state of having identical cumulative distribution function or values
example_en: The government panicked into imposing a kind of cultural homogeneity.
example_zh: 政府在恐慌下开始强制实施某种文化统一政策。

english: to demand an express term in an agreement
example_en: That is why the vehicle manufacturers stipulate regular engine oil changes.
example_zh: 这就是为什么汽车制造商规定定期发动机换油。

english: to shine with or as if with subdued steady light or moderate brightness
example_en: Her black hair gleamed in the sun.
example_zh: 她的黑发在阳光下闪着光泽。

english: narrowly, stodgily, and often ostentatiously learned
a feeling of not worrying about anything
example_en: She hid her worries behind an air of insouciance.
example_zh: 她掩饰着自己的烦恼，表现得无忧无虑

english: intricately involved
example_en: The procedures surrounding legal redress are byzantine.
example_zh: 修改法律的程序是错综复杂的。

english: a distinguishing quality
example_en: Creativity is a human trait.
example_zh: 创造力是人类的一种特性。

english: very noticeable
example_en: Her novels have just been reissued with eye-catching new covers.
example_zh: 她的小说刚进行了重印，新封面非常抢眼。

english: to fill up the number of with new members
example_en: The police are trying to recruit more black and Asian officers.
example_zh: 警方正在试图招聘更多黑人和亚裔警官

english: entrance or enthrall
example_en: Like all great books, it has an enduring power to surprise and mesmerize.
example_zh: 像所有伟大的著作，它有一个持久的力量感到惊讶和催眠。

english: to show to be false or wrong
example_en: Her energy and youthful good looks belie her 65 years.
example_zh: 她的活力与年轻美貌使人看不出她有65岁了。

english: promoting health or well-being of mind or spirit
example_en: Water is a wholesome drink.
example_zh: 水是有益健康的饮料。

english: a person who attempts to stir up or spread something that is usually petty or discreditable
example_en: Of course, once you've spotted the gossip-monger it might help to be very careful about the information you share with this employee.
example_zh: 当然，一旦你知道了谁是喜欢传闲话的人，那么跟这个员工分享信息的时候就要特别小心谨慎。

english: too ready to believe things
example_en: Mary is so credulous that she may rea dily accept any excuse you make.
example_zh: 玛丽很轻信，你随便找个借口她都可以相信。

english: one who attends or assists a leader
example_en: Others say of course that he is an acolyte of the old regime, he's the one who has brought problem to Egypt.
example_zh: 当然也有人说，他是旧政权的支持者，埃及的问题就出在他身上。

english: to help someone or something pay for the costs of
example_en: Many universities subsidize research and publications.
example_zh: 许多大学资助研究和出版。

english: not easily understood or explained
example_en: His equivocal response has done nothi ng to dampen the speculation.
example_zh: 模棱两可的回应丝毫没有消除人们的猜疑。

english: to agree precisely
example_en: His practice does not square with his principles.
example_zh: 他的行为与主张不符。

english: to represent as less than is the case
example_en: The government chooses deliberately to understate the increase in prices.
example_zh: 政府有意选择对价格的上涨轻描淡写。

english: to manage prudently and economically
example_en: Husbanding precious resources was part of rural life.
example_zh: 节约地使用宝贵的资源是乡村生活的一部分。

english: to ruin or spoil
example_en: His spirit was vitiated by pleasure seeking.
example_zh: 他的志气因追求吃喝玩乐而消磨殆尽。

english: experiencing or tending to bring about renewal or revival
example_en: That could harm exports and growth in the resurgent eurozone.
example_zh: 对于正在复苏的欧元区，这可能会危害到它的出口和增长。

english: providing something additional to a main part of function
example_en: The transport corps is ancillary to the infantry.
example_zh: 运输队是步兵的辅助部队。

english: changing often
example_en: Online players are a fickle bunch who move to new games quickly.
example_zh: 在线玩家是一群易变的人，他们很快就会转移到新游戏中。

english: organized to do good things for other people
example_en: The company has proved to be a most benevolent employer.
example_zh: 结果证明该公司是一个非常仁慈的雇主

english: of or relating to the brain
example_en: His poetry is very cerebral.
example_zh: 他的诗富涵理性。

english: strongly desirous of acquiring and possessing
example_en: The most acquisitive firms tend to be engineering groups.
example_zh: 最贪得无厌的公司往往是工程队。

english: product of the imagination
example_en: The story was certainly a favorite one, but it was undoubtedly pure invention.
example_zh: 这个故事的确是人们最喜欢的一个，但毫无疑问它纯粹是虚构的。

english: agreeing with a set of rules, standards, or requirements
example_en: She was much naughtier than her com pliant brother.
example_zh: 她哥哥很听话，她却调皮得多。

english: to take arbitrary or forcible possession of
example_en: All automobiles in the town were commandeered by the army.
example_zh: 城中所有的汽车均被部队征用了。

english: a person who argues for or supports a cause or policy
example_en: Mr Williams is a strong advocate of free market policies and a multi-party system.
example_zh: 威廉斯先生是自由市场政策和多党派制度的坚决拥护者。

english: to confuse very much
chinese: 你不要以这个问题困惑她。

english: of outstanding spiritual, intellectual, or moral worth
example_en: She elevated every rare small success to the sublime.
example_zh: 她把每一次少有的微小成功都提升成了非凡的成就。

english: a person who has just started learning or doing something
example_en: In fact, in the world of complex software, everyone is effectively a novice.
example_zh: 事实上，在复杂的软件世界里，每个人实际上都是新手。

english: exhibiting or given to extreme fierceness and unrestrained violence and brutality
example_en: The ferocious panther is chasing a rabbit.
example_zh: 那只凶猛的豹子正追赶一只兔子。

english: a natural liking for something
example_en: Charles has always had a predilection for red-haired women.
example_zh: 查尔斯对红头发女人一直有偏爱。

english: very careful about doing what you are supposed to do
example_en: She is very conscientious and never s kimps her work.
example_zh: 她办事认真，从不敷衍了事。

english: wrongdoing or misconduct especially by a public official
example_en: The mayor is condemned for the monstrous malfeasance of his administration.
example_zh: 市长被宣告有罪，由于其领导的政府渎职。

english: to become liable or subject to: bring down upon oneself
example_en: She falls in love and incurs the wrath of her father.
example_zh: 她恋爱了，这引起了父亲的愤怒。

english: shocked and upset
example_en: Tania stared at him aghast, unable to speak.
example_zh: 塔妮娅吃惊地看着他，说不出话来。

english: a place or locality especially when viewed in relation to a particular event or characteristic
example_en: An amusement park is the perfect locale for a bunch of irrepressible youngsters to have all sorts of adventures.
example_zh: 游乐场是一帮精力过剩的年轻人寻求各种惊险刺激的绝佳场所。

english: favoring, conducive to, or operating toward peace, moderation, or conciliation
example_en: Great players can hold an irenic attitude toward former antagonists.
example_zh: 伟大的运动员能够秉持对前对手的和平态度。

english: a lack of belief or a strong disbelief in the existence of a god or any gods
example_en: David believes in atheism as though it were a new religion.
example_zh: 大卫信奉无神论就像信仰一种新的宗教

english: the act of causing two people or groups to become friendly again after an argument or disagreement
example_en: Their handshake appeared to be a gesture of reconciliation.
example_zh: 他们的握手似乎是和解的表示。

english: used, needed, or enjoyed constantly usually by many individuals
example_en: Rice is the staple food of more than half the world's population.
example_zh: 稻米是全世界一半以上人口的主食。

english: to attract artfully or adroitly or by arousing hope or desire
example_en: The promise of higher pay enticed me into the new job.
example_zh: 高薪诱使我从事了这个新工作。

english: preservation from destruction or failure
example_en: The church's message of salvation has changed the lives of many.
example_zh: 基督教中耶稣拯救灵魂的教义改变了很多人的生活。

english: very obvious and offensive

example_zh: 代表团向下院呈交了有关公然侵犯基本人权的备忘录。

english: very poor
example_en: The town government is responsible for assistance to indigent people.
example_zh: 镇政府负责给穷人提供帮助。

english: unshakable or insistent especially in maintaining a position or opinion

example_zh: 美国谈判者非常强硬，他们在这一点上是不会妥协的。

english: the last small part that remains of something that existed before

example_zh: 这些竖立的石头是某种古代宗教的遗迹

english: a commonplace or hackneyed statement or notion

example_zh: 会议上提出的还是那些惯常讨论的老套话题——宏观经济政策、第三世界债务和环境问题。

english: being in an early stage of development
example_en: It is still in an embryonic stage.
example_zh: 它还处于萌芽阶段。

english: easily duped or cheated

example_zh: 骗子们已使一些轻信的人上了当。

english: to reduce the speed of
chinese: 但大多数分析师已经预料到中国的增长

example_zh: 但大多数分析师已经预料到中国的增长会减速。

english: not energetic or excited

example_zh: 评论家对那部影片的反映不太热烈。

english: a noisy disturbance or quarrel

example_zh: 在酒吧里吵了一架后，他气鼓鼓地开车走了。

english: to take or use especially in a way that is illegal, unfair, etc.

example_zh: 所以如果你想要人们受教育，也许一定形式的补助是合适的。

english: a terse formulation of a truth or sentiment
example_en: It is the aphorism of the Asian Games.
example_zh: 这是亚运会的格言。

english: a strong inclination or interest

example_zh: 普京似乎更倾向于试图证明俄罗斯再次可以说“不”。

english: to be in inward turmoil

example_zh: 那名花匠憋了一个早上的愤怒终于爆发了。

english: analyze critically

example_zh: 然后您可以让您的测试自动化读取、解析和使用该文件中的数据。

english: currently or actually existing
example_en: Two fourteenth-century manuscripts of this text are still extant.
example_zh: 这个文本仍有两份14世纪手抄本存世。

english: to throw away because it is useless or unwanted
example_en: On no account should we discard our f ine traditions and styles of work.
example_zh: 好传统、好作风绝不能扔掉。

english: of, relating to, befitting, or suggestive of an empire or an emperor
example_en: They executed Russia's imperial family in 1918.
example_zh: 他们 1918 年处死了俄国沙皇皇族。

english: a great disaster or complete failure
example_en: After the debacle of the war the world was never the same again.
example_zh: 经历了这场战争的惨败之后，世界再也不是原来的那个样子了。

english: to become worse in condition or quality

example_zh: 自由民主党的选举运势可能会衰减。

english: unqualified, utter

example_zh: 听他的音乐完全是一种享受。

english: a feeble or ridiculous imitation

example_zh: 这拙劣的模仿仅仅是戏弄的一个形式。

english: existing or continuing in the same way for a long time

example_zh: 它反映了长久以来对阿拉伯语世界内关于该语言现状的担忧。

english: ancestor, forefather
having a pleasant or agreeable taste
to think of or describe something as larger or greater than it really is

example_zh: 希拉承认自己有时候确实夸大了工作的难度。

english: a situation in which you have to make a difficult choice

example_zh: 这个问题引发了一个道德上的两难抉择

english: a mixture of different elements

example_zh: 这个电影脚本由三本书合成。

english: vast or ample in extent

example_zh: 这座房子有一个宽敞的厨房和用餐区。

english: to hide your true feelings, opinions, etc.

example_zh: 在需要时，亨利会毫不迟疑地伪装自己

english: to stimulate or excite as if by an electric shock
example_en: The aid appeal has galvanized the German business community.
example_zh: 这份救助呼吁已经促使德国的工商业界行动了起来。

english: depending on each other
example_en: We live in an increasingly interdependent world.
example_zh: 我们生活在一个日益相互依赖的世界。

english: to establish or bring about as if by force
example_en: Parents of either sex should beware of imposing their own tastes on their children.
example_zh: 父母双方都应切记不要把自己的喜好强加给孩子。

english: truth or accuracy
example_en: They questioned the veracity of her story.
example_zh: 他们质疑她所述事情的真实性。

english: powerfully pleasing, appealing, or delightful
example_en: She has the most enchanting smile.
example_zh: 她有着最迷人的微笑。

english: not easily or naturally deduced or introduced
example_en: The storyline was too far-fetched and none of the actors was particularly good.
example_zh: 故事情节太离谱，演员表演也没有出彩的。

english: causing feelings of sadness and sympathy

example_zh: 这只动物低声哀叫，令人怜悯。

english: strikingly out of the ordinary
example_en: Grass's novels are peopled with outlandish characters.
example_zh: 格拉斯的小说里都是些稀奇古怪的人物

english: incapable of error
example_en: No country should claim infallibility and each country should be prepared to re-examine its own attitudes for the common good.
example_zh: 任何国家都不应自称一贯正确，各国都要准备为了共同的利益重新检查自己的态度。

english: standoffish
to let fall, exude, or precipitate in drops or in a wet mist
example_en: We were asked to distill the crucial points of the book.
example_zh: 我们被要求从这本书中提炼出关键点。

english: an official document conferring a right or privilege
to gather into a ball, mass, or cluster
example_en: Similarly charged colloidal particles cannot agglomerate into larger particles.
example_zh: 带相同电荷的胶粒不能聚集成较大的颗粒。

english: a competition, dispute, or fight open to all comers and usually with no rules
example_en: The lowering of trade barriers has led to a free-for-all among exporters.
example_zh: 降低贸易壁垒导致出口商各自为政。

english: not giving you enough useful information
example_en: The reports of the explosion were brief and uninformative.
example_zh: 有关爆炸事件的报道很简略，未及详情

english: the state of being old and in bad condition or poor health
example_en: The building had a general air of decre pitude and neglect.
example_zh: 这座建筑看上去破旧失修，无人照管。

english: inflame, excite
example_en: Lady Lysa's face was flushed with fury.
example_zh: 莱莎夫人气得满脸通红。

english: performed or existing on a large scale especially without discrimination
example_en: Once wholesale prices are deregulated, consumer prices will also rise.
example_zh: 一旦批发价格放开，零售价格也会随之上涨。

english: to treat as a very important and famous person

example_zh: 媒体开始狂热地吹捧他。

english: to say that you accept or do not deny the truth or existence of

example_zh: 内勒在给法官的信中承认自己吸毒。

english: to pretend to have

example_zh: 他表现出一副高高在上的样子以获得自我满足。

english: to act as intermediary

example_zh: 梵蒂冈成功地调解了1984年阿根廷与智利之间的领土争端。

english: exciting distaste or aversion
example_en: All food was repugnant to me during my illness.
example_zh: 生病时所有的食物都使我感到厌恶.

english: eerie, mysterious
example_en: Tony was unnerved by the uncanny familiarity of her face.
example_zh: 怪异的是，她看起来竟有些面熟，这让托尼心慌意乱。

english: to make more prominent or noticeable
example_en: Happy couples accentuate the positive.
example_zh: 幸福伴侣总是强调积极的一面。

english: to persuade with flattery or gentle urging especially in the face of reluctance
chinese: 他诱骗我同意接下那份工作。

example_zh: 他诱骗我同意接下那份工作。

english: not showing emotion

example_zh: 他满足于站在旁边做一个冷漠的旁观者

english: poorly done or made

example_zh: 我们不会花高价买劣质商品。

english: marked by arrogant assurance

example_zh: 她从桌子对面扫了他一眼，目光咄咄逼人，凌利而专横。

english: to make agitated and angry

example_zh: 他很少因为约定取消或出发太晚而恼火

english: to be about to occur

example_zh: 出发远征的那个早上，我醒来就有一种灾难即将来临的感觉。

english: the period of one's greatest popularity, vigor, or prosperity
example_en: In its heyday, the studio's boast was that it had more stars than there are in heaven.
example_zh: 在其全盛时期，该制片公司夸口说，他们旗下的明星比天上的星星还要多。

english: to be present in large quantity
example_en: The advertisements teem with our life everywhere.
example_zh: 在我们的生活中到处充满了广告。
