example_zh: 目前，南部苏丹居民主要效忠于好战的部落首领，而不是带领他们为独立而战的新生的政府。

english: feeding on plants
example_en: Mammoths were herbivorous mammals.
example_zh: 猛犸是食草性哺乳动物。

english: causing a feeling of great surprise or wonder
example_en: The results are quite astounding.
example_zh: 结果令人无比震惊。

english: allowed according to rules or laws
example_en: The French government has condemned the coup in Haiti and has demanded the restoration of the legitimate government.
example_zh: 法国政府已经谴责了海地的政变，并要求恢复合法政府。

english: to avoid or ignore especially to get something done quicker
a rude or discourteous act
example_en: It is gross incivility to refuse answer when spoken to.
example_zh: 当人家找你说话时拒绝答应是极其无礼的事.

english: affirm, declare
example_en: We predicate goodness and mercy of god.
example_zh: 我们断定上帝之善与慈悲。

english: to declare or make legally invalid or void
example_en: Their marriage was annulled after just six months.
example_zh: 他们的婚姻仅过半年就宣告取消。

english: to give heart to: cheer
example_en: These initiatives appeared to hearten investors.
example_zh: 这些举措似乎鼓舞了投资者。

english: a minor flaw or shortcoming in character or behavior
to induct into an office with suitable ceremonies
example_en: The new President will be inaugurated on January 20.
example_zh: 新总统将于1月20号举行就职典礼。

english: to reduce in size
example_en: Sales have decreased so much that they need to downsize.
example_zh: 销售业绩减少很多，所以他们必须缩小规模。

english: characterized by shrewdness in managing, contriving, or dealing
example_en: Many towns often found it politic to change their allegiance.
example_zh: 很多城镇经常发现改变拥戴对象才是上策。

english: to confound with fear, amazement, or awe
example_en: The news petrified me.
example_zh: 这个新闻让我非常吃惊。

english: of, relating to, or marked by declamation or rhetorical display
example_en: Rebels like Katharine Hamnett have m ade a name for bold, declamatory statements.
example_zh: 诸如凯瑟琳·哈姆内特之类的叛逆者以口出大胆、夸张之词而闻名。

english: dynamic, energizing
example_en: The energy of motion is called kinetic energy.
example_zh: 运动的能量称为动能。

english: believable or realistic
example_en: He was so plausible that he conned everybody.
example_zh: 他那么会花言巧语，以至于骗过了所有的人。

english: not capable of being defended against attack or criticism
example_en: This argument is untenable from an intellectual, moral and practical standpoint.
example_zh: 从智识、道德和现实的角度来看，这一论点是站不住脚的。

english: hard to notice or see
example_en: The job required a subtle mind.
example_zh: 那项工作需要一个头脑敏锐的人去做。

english: to criticize very harshly
example_en: They lambasted the report as a gross distortion of the truth.
example_zh: 他们激烈批评该报告是严重歪曲事实。

english: arrested in development or adjustment
example_en: He is fixated on things that remind him of his childhood.
example_zh: 他异常依恋那些使他回忆起童年生活的东西。

english: of little weight or importance
example_en: The group says it wants politicians to stop wasting public money on what it believes are frivolous projects.
example_zh: 这个团体表示希望从政者不要再把公共资金浪费在一些它认为无关痛痒的项目上。

english: full of danger
example_en: The journey through the jungle was perilous.
example_zh: 穿过丛林的旅行充满了危险。

english: a main interest, quality, or goal
example_en: The course is essentially theoretical in orientation.
example_zh: 该课程的目标基本上是理论性的。

english: the belief that a country should not be involved with other counties
example_en: Voices of economic isolationism do not represent the interests of the American people.
example_zh: 经济孤立主义的声音并不代表美国人民的利益。

english: fierce, cruel, terrible
to examine in order to suppress or delete anything considered objectionable
example_en: Censor on film means you examine a film to see whether it can be released or not.
example_zh: 审查电影就是检查一部电影是否能够发行。

english: a mania for great or grandiose performance
example_en: Early success may lead to megalomania.
example_zh: 少年得志可能导致妄自尊大。

english: proceeding without a specific goal, purpose, or direction
example_en: Don't waste time yours and your manager's with long preambles and rambling thoughts.
example_zh: 不要用长篇大论和杂乱无章的想法来浪费你和经理的时间。

english: of, relating to, or befitting a teacher or education
example_en: Three aspects are included: its pedagogical idea, the teaching reform and practice, and the teaching effects.
example_zh: 它从教育理念、教学改革与实践、教学效果三个方面展开。

english: the state or custom of being married to only one person at a time
example_en: There are apparently some misconceptions about this whole monogamy thing.
example_zh: 很多人显然对一夫一妻制存在着误解。

english: leaning to one side
example_en: His suit had shoulders that made him look lopsided.
example_zh: 他那套西服的两肩不平，让他整个人看起来一边高一边低。

english: to begin to fail or weaken
example_en: The economy shows no signs of faltering.
example_zh: 经济没有衰退的迹象。

english: in a state of complete disorder and confusion
example_en: Mullins began to rummage among the chaotic mess of papers on his desk.
example_zh: 马林斯开始在桌子上一堆乱七八糟的文件里翻来翻去。

english: tyro, beginner
having corresponding points whose connecting lines are bisected by a given point or perpendicularly bisected by a given line or plane
example_en: The two wings of the building are exactly symmetrical.
example_zh: 大楼的两翼完全对称。

english: the time at which something begins
example_en: Since its inception the company has produced 53 different aircraft designs.
example_zh: 该公司自成立以来已经完成了 53 种不同样式飞行器的设计。

english: not easily upset or excited
to descend or dip suddenly
example_en: Some traders said the plunge put the market more in sync with the state of the USA.
example_zh: 一些交易员说，此次大盘跳水令市场和美国经济现状更为协调。

english: an indispensable and fundamental basis
example_en: The doctrine of surplus value is the cor nerstone of Marx's economic theory.
example_zh: 剩余价值学说是马克思经济理论的基石

english: undivided rule or absolute sovereignty by a single person
example_en: The monarchy in England plays an important role in British culture.
example_zh: 英格兰的君主政体在英国文化中起重要作用。

english: to supply what is required or desired
example_en: When companies try to cater for older customers, they do not always get it right.
example_zh: 公司试着迎合老年客户，但他们并不总是采取正确方式。

english: new and different from what has been known before
example_en: Protesters found a novel way of demonstrating against steeply rising oil prices.
example_zh: 抗议者们找到一种新奇的示威方式来反对石油价格的飙升。

english: treating all people and groups equally
example_en: Careers officers offer impartial advice to all pupils.
example_zh: 就业指导员向所有学生提供公正无私的建议。

english: a deed notable especially for courage
example_en: The tunnel is a brilliant feat of engineering.
example_zh: 这条隧道是工程方面的辉煌成就。

english: a person who hates or distrusts humankind
example_en: You must be some kind of cynic or misanthrope to object to such a laudable goal.
example_zh: 你一定是有点愤世嫉俗或反人类才会反对这个值得赞赏的目标。

english: happening by chance
example_en: Their success is the result of a fortuitous combination of circumstances.
example_zh: 他们的成功是各种环境因素偶然联系在一起的幸运产物。

english: something that will make everything about a situation better
example_en: Membership of the ERM is not a panacea for Britain's economic problems.
example_zh: 加入欧洲汇率机制并不是解决英国经济问题的万灵丹。

english: having or showing liveliness and enthusiasm
example_en: Besides ebullient congratulant word, organizer brought a lot of exquisite gifts.
example_zh: 除了热情洋溢的祝贺词外，主办方还带来了精美的小礼物。

english: to talk or write foolishly
example_en: He waffled on about everything that didn't matter.
example_zh: 他继续对所有无关紧要的事胡扯了一通

english: urgently important
example_en: It is one of the most pressing problems facing this country.
example_zh: 它是该国面临的最紧迫的问题之一。

english: causing wonder
example_en: We were driven across this wondrous vast land of lakes and forests.
example_zh: 我们乘车穿越这片有着湖泊及森林的广袤而神奇的土地。

english: to convert into intelligible form
example_en: All he had to do was decode it and pass it over.
example_zh: 他需要做的就是将它破译然后转给他人

english: strengthen or toughen
chinese: 毕业后我去当兵，其间我在很多方面得
example_en: After graduation, I served in the army and meanwhile I went through a lot of anneal.
example_zh: 毕业后我去当兵，其间我在很多方面得到了锻炼。

english: one who practices a profession
example_en: As a practitioner I discovered problem that I need to solve.
example_zh: 作为从业者，我会发现我需要解决的问题。

english: to make greater, more numerous, larger, or more intense
example_en: While searching for a way to augment the family income, she began making dolls.
example_zh: 为了想法子增加家庭收入，她开始制作洋娃娃。

english: covering or including everything
example_en: An all-inclusive two-week holiday costs around £880 per person.
example_zh: 为期两周、包括所有费用的度假大约每人花费880英镑。

english: a slight offense
example_en: People are not tolerant of extra-marital peccadilloes by public figures.
example_zh: 人们不能容忍公众人物婚外过失。

english: to secretly plan with someone to do something that is harmful or illegal
example_en: She admitted conspiring with her lover to murder her husband.
example_zh: 她承认与情夫密谋杀害亲夫。

english: having a thick edge or point
example_en: He was sawing the bread with a blunt knife.
example_zh: 他用一个很钝的小刀切面包。

english: possessing or acting with bravery or boldness
extremely old

example_zh: 但是随着时间的流逝，一度新鲜的观念也变成了陈腐的教条。

english: to change into a vapor or to cause to change into a vapor
example_en: The benzene vaporized and formed a huge cloud of gas.
example_zh: 苯蒸发了，形成了一大团气体。

english: a narrow exclusive circle or group of persons
example_en: At university, Taylor had fallen in with a small clique of literature students.
example_zh: 在大学里，泰勒曾经频繁参与一个文学小团体的活动。

english: a natural or inherent aptitude, impulse, or capacity
the technical terminology or characteristic idiom of a special activity or group
example_en: The manual is full of the jargon and slang of self-improvement courses.
example_zh: 手册里满是有关自修课程的行话术语。

english: a doctrine or practice that emphasizes direct vigorous action
example_en: The hallmarks of our corporate culture include an emphasis on teamwork, meritocracry, client service, and activism in a wide variety of areas.
example_zh: 我们企业文化的特色包括：强调团队协作、精英领导、客户服务，以及在广泛领域的行动主义。

english: surpassing all others
example_en: Some superlative wines are made in this region.
example_zh: 一些上好的葡萄酒就是在这个地区酿造的。

english: a person who has just started learning or doing something
to prevent from happening
example_en: Arrests and jail sentences have done n othing to deter the protesters.
example_zh: 逮捕和监禁都没能吓倒抗议者。

english: shelter or protection from danger or distress
example_en: He regarded the room as a refuge from the outside world.
example_zh: 他把这个屋子当作是逃避外界的避难所

english: traveling from place to place
example_en: He is starting itinerant performance all over the world.
example_zh: 他正在世界各地巡回演出。

english: to write or draw hastily and carelessly
example_en: She can't write yet, but she loves to scribble with a pencil.
example_zh: 她现在还不会写字, 但她喜欢用铅笔乱涂.

english: tending to talk a lot
example_en: My garrulous neighbor had given away the secret.
example_zh: 我那喋喋不休的邻居已把秘密泄露了。

english: full of dust and unpleasant smells
example_en: The fusty organization refused to recognize the demand for popular music.
example_zh: 这一古板的机构拒绝承认人们对流行音乐的需求。

english: to become bigger quickly
example_en: In London, the use of the Tube has ballooned.
example_zh: 在伦敦，坐地铁的人激增。

english: profitable
example_en: Small local shops stop being economic when a supermarket opens up nearby.
example_zh: 附近的一家超市开业后，当地的小商店就没有利润可赚了。

english: hostile toward a rival or one believed to enjoy an advantage
example_en: She was jealous of his wealth.
example_zh: 她嫉妒他的富有。

english: having a very sour or sharp taste
example_en: Dissolved carbon dioxide makes the water more acidic.
example_zh: 二氧化碳溶解后能使水的酸性增加。

english: a strong desire for money or possessions
example_en: There was a glimmer of cupidity in those small, cunning eyes of his.
example_zh: 他狡猾的小眼睛里露出了一丝贪婪的神情。

english: of or relating to faction
example_en: These factious groups are more violent than their predecessors and their fanaticism is even more irrational.
example_zh: 这些宗教派组织比他们的前辈更残暴，他们的狂热变得更加丧失理性了。

english: a situation of perplexity or distress
example_en: She found herself in desperate financial straits.
example_zh: 她发觉自己经济状况极为窘迫。

english: volunteering one's services where they are neither asked nor needed
example_en: When people put on uniforms, their attitude becomes more confident and their manner more officious.
example_zh: 人们穿上制服后会信心倍增，也更爱管闲事了。

english: coolly and patronizingly haughty
example_en: Her supercilious attitude enraged me.
example_zh: 她的傲慢态度使我极为愤怒。

english: to call something to mind
example_en: Ramona spoke with warmth when she recollected the doctor who used to be at the county hospital.
example_zh: 拉蒙纳回忆起曾在乡村医院工作的那位医生时，言语中透着温情。

english: an unfortunate accident
example_en: This mishap reminded me of a traffic accident I once experienced.
example_zh: 这次小事故使我联想起我过去经历的一次交通事故。

english: false information that is given to people in order to make them believe something or to hide the truth
example_en: They spread disinformation in order to discredit politicians.
example_zh: 他们散布假消息，企图败坏政治家的名声。

english: very noticeable
example_en: There has been a marked increase in crimes against property.
example_zh: 侵犯财产罪的数量有了明显的增加。

english: commonly accepted or supposed
example_en: Newt Gingrich, a putative Republican candidate next year, has thrown his weight behind the idea.
example_zh: 公认的明年共和党候选人NewtGingrich，已经表明了对此意见的态度

english: reappear
an irreligious or hedonistic person
example_en: The new religion was eager to convert the pagan world.
example_zh: 那种新宗教急于使异教徒皈依本教。

english: to lessen the strength or
a critical and usually censorious remark
example_en: This text is an animadversion to comment on an article.
example_zh: 本文是一篇批评性评论文章。

english: a tendency to believe that some people, ideas, etc., are better than others that usually results in treating some people unfairly
example_en: Many parents are biased against popular music.
example_zh: 许多父母对流行音乐有偏见。

english: to examine carefully especially in a critical way
example_en: The statement was carefully scrutinized before publication.
example_zh: 声明在发表前经过仔细审查。

english: the farthest or highest point
example_en: The Alliance for Progress reached its apogee during the first half of the decade.
example_zh: 这十年中的前五年是进步联盟迈向顶峰的时期。

english: having little or no money
example_en: He is impecunious, does not know anyone who can lend money.
example_zh: 他身无分文，也不认识任何可以借钱的人。

english: causing wonder and admiration
example_en: Among the most spectacular sights are the great sea-bird colonies.
example_zh: 庞大的海鸟群是最壮观的景象之一。

english: habitually lazy
example_en: Having nothing to do makes one indolent.
example_zh: 一个人老是无所事事就会懒散成性。

english: something that exists only in the imagination and is not possible in reality
chinese: 宗教统一仍然和从前一样，不过是个妄
example_en: Religious unity remained as much a chimera as ever.
example_zh: 宗教统一仍然和从前一样，不过是个妄想。

english: small bumps on your skin that are caused by cold, fear, or a sudden feeling of excitement
example_en: When I ride a bicycle on a windy night, I get goosebumps.
example_zh: 当我在起风的夜里骑脚踏车时，我会起鸡皮疙瘩。

english: to determine beforehand
example_en: These factors predetermine to a large extent the outcome.
example_zh: 这些因素在很大程度上预先决定了其结果。

english: not loyal and cannot be trusted
example_en: Their feet will trample on the dead bodies of their perfidious aggressors.
example_zh: 他们将从背信弃义的侵略者的尸体上踏过。

english: to give up, refuse, or resign usually by formal declaration
not letting light through
example_en: You can always use opaque glass if you need to block a street view.
example_zh: 如果你需要挡住外面的街景，你随时可以使用不透明玻璃。

english: the technical or special terms used in a business, art, science, or special subject
example_en: The disagreement arose over a different use of terminology.
example_zh: 分歧的缘起在于专门用语使用的不同。

english: to copy especially of humor
example_en: Neural networks are computer systems which mimic the workings of the brain.
example_zh: 神经网络是模拟大脑工作方式的计算机系统。

english: able to do many different things
example_en: They bought a versatile Swiss Army knife for $ 20.
example_zh: 他们花二十美元买了一把多功能的瑞士军刀。

english: to cause to feel weariness and restlessness through lack of interest
example_en: Dickie bored him all through the meal with stories of the Navy.
example_zh: 迪基吃饭时一直在讲海军的故事，让他不胜其烦。

english: to increase in number or amount quickly
example_en: Computerized data bases are proliferating fast.
example_zh: 计算机数据库正在迅速激增。

english: excessive scanty
example_en: The rest of the old man's exiguous savings are donated to that boy.
example_zh: 那老人微薄积蓄中的剩余部分都捐赠给了那个男孩。

english: making you feel serious and thoughtful
example_en: It is sobering to realize that this is not a new problem.
example_zh: 意识到这并不是新问题，就会使人冷静严肃起来。

english: the ability to think clearly and make good decisions
example_en: His sharp business acumen meant he quickly rose to the top.
example_zh: 精明的商业头脑令其青云直上。

english: a model of excellence or perfection
example_en: He wasn't the paragon of virtue she had expected.
example_zh: 他不是她想象中的那种美德典范。

english: to attack or criticize in a violent or angry way
example_en: The opposition's newspapers assail the government each day.
example_zh: 反对党的报纸每天都对政府进行猛烈抨击。

english: using conversational style
example_en: When reading, I'm always confused wit h idioms, slang and colloquial words.
example_zh: 在阅读中，我总是弄不清惯用语、俚语和口语词汇。

english: to suspend indefinitely or until a later stated time
example_en: The trial has been adjourned until next week.
example_zh: 审判延期至下周。

english: to revile or scold in harsh, insolent, or abusive language
example_en: Other Internet users rail at companies and government departments forcing staff to donate to national appeals.
example_zh: 其它互联网用户则抱怨企业与政府部门强迫员工响应国家号召，加入捐款活动

english: crude or coarse in manner or style
example_en: He spent all day playing rackets on the beach, a plebeian sport if there ever was one.
example_zh: 他一整天都在海滩玩壁球，再没有比这更粗俗的运动了。

english: advocating or involving a rigidly uncompromising course of action
example_en: This politician is a hardliner.
example_zh: 这个政治家是一个强硬分子

english: neither perpendicular nor parallel
example_en: Our laughter startled people at a nearby table.During the time left to us, out glances were furtive,oblique.
example_zh: 我们的笑声惊动了邻桌的人，接下来我们的目光躲躲闪闪，游离不定。

english: to expose to view by or as if by digging away a covering
example_en: The site has been excavated by archaeologists.
example_zh: 这个遗址已被考古学家发掘出来。

english: stubbornly tenacious
to condemn or forbid as harmful or unlawful
example_en: In some cultures surgery is proscribed.
example_zh: 在一些文化里，外科手术是被禁止的。

english: to drink especially liquor greedily, continually, or habitually
example_en: The kids seem to be guzzling soft drinks all day.
example_zh: 孩子们似乎整天都在猛喝汽水。

english: to set about dealing with
showing innocent or childlike simplicity and candidness
example_en: Only the most ingenuous person would believe such a weak excuse!
example_zh: 只有最天真的人才会相信这么一个站不住脚的借口!

english: to bring together
example_en: He has assembled a team of experts to handle queries.
example_zh: 他召集了一班专家来答疑解惑。

english: to take the job or position of
example_en: These factories have displaced touris m as the country's largest source of for eign exchange.
example_zh: 这些工厂已取代旅游业成为该国最大的外汇来源。

english: a great or foolish amount of pride or confidence
to make confused or upset
example_en: He will be particularly discomfited by th e minister's dismissal of his plan.
example_zh: 部长对他计划的不理会将使他特别尴尬

english: marked by, held in, or conducted with secrecy
example_en: She is the director of clandestine operations of the CIA.
example_zh: 她是中央情报局秘密行动的负责人。

english: a person who refuses to follow the customs or rules of a group
example_en: He was too much of a maverick ever to hold high office.
example_zh: 他太特立独行，永远不可能升职。

english: extremely important and necessary
example_en: Cars have become an indispensable part of our lives.
example_zh: 汽车已成了我们生活中必不可少的一部分。

english: to have an inward
thinking carefully about something

english: to be present in large numbers or in great quantity

example_zh: 为了缓解经济困难，农场主们损失的补贴会得到补偿。

english: a league or compact for mutual support or common action

example_zh: 由于中央政府无力控制逐渐崩溃的经济，所以他们加入了这个新联盟。

english: agreeing with what seems naturally right

english: to transmit to another

example_zh: 他们给灾民提供了援助。

english: growing quickly and in a way that is difficult to control
example_en: Malaria is still rampant in some swampy regions.
example_zh: 疟疾在一些沼泽地区仍很猖獗。

english: to get or win back
example_en: He had realized the mistake he had made and wanted to redeem himself.
example_zh: 他已经认识到了自己的错误，想要进行补救。

english: a minute or minor detail

example_zh: 他们为每个细节煞费苦心。

english: lacking discretion, wisdom, or good judgment
example_en: The Government of Jamaica consider it imprudent to abolish the death penalty.
example_zh: 牙买加政府认为废除死刑是轻率之举。

english: extremely poisonous or venomous

english: to stop from happening or to cause to happen at a later time
example_en: Try to anticipate what your child will do and forestall problems.
example_zh: 尽量预见你的孩子会干什么，并预先阻止问题发生。

english: to cut off or cut back parts of for better shape or more fruitful growth

example_zh: 他把较长的树枝剪掉了。

english: a ranting piece of writing
example_en: The screed tired the audience.
example_zh: 那篇冗长的演说使听众厌烦了。

english: to combine into a composite whole
example_en: The two meanings conflated.
example_zh: 这两个意思混在一起了。

english: to exceed in importance
example_en: Hester is overshadowed by her younger and more attractive sister.
example_zh: 赫斯特被她那更年轻而且更有魅力的妹妹超越了。

english: to divide and share out according to a plan
example_en: They dispensed new clothes to the children in the orphanage.
example_zh: 他们把新衣服发给孤儿院的小孩们。

english: idealizing or idolizing biography

example_zh: 在这本理想化的传记当中，他的成功被夸大了。

english: valuable beyond estimation
magnificence

example_zh: 委内瑞拉是探索南美的宏伟壮观与自然美景的理想出发点。

english: aware of something
example_en: We are cognizant of the problem.
example_zh: 我们意识到了这个问题。

english: not real or genuine
example_en: The scholar produced some bogus documents to support her claim.
example_zh: 该学者提出了一些伪造的文献来支持她的观点。

english: marked by complexity, fullness of detail, or ornateness
example_en: This is an elaborate management training scheme for graduates.
example_zh: 这是一份针对毕业生的详尽的管理培训计划。

english: a line at the beginning of a news story, magazine article, or book giving the writer's name
example_en: Finally, we wish to thank the author of this article which carries no byline.
example_zh: 最后，我们要感谢这篇文章的那位没有署名的作者。

english: a prolonged lamentation or complaint

example_zh: 西格尔的书是一本哀史，它反对祸害，反对网络，这些已经逗留在我们生命中的东西。

english: belonging to the essential nature of a thing
example_en: Diamonds have little intrinsic value and their price depends almost entirely on their scarcity.
example_zh: 钻石没有多少本质价值，它们的价格几乎完全取决于其稀有程度。

english: subsequent development
example_en: The police said the clash was a sequel to yesterday's nationwide strike.
example_zh: 警方说这场冲突是昨天全国大罢工的余波。

english: yielding abundantly

example_zh: 那时我们家门口有两棵枝广叶茂的大橡树。

english: of or relating to art or beauty
example_en: Their furniture was more aesthetic than practical.
example_zh: 他们的家具华而不实。

english: exuding fragrance
example_en: Their own yard is redolent with lilacs.
example_zh: 他们家自己的院子里散发着丁香花的芬芳。

written in or consisting of elegiac couplets

english: someone or something that has the same job or purpose as another

example_zh: 乐观情绪逐渐取代了悲观主义。

english: a measure around a body
exaggerated or disposed to exaggerate one’s own worth or importance often by an overbearing manner

example_zh: 他说新闻媒体把他歪曲成了一个傲慢而又霸道的人。

english: to give joy to
example_en: When the war ended, people finally had cause to rejoice.
example_zh: 战争结束，人们终于可以欢欣鼓舞了。

english: to come together to form a group
example_en: The passengers clustered together in small groups.
example_zh: 乘客们三五成群聚在一起。

english: to hide or disguise
example_en: She cloaked her embarrassment by rushing into speech.
example_zh: 她急忙开口说话，以掩饰自己的尴尬。

english: prevalent especially to an increasing degree
example_en: Bribery and corruption were rife in the industry.
example_zh: 在这个行业中，贿赂和腐败现象猖獗。

english: devoted to or biased in support of a party, group, or cause
example_en: The audience was very partisan, and refused to listen to the points she was making in her speech.
example_zh: 观众们很有偏见, 拒绝聆听她发言中的要点。

english: of, relating to, involving, or forming a periphery or surface part
example_en: Among high-income economies, those with most slack are those in the peripheral eurozone.
example_zh: 在高收入经济体中，拥有最多闲置资源的是那些处于欧元区外围的经济体。

english: beginning to exist

example_zh: 我们经理发现了一个新人才。

english: open to view

english: to cause to be at a loss as to what to say, think, or do

example_zh: 那位教授从未感到困惑，也没有被任何问题所难倒。

english: not able to be proved wrong
example_en: The pictures provide irrefutable evidence of the incident.
example_zh: 这些图片为该事件提供了无法反驳的证据。

example_zh: 在他的演讲中，他援引了来自许多当代牧师的劝诫格言。

english: expressing a strong opinion

english: feeling or showing anger because of something unjust or unworthy

example_zh: 他们因没有受到邀请而愤愤不平。

english: something that came before something else and may have influenced or caused it

example_zh: 先前的法律是允许被考虑进来的。

example_zh: 这一结果将不可避免地加剧人们对首相未来的揣测。

english: to thrust oneself in without invitation, permission, or welcome

example_zh: 新闻媒体因以一种令人无法接受的方式侵入人们的私生活而受到谴责。

english: a person who says something will not work or is not possible

example_zh: 一位反对者指出，这些运动员只不过是从巅峰状态回复到了平均水平。

english: dealing with the problems that exist in a specific situation in a reasonable and logical way instead of depending on ideas and theories

english: subject to erratic behavior or unpredictable change

example_zh: 没有理由轻视这场灾难的严重性。

english: fit to be eaten

example_zh: 相比之下，食草动物的肉更易食用，闻起来更美味。

english: a charitable act or gift

english: very unusual in a way that does not seem natural

english: distasteful, unpalatable

english: very small in amount or number
egoism, egocentrism

example_zh: 被自恋症折磨的人会变得只专注于自己的事情，或者不断地自我炫耀。

english: to praise

example_zh: 我们赞美像史蒂夫•乔布斯那样的人，他创造出了差异化的革命性产品。

english: to treat in a harsh or harmful way

english: not capable of being solved

english: given to or abounding in excessive moralizing

english: to bring into a condition of decay or partial ruin

example_zh: 弗雷迪·摩克瑞是英国硬摇滚乐界一颗耀眼的明星。

english: having a large estate or property

example_zh: 大部分现金都花在了维系他挥金如土的生活方式上。

english: having a rough quality

example_zh: 那位年轻的母亲让她的儿子躺到床上，用一条粗糙的毛巾给他擦干了全身。

english: remaining after a process, event etc is finished

example_zh: 电脑程序还有一些残留问题。

english: to adjust precisely for a particular function

english: radiant splendor

english: to suffer agony, torture or anguish
example_en: If you agonize over getting the perfect answer, you won't get very far.
example_zh: 如果你为求得完美的答案而苦恼不堪，那你不会有多大的成就。

english: shared in common

english: having strong moral principles

example_zh: 这样的行为与她情操高尚的原则是格格不入的。

example_zh: 他的水彩设计使许多图书大为生色。

english: happening or beginning now or in recent times

example_zh: 莎士比亚与狄更斯不是同时代的人。

english: being less dense

example_zh: 动物和人在稀薄的空气中都大口喘着气

example_zh: 商业贿赂的直接目的是促成交易，即推销商品或者购买商品。

english: to conceal or disguise

example_zh: 士兵用树叶来伪装自己。

english: filled with or expressing great joy or triumph

example_zh: 欢欣的人群在大街上跳起了舞。

english: a eulogistic oration or writing
example_en: He made a speech of panegyric.
example_zh: 他作了一个颂扬性的演讲。

english: a deceptive device or stratagem
example_en: The party has predictably rejected the proposals as a subterfuge.
example_zh: 不出所料，该党以这些提议是在耍花招为由而加以拒绝。

english: offering or expressing a choice
example_en: We are currently investigating a number of alternative options.
example_zh: 我们现在正在研究一系列可供替代的选择方案。

english: a group of people who develop new and often very surprising ideas in art, literature, etc.
example_en: It was one of the first avant-garde works to appeal to a wide audience.
example_zh: 这是受到听众广泛欢迎的第一批先锋派作品之一。

english: if someone is obsessed with a person or thing, they keep thinking about them and find it difficult to think about anything else

example_zh: 她并没有爱上史蒂夫，只是被他的外表迷住了。

english: great or imposing in size or extent
meriting condemnation or blame especially as wrong or harmful

example_zh: 他们认为他有罪应受惩罚。

english: to restrain from motion, action, or progress

example_zh: 我们尊敬传统,但不愿被它束缚。

example_zh: 他为穷人提供暂时的安身之处。

example_zh: 在大规模生产的时代，跨国公司往往实行集权化经营。

low in spirits

example_zh: 所有的灯都熄灭了，大家都变得歇斯底里起来。

example_zh: 这部电影比较像是讽刺的幻想故事，而不是恐怖片。

example_zh: 这个地区有许多南北战争以前的房屋.

english: filled, covered, or completely overrun as if by a flood

example_zh: 这毕竟是一家现金充裕的公司。

english: to extend or expand beyond a safe or reasonable point
example_en: They should not overextend themselves on the mortgage.
example_zh: 他们不应该用抵押借款过多。

english: a person who rules with total power

example_zh: 独裁者希望他的国民都是自动调节器，像智能机器人。

english: distress or suffering resulting from oppression or persecution

english: to prove or show to be just, right, or reasonable
example_en: He tried to justify his absence with lame excuses.
example_zh: 他想用站不住脚的借口为自己的缺席辩解。

english: to make an exact copy of in order to trick people
example_en: The man was arrested for having chea ted people with counterfeit notes.
example_zh: 那个人曾用伪钞行骗而被捕过。

english: the origin or source of something
example_en: They try to understand the whole universe, its provenance and fate.
example_zh: 他们试图认识整个宇宙，其起源及命运

english: a disadvantage that makes achievement unusually difficult
example_en: Not speaking the language proved to be a bigger handicap than I'd imagined.
example_zh: 事实证明不会讲这种语言造成的障碍比我所想象的大。

english: having a coarse uneven surface that is rough or unpleasant to the touch
example_en: The harsh truth is that luck plays a big part in who will live or die.
example_zh: 残酷的事实是，谁死谁活在很大程度上要靠运气。

english: to limit or restrict
example_en: Criticism tends to undermine and cons train the artist's creativity.
example_zh: 批评家总是削弱和限制艺术家的创造力

english: kind and friendly
to suppress or extinguish summarily and completely
example_en: The rumours were quickly quashed.
example_zh: 流言很快被制止了。

english: obstinately defiant of authority or restraint
example_en: The university suspended the most recalcitrant demonstrators.
example_zh: 该大学对最为桀骜不驯的学生做了暂令停学的处理。

english: something by which one is entangled, involved in difficulties, or impeded
example_en: Given data which are free from bias there are further snares to avoid in statistical work.
example_zh: 即使数据本身不存在偏差在统计工作中仍需要避免其他陷阱。

english: the practice of not doing or having something that is wanted or enjoyable
example_en: The meaning of life was freedom and the abstinence from evil.
example_zh: 生命的真谛是自由和避免作恶。

english: cheerful, optimistic
example_en: The Defense Secretary gave an upbeat assessment of the war so far.
example_zh: 国防部长对迄今为止的战事进行了乐观的评价。

english: by surprise
example_en: Cross was a little taken aback by her abrupt manner.
example_zh: 她鲁莽的态度让克罗斯感到有点吃惊。

english: to empty of a principal substance
example_en: They fired in long bursts, which deplet ed their ammunition.
example_zh: 他们长时间开火，耗尽了弹药。

english: an exclusive or special right, power, or privilege
chinese: 修改宪法是议会独有的权力。
example_en: Constitutional changes are exclusively the prerogative of the parliament.
example_zh: 修改宪法是议会独有的权力。

english: not mixed with something else
example_en: After the steepest decline since the Great Depression, unalloyed optimism among veteran stock market hands is hard to find.
example_zh: 股市发生了大萧条以来最大跌幅之后，资深股市老手中是很难找到纯粹的乐观情绪的。

english: a feeling of like or dislike for someone or something especially when it is not reasonable or logical
example_en: There was a deep-rooted racial prejudice long before the two countries went to war.
example_zh: 早在两国交战之前就有了根深蒂固的种族偏见。

english: a family tree
example_en: Stemma is a scroll recording the genealogy of a family and the stories of key members.
example_zh: 家谱即记载本族世系、重要人物事迹的书。

english: to soil, stain, corrupt, or infect by contact or association
example_en: Aflatoxins are carcinogenic fungal toxins that can contaminate corn, peanuts and other food crops such as tree nuts under certain conditions.
example_zh: 黄曲霉毒素是致癌的真菌毒素，可在某些条件下污染玉米、花生及其他粮食作物，如树坚果。

english: a lack of knowledge, understanding, or education
the state of being very annoyed or upset
example_en: She rolled her eyes in sheer exasperation.
example_zh: 她气急败坏地转动着眼珠。

english: one that occupies a particular position or place
example_en: He defeated the incumbent governor by a large plurality.
example_zh: 他以压倒多数票击败了现任州长。

english: having wide or considerable extent
example_en: Extensive research has been done into this disease.
example_zh: 对这种疾病已进行了广泛研究。

english: musingly or dreamily thoughtful
example_en: Angela stared pensively out of the window.
example_zh: 安杰拉忧郁地望着窗外。

english: to cause or force to leave a position of power, a competition, etc.
example_en: In this African country, the rebels finally managed to oust the government from power.
example_zh: 在这个非洲国家，反叛者最后总算推翻了政府。

english: having or showing qualities that are considered good in business
example_en: This activity was carried on in a businesslike manner.
example_zh: 这个活动开展的效率很高。

english: feeling or showing regret for bad behavior
example_en: She assumed a contrite expression.
example_zh: 她装出一副后悔的表情。

english: to become dry and sapless
example_en: As the leaves of autumn wither and fall, so has my own life become barren.
example_zh: 我的生命就如秋叶般枯萎凋零。

english: emphasizing that it is better or greater than anything else of its kind
example_en: In another literary form, poetry, the Bible is unsurpassed.
example_zh: 在另一种文学形式即诗歌方面来看, 《圣经》是无与伦比的。

english: unknown
example_en: It marks a largely uncharted area of medical science.
example_zh: 这标志着医学中一个几乎全新的领域。

english: to think of (something that will or might happen in the future)
example_en: At the time we couldn't have anticipated the result of our campaigning.
example_zh: 那时我们不可能预料到我们这项运动的结果。

english: great technical skill (as in the practice of a fine art)
example_en: At that time, his virtuosity on the trumpet had no parallel in jazz.
example_zh: 那时，他高超的小号吹奏技巧在爵士乐界无人能比。

english: to forgive or approve
example_en: Terrorism can never be condoned.
example_zh: 决不能容忍恐怖主义。

english: to take away the peace or tranquility of
of doubtful authenticity
example_en: This may well be an apocryphal story.
example_zh: 这很可能是个杜撰的故事。

english: to control the course of
example_en: He managed to steer the conversation away from his divorce.
example_zh: 他设法把话题从他离婚一事上引开。

english: to set in motion
example_en: There was one teacher who really ignited my interest in words
example_zh: 曾经有一位老师真正激起了我对文字的兴趣。

english: to dig up out of or as if out of the earth
example_en: Other financial scandals are out there waiting to be unearthed.
example_zh: 其他金融丑闻正有待于被揭发。

english: causing unhappiness or sad feelings
example_en: It is a dreary little town where few woul d choose to linger.
example_zh: 这是个沉闷的小镇，没几个人会愿意在此流连。

english: very attractive or pleasing in a way that holds your attention
example_en: Many people were attracted by her engaging smile.
example_zh: 许多人被她迷人的微笑所吸引。

english: the spirit and enthusiasm animating artistic composition or performance
example_en: She reveled in big MGM musicals with their colour and verve.
example_zh: 她酷爱米高梅电影公司制作的色彩绚丽、激情四溢的大型歌舞片。

english: marked by assurance and self-control
example_en: Donald Duck-the irascible but unflappable waterfowl-prepared to be feted in grand fashion,as he turned 75 years old Tuesday.
example_zh: 本周是唐老鸭的75岁生日，这位脾气暴躁却镇定自若的鸭先生将迎来盛大的生日庆典。

english: an amount that is too much or more than you need
example_en: Rationing had put an end to a surfeit of biscuits long ago.
example_zh: 定量供应很久以前就结束了饼干过剩的状况。

english: not original
example_en: One heart expert thinks this study provides further evidence of the dangers of secondhand smoke.
example_zh: 一位心脏专家认为这一研究提供了间接吸烟危险性的进一步证据。

english: to charge with a fault or offense
marked by firm determination
example_en: He described the situation as very dangerous and called for resolute action.
example_zh: 他将形势描述得非常危险，并号召采取果断行动。

english: to throw in between or among other things
example_en: He listened thoughtfully, interjecting only the odd word.
example_zh: 他细心地聆听，只插了几句话。

english: an artist, performer, or player of consummate skill
example_en: She was a master of the English language.
example_zh: 她是英文高手。

english: clearly expressed or understood
example_en: The close-up photography and commentary are clear and unambiguous.
example_zh: 那组特写照片和附带的评论一目了然，毫无含糊之处。

english: complete and total
example_en: To my utter amazement she agreed.
example_zh: 令我大感意外的是，她同意了。

english: marked by transparency
done with or showing artistic skill
example_en: There is also an artful contrast of shapes.
example_zh: 形状的对比也很巧妙。

english: to ruin or diminish the perfection or wholeness of
easily led or influenced
example_en: Steel in this class is tough, ductile and easily machined.
example_zh: 这种钢强韧, 延展性好,而且容易加工。

english: to suffer violent internal excitement

example_zh: 我怒火中烧，她却嘲弄地咧着嘴笑。

english: to understand
example_en: Whenever she failed to comprehend s he invariably laughed.
example_zh: 每当她听不懂的时候，她总是会笑。

english: extremely silly, foolish, or unreasonable
example_en: It's patently absurd not to wear a coat in such cold weather.
example_zh: 这么冷的天气不穿外衣，显然很荒唐。

english: very small
example_en: There has been a minute improvement in the working conditions of the factory.
example_zh: 工厂的工作情形已有微小的改善。

english: unusual or surprising: likely to be noticed
example_en: There was a remarkable resemblance between him and Pete.
example_zh: 他和皮特之间有着惊人的相似之处。

english: open to attack or damage
example_en: Lacking self-confidence and maturity, many teenagers are left feeling very vulnerable.
example_zh: 许多十几岁的孩子既缺乏自信又不够懂事，所以感情上十分脆弱。

english: a viewpoint that traditional values and beliefs are unfounded and that existence is senseless and useless
example_en: Her latest play is a nihilistic vision of the world of the future.
example_zh: 她最近出的这个剧本对未来世界作了虚无主义的诠释。

english: a mixture of different things
example_en: Peter Baker's bathroom is a brilliant pastiche of expensive interior design.
example_zh: 彼得·贝克的浴室是高档室内设计的集大成之作。

english: a sudden invasion or attack
example_en: The English incursion was doomed from the outset.
example_zh: 从一开始，英格兰人的入侵就注定了失败。

english: to cease marching or journeying
example_en: They halted at a short distance from the house.
example_zh: 他们在离房子不远处停了下来。

english: taking up the attention completely
example_en: He told us an engrossing story.
example_zh: 他给我们讲了一个引人入胜的故事。

english: to change direction or course
example_en: The plane veered off the runway and crashed through the perimeter fence.
example_zh: 这架飞机突然偏离了跑道并且冲断了周边的护栏。

english: enormously or inconceivably large or great
example_en: Astronomical sums of money will be needed for this river tunnel plan.
example_zh: 这条过江隧道的计划需要极大的一笔钱

english: inquisitive in an annoying, officious, or meddlesome way
example_en: Imelda might think she was prying.
example_zh: 艾美达可能认为她在刺探别人的隐私。

english: feeling or showing deep hatred or disapproval
example_en: She cast a contemptuous glance at hi m.
example_zh: 她用轻蔑的目光扫了他一眼。

english: having or showing a generous and kind nature
very harsh or severe

example_zh: 他这人说起话来老这么尖酸刻薄。

english: including or involving many things
example_en: The new government has promised sweeping reforms.
example_zh: 新政府承诺进行彻底的改革。

english: lack of vitality
example_en: Victims of this disease suffer from a severe and usually fatal anemia.
example_zh: 这种疾病的患者常患严重的,往往是致命性的贫血症。

english: having a bad smell
example_en: Presently, most of the ground water in China gradually tend to be malodorous black river due to the deteriorating pollution.
example_zh: 目前我国大部分城市地表水由于污染日趋严重已经演变成黑臭水体。

english: to ask in a serious and emotional way

example_zh: 弗·史蒂文恳求他们晚点走。

english: very flowery in style
example_en: Her usually florid complexion seemed drained of colour.
example_zh: 她通常红润的脸色看上去没有了血色

english: to give new life or vigor to
example_en: This hair conditioner is excellent for revitalizing dry, lifeless hair.
example_zh: 这种护发素能够非常有效地修复干枯的头发。

english: having little or no importance or significance
example_en: You know, this may sound petty to you.
example_zh: 你知道，这听起来对你是不重要的。

english: a product of disintegration, destruction, or wearing away
a skill or instinctive ability to appreciate or make good use of something
example_en: Helen Keller has a flair for languages.
example_zh: 海伦·凯勒有语言的天赋。

english: to put or keep apart
example_en: The two countries have severed all diplomatic links.
example_zh: 两国断绝了一切外交关系。

english: difficult to understand
very clear and easy to understand

example_zh: 他的解释扼要易懂。

english: showing great care, attention and effort
example_en: My grandpa has been assiduous in learning foreign language.
example_zh: 爷爷一直很努力地学习外语。

english: to avoid or escape by being quick, skillful, or clever

example_zh: 马教授提出了一个他们理解不了的隐喻

english: to give spiritual insight to

example_zh: 从小路向谷底望去令人眩晕。

english: unduly adhering to one’s own opinion or to preconceived notions
example_en: He is too opinionated to listen to anyone else.
example_zh: 他太固执己见，听不进别人的意见。

english: characterized by great liberality or generosity
example_en: He is one of the country's most munificent artistic benefactors.
example_zh: 他是这个国家最慷慨的艺术资助人之一

english: to abolish by authoritative action

example_zh: 下一任首相可能会废除这个条约。

english: something (such as a state of affairs) that alternates between opposites
example_en: The pendulum has swung back and the American car companies have made dramatic advances in safety.
example_zh: 三十年河东，三十年河西，美国汽车公司在安全方面已经取得了巨大进步。

english: not ostentatious
example_en: It's classic Amazon: unostentatious, and no company signs on any of the buildings.
example_zh: 这就是经典的亚马逊：朴素而不声张，在楼上没有任何公司的标识。

english: being not original and having been used many times before in similar situations
example_en: His paintings are contrived and formulaic.
example_zh: 他的绘画作品做作而又俗套。

english: a sensation of motion in which the individual or the individual's surroundings seem to whirl dizzily
example_en: If you have vertigo it seems as if the whole room is spinning round you.
example_zh: 如果你头晕，就会觉得整个房间都旋转起来。

english: remaining the same, and not likely to change

example_zh: 他决定和爱人一起过一种更加安定的生活。

english: the respect and admiration that someone or something gets for being successful or important
chinese: 是他在外交事务中的尽职尽责为他赢得

example_zh: 是他在外交事务中的尽职尽责为他赢得了国际声望。

english: to adapt to a new purpose or need

example_zh: 这项业务主要是改造更新现有的飞机。

english: pointless or useless
example_en: It is always futile to try to hold back the progress of history.
example_zh: 要想阻止历史潮流是徒劳的。

english: to cause to lose its value or to have no effect
to have a pleasant tune
example_en: She spoke in a quietly melodious voice.
example_zh: 她说话轻声细语，嗓音甜美。

english: expressing a lot of emotion
example_en: He was effusive in his praise for the ge neral.
example_zh: 他对那位将军极尽溢美之词。

english: elegant or graceful in manner, appearance, or shape
example_en: There are not as many genteel young men in Devonshire as Sussex.
example_zh: 与苏塞克斯相比，德文郡有教养的年轻人不多。

english: of, relating to, or resulting from the influence of human beings on nature
example_en: Since the influences of industrial and anthropogenic activities, the content of atmospheric aerosols increased obviously.
example_zh: 由于工业和人类活动的影响，大气中气溶胶含量明显增加。

english: a coming or flowing together, meeting, or gathering at one point
example_en: The 160-metre falls mark the dramatic confluence of the rivers Nera and Velino.
example_zh: 内拉河和韦利诺河的汇合处是落差达160米的瀑布，景象十分壮观。

english: noisily insistent
to continue to do something or to try to do something even though it is difficult or other people want you to stop
example_en: When I set my mind to something, I persist.
example_zh: 一旦我对某事拿定主意，我就会坚持到底。

english: marked by or suggestive of a state of sleep or lethargy
example_en: Lord Henry turned and looked at the duchess with his slumberous eyes.
example_zh: 亨利勋爵转过头来，用昏昏欲睡的眼睛望着公爵夫人。

english: readily understood
example_en: The company has to make its accounts and operations as transparent as possible.
example_zh: 公司必须使其账目与运作尽可能地清晰透明。

english: banish, exile
example_en: She was expatriated for some political reason.
example_zh: 她因某种政治原因而被流放国外。

english: the payment of damages
example_en: There is a clear demand amongst victims for some sort of reparation from offenders.
example_zh: 受害者明确要求责任人给予一定的赔偿

english: to deprive of something
example_en: The recent outbreak of hepatitis bereaved the happy family of three members.
example_zh: 最近暴发的肝炎使这个幸福的家庭丧失了三条性命。

english: to crumble into particles

example_zh: 她奶奶的围巾已经在箱子里腐烂了。

english: having or showing a lack of hope for the future
example_en: Not everyone is so pessimistic about the future.
example_zh: 不是每个人都对未来如此悲观。

english: to officially force to leave a place or organization
example_en: An American academic was expelled fr om the country yesterday.
example_zh: 昨天一位美国学者被逐出该国。

english: to cleanse of something morally harmful, offensive, or erroneous
clearly true and requiring no proof or explanation
example_en: This point is self-evident and needs no elaboration.
example_zh: 含义自明，无须多说。

english: to examine or consider with attention and in detail
example_en: If you peruse the software industry, you'll find hundreds of commercial plug-ins and products for Eclipse.
example_zh: 如果你仔细的研究软件业，你会发现成百上千的Eclipse的商用插件和产品。

english: bypass, evade
example_en: He was trying to sidestep responsibility.
example_zh: 他正试图回避责任。

english: a person who belongs to the same age group or social group as someone else
example_en: His engaging personality made him popular with his peers.
example_zh: 他迷人的个性使他深受同龄人的喜爱。

english: to say that you accept or do not deny the truth or existence of
example_en: The organizers of the demonstration c oncede that they hadn't sought permis sion for it.
example_zh: 游行示威的组织者承认他们并未申请批准这次活动。

english: a person who has very strong feelings about something and who wants other people to have those feelings
to show or promise something that someone really wants, but then not allow them to have it
example_en: The tantalizing aroma of fresh coffee wafted towards them.
example_zh: 新鲜咖啡那诱人的香味向他们飘来。

english: cheap and gaudy in appearance or quality
example_en: These two colours look tawdry when put together.
example_zh: 这两种颜色配起来显得很俗丽。

english: laborious or intensive study
example_en: In order to meet the need of our country railroad's development, lucubration of tunnel aerodynamic effect's spread abroad rules and corresponding alleviation measure is very necessary.
example_zh: 为了适应我国铁路发展的需要，有必要对隧道空气动力学效应的规律及其减缓措施进行深入研究。

english: doing something involves the use of logical reasoning
example_en: Programming is for analytical mind.
example_zh: 编程适合善于分析的人。

english: limited in character or scope

example_zh: 警方说这是一起派系谋杀。

english: trap, snare

example_zh: 到国外工作存在许多陷阱。

english: to excite or arouse especially by a provocation, challenge, or rebuff
example_en: This phenomenon piqued Dr Morris' interest.
example_zh: 这一现象激起了莫里斯医生的兴趣。

english: someone or something that is very exaggerated in a funny or foolish way
example_en: He had unfairly presented a caricature of my views.
example_zh: 他歪曲了我的观点。

english: staying strong and in good condition over a long period of time
example_en: He bought himself a pair of durable trousers.
example_zh: 他给自己买了一条耐穿的裤子。

english: highly objectionable
example_en: Governments around the world will strongly criticize the villainous crimes of the terrorists.
example_zh: 世界各国政府都会强烈指责恐怖分子的罪恶行为。

english: pulsating with life, vigor, or activity

example_zh: 充满生气的蓝色与黄色和红色形成了很好的反差，使整个场景栩栩如生。

english: to think of as coming from a specified cause, source or author
example_en: The actor ascribed his success to the support of his family.
example_zh: 这位演员将他的成功归功于家人的支持

english: to cause to feel happy or confident

example_zh: 竞选获胜，该党情绪一片高涨。

example_zh: 科学家们昨天宣布已经解开了宇宙诞生之谜。

english: conform, adhere
example_en: Every student must hew to the rules and regulations of the college.
example_zh: 每个学生都要遵守学校的规章制度。

english: to excite and often trouble the mind or feelings of
example_en: They sent agents to agitate the local people.
example_zh: 他们派遣情报人员煽动当地的民众

english: having or showing great knowledge or understanding
example_en: Liu Jun is a famous parallel prose writer of Liang dynasty, is a knowledge profound scholar.
example_zh: 刘峻是梁代著名的骈文家，更是一位知识渊博的学者。

english: presaging ill fortune or trouble
example_en: The air of desertion lenDS the place a sinister aspect.
example_zh: 荒芜的景象给这个地方蒙上了一种不祥的色彩。

english: to penetrate and come to understand
example_en: It is hard to fathom the pain felt at the death of a child.
example_zh: 丧子之痛是难以体会的。

english: having the power of forcing someone to do something
example_en: Public secondary and university educa tion is also free but is not compulsory.
example_zh: 公立高中和大学教育也实行免费教育，但不是强制性的.

english: the state of being old or the process of becoming old
example_en: It affects tuberization, leaf senescence, and dormancy.
example_zh: 它影响块茎形成、叶子衰老和休眠。

english: to separate or set apart from others or from the general mass
example_en: Police segregated the two rival camps of protesters.
example_zh: 警察把两个敌对阵营的抗议人群隔离开来。

english: to cause to stop burning
example_en: The message extinguished her hopes of Richard's return.
example_zh: 那条消息使她对理查德归来的希望彻底破灭。

english: to cut with something sharp
example_en: Trim the shrubs with shears.
example_zh: 用大剪刀修剪灌木丛。

english: showing people and things in a way that resembles how they really look
example_en: The word here is used in its figurative sense.
example_zh: 此词在这儿取的是它的比喻意义。

english: very lively, happy, or energetic
example_en: She gave an exuberant performance.
example_zh: 她的表演热情洋溢。

english: marked by an overbearingly dignified or assured manner or aspect
example_en: The Cambridge World History of Human Disease is a magisterial work.
example_zh: 《剑桥世界人类疾病史》是一部权威著作。

english: appealing to the emotions: sensational
example_en: She wanted to laugh at the melodramatic way he was acting.
example_zh: 他戏剧化的夸张架势使她忍不住想笑。

english: not feeling or showing emotions such as affection or kindness
example_en: She's hard-boiled, tough and funny.
example_zh: 她冷峻、坚韧而风趣。

english: to ask for something in a serious way
example_en: The United Nations has appealed for help from the international community.
example_zh: 联合国已经呼吁国际社会提供援助。

english: having great magnitude, force, or power
example_en: The earth buckled under the titanic stress.
example_zh: 在巨大的压力下，地面下陷了。

english: a small amount
example_en: They should win, given a modicum of luck.
example_zh: 只要有一点点运气，他们就会赢。

english: lasting for only a short time
example_en: Each moment in history is a fleeting ti me, precious and unique.
example_zh: 历史上的每一刻都是飞逝的时光，珍贵而独特。

english: strength or force gained by motion or by a series of events
example_en: They began to lose momentum in the second half of the game.
example_zh: 在比赛的下半场，他们的势头就逐渐减弱。

english: to weaken or destroy gradually
example_en: Engineers found the structure had bee n corroded by moisture.
example_zh: 工程师们发现该建筑已经受潮腐蚀。

english: to reverse in position, order, or relationship
example_en: The cook inverted the cake onto a serving plate.
example_zh: 厨师把蛋糕倒扣过来放到一个盘子上。

english: serious, boring, or old- fashioned
example_en: Her thoughts were staid and solemnly adapted to a condition.
example_zh: 她的思想已经定形,安于一板一眼地顺应现实.

english: amazement or dismay that hinders or throws into confusion
example_en: As the ball hurtles through the air, the varying air flow around it can send it on unexpected paths, to the consternation of many soccer players.
example_zh: 当球在空中疾驰时，球表面变化多样的气流可以将它送往意料之外的路径，让许多足球运动员惊愕不已。

english: coming before and usually forming a necessary prelude to something else
example_en: Bombus fauna of this Province.
example_zh: 另外，作者对该地区的熊蜂区系成分进行了初步的分析。

english: having worldwide rather than limited or provincial scope or bearing
example_en: The family are rich, and extremely sop histicated and cosmopolitan.
example_zh: 这家人很富有，老于世故，而且见多识广。

english: fit for or used for the growing of crops
example_en: The soil proved too infertile to sustain real pasture or arable crops.
example_zh: 这土壤被证明太贫瘠，不能真正用作放牧或耕种作物。

english: an overwrought expression of concern or guilt
example_en: There's also been much hand-wringing over ballooning mortgage debt.
example_zh: 不断膨胀的抵押贷款债务也令人坐立不安.

english: a feeling of doubt or suspicion especially concerning a future event
example_en: She had some misgivings about what she was about to do.
example_zh: 她对自己要做的事有些疑虑。

english: to cause to happen quickly or suddenly
to give support or encouragement to
example_en: Bryan Sutton seconded the motion against fox hunting.
example_zh: 布赖恩·萨顿赞同反对猎狐动议。

english: an outward sign
example_en: Only occasionally did the telltale redness around his eyes betray the fatigue he was suffering.
example_zh: 只有从他发红的眼圈上偶尔能看出他非常疲惫。

english: a source of danger
extremely good
something that is very special, important, or valuable
example_en: She treasures her memories of those joyous days.
example_zh: 她珍视那段快乐时光的记忆。

english: to close up or block off
chinese: 止血带应阻断静脉及淋巴回流
example_en: The tourniquet should occlude venous and lymphatic return.
example_zh: 止血带应阻断静脉及淋巴回流.

english: to establish by proof or competent evidence
example_en: There is little scientific evidence to substantiate the claims.
example_zh: 这些主张几乎找不到科学依据来证实。

english: not decreasing or becoming weaker
example_en: His unflagging enthusiasm was an inspiration for all of us.
example_zh: 他经久不衰的热情鼓舞了我们所有人。

english: made to be useful rather than to be decorative or comfortable
example_en: This basic utilitarian model gives a relatively unsophisticated account of human behavior.
example_zh: 这个实用的基础模型较为简略地解释了人类的行为。

english: the quality or state of being faithful
example_en: He believed in marital fidelity.
example_zh: 他认为婚内应该忠诚。

english: willing to do dishonest things in return for money
of the same mind or habit of thought
example_en: Some like-minded people got together and set up a group.
example_zh: 一些志趣相投的人聚在一起，成立了一个小组。

english: a feigning to be what one is not or to believe what one does not
example_en: He called it 'rank hypocrisy' that the government was now promoting equal rights.
example_zh: 他把目前政府提倡平等权利的举措称为“彻头彻尾的伪善”。

english: to overwhelm with shock, surprise, or wonder
example_en: He is flabbergast when he hears that his friend has been accused of murder.
example_zh: 他听说朋友被控谋杀罪，大吃一惊。

english: a general agreement about something
example_en: There seems to be a consensus that the plan should be rejected.
example_zh: 看来人们一致同意放弃这一计划。

english: in good health
the quality or state of being accurate and correct
example_en: They cannot determine their optimum price and output with neat exactitude.
example_zh: 他们不能精确无误地知道最优价格和产量。

english: one inclined to raise or excite alarms especially needlessly
example_en: The senator is just a scaremonger, his political act won't realistically result in changed behavior.
example_zh: 这名议员仅仅是个危言耸听者，他的政治举措并不能解决实际问题。

english: to reach its highest altitude
example_en: In just a few days, a century- long struggle will culminate in a historic vote.
example_zh: 几天之后，在历史性的投票中，长达一个世纪的努力即将达到高潮

english: basic or simple
example_en: They are deprived of the ability to exercise the most rudimentary workers' rights.
example_zh: 他们被剥夺了行使最基本的工人权利的资格。

english: arranged or organized in a logical or regular way
example_en: The officers and crew prepared to abandon ship in an orderly fashion.
example_zh: 全体船员秩序井然地准备弃船。

english: to weaken or destroy the effect of
example_en: An official decree invalidated the vote in the capital.
example_zh: 一项官方法令使首都的投票失去了效力

english: to draw back or in
example_en: They tried to persuade me to retract my words.
example_zh: 他们试图说服我收回我的话。

english: affording a general view of a whole
example_en: There are many vortex patterns on synoptic maps.
example_zh: 摘要天气图上有许多种涡旋型式。

english: willing to believe that other people are good and honest
example_en: Perhaps I was too trusting.
example_zh: 也许我太轻信了。

english: to reach above or beyond
example_en: In making these promises, the company had clearly overreached itself.
example_zh: 这家公司作出这些承诺，显然是不自量力。

english: to frustrate the progress or efforts of
example_en: John is stumped by an unexpected question.
example_zh: 一个意想不到的问题把约翰难住了。

english: loyalty to a person, group, etc.
example_en: They owed fealty to the Earl rather than the King.
example_zh: 与其说他们应效忠国王，还不如说他们该效忠伯爵。

english: to check or go counter to
example_en: Austria has sent three army battalions to its border with Hungary to stem the flow of illegal immigrants.
example_zh: 奥地利已派出 3 个营的兵力去本国和匈牙利交界的边境地区阻止非法移民的流入。

english: to impede or stop the development of
example_en: The governor's proposals would actually cost millions of jobs and suffocate the economy.
example_zh: 总督的计划可能会造成上百万人失业，并抑制经济发展。

english: something that is joined or added to another thing but is not an essential part of it
example_en: The Party was certainly not an official adjunct of the police department.
example_zh: 该党派肯定不是公安部门的官方附属机构。

english: having the characteristics of a platitude
example_en: The whole speech was platitudinous nonsense.
example_zh: 整篇讲话都是陈谷子烂芝麻。

english: cruel, savage
example_en: Custer was an idiot and a brute and he deserved his fate.
example_zh: 卡斯特是个愚蠢而粗暴的人，他应该有这样的下场。

english: big and very impressive
example_en: This grand building lies in the center of town.
example_zh: 这幢宏伟建筑位于市中心。

english: not having or providing enough of what is needed
example_en: He decided there was insufficient evidence to justify criminal proceedings...
example_zh: 他认定证据不充分无法提起刑事诉讼。

english: not confined, limited, or impeded
example_en: When his schoolmate made the last goal, the boy gave out with an untrammeled yell.
example_zh: 那个男孩在他的同学踢进最后一球时不禁纵声欢呼。

english: a loss of power, success, popularity, etc.
example_en: The gramophone had been eclipsed by new technology such as the compact disc.
example_zh: 激光唱片等新技术使留声机黯然失色。

english: to disturb the quiet of
example_en: Remove the bowl from the ice and stir in the cream.
example_zh: 从冰里把碗取出，搅入奶油。

english: not wanting or willing to do something
example_en: He was loath to admit his mistake.
example_zh: 他不愿承认自己的错误。

english: lacking proper respect or seriousness
example_en: He now dismisses that as a flippant co mment.
example_zh: 他现在把那当作轻率的随口一说不再理会了。

english: freedom of action or choice
example_en: Generally, courts give local administrators great latitude.
example_zh: 总体上，法庭还是给了当地管理者以较大的自由。

english: similar in some way
example_en: The relationship of a teacher and his students is analogous to that of a director and the actors.
example_zh: 老师和学生之间的关系就像导演和演员之间的关系。

english: impossible to see or notice
example_en: The slight change in the taste was imperceptible to most people.
example_zh: 这种味道的细微变化对大多数人而言是无法觉察的。

english: to breathe out
example_en: She exhaled the smoke through her nose.
example_zh: 她从鼻子里喷出烟雾。

english: a comment or remark
example_en: In hospital she'll be under observation all the time.
example_zh: 医院会对她24小时密切观察。

english: of, relating to, or resembling a labyrinth
example_en: The streets of the Old City are narrow and labyrinthine.
example_zh: 老城区的街道狭促曲折，好似迷宫一般

english: to make a sudden, unsteady movement forward or sideways
example_en: As the car sped over a pothole she lurched forward.
example_zh: 车子飞驶过一个坑洼时，她身子猛地向前一倾。

english: inveigle
example_en: She inveigles Paco into a plot to swindle Tania out of her savings.
example_zh: 她引诱帕科一起合谋来骗取塔妮娅的积蓄。

english: having a good or helpful result especially after something unpleasant has happened
example_en: The team's defeat is a salutary warning before the World Cup.
example_zh: 这次失利是在世界杯比赛之前对整个队的一个有益警示.

english: involving two people or two sides who oppose each other
example_en: There is almost an adversarial feeling between businesses and consumers.
example_zh: 在商家和消费者之间几乎产生了一种敌对的情绪。

english: the process or result of being slowly destroyed by natural precesses
example_en: The bodies buried in the fine ash slowl y decayed.
example_zh: 埋在灰烬里的尸体慢慢地腐烂了。

english: harshly and haughtily arrogant
example_en: He's so overbearing that no one wants to work for him.
example_zh: 他那么专横，没人愿为他工作。

english: easily broken or destroyed
example_en: The fragile economies of several southern African nations could be irreparably damaged.
example_zh: 一些南非国家的脆弱经济可能会被彻底破坏，无法挽回。

english: to rescind or annul by authoritative act
example_en: Many voted for the repeal of that property law.
example_zh: 许多人投票赞成废止那项财产法。

english: lacking conviction: half- hearted
example_en: The study received a lukewarm response from the Home Secretary.
example_zh: 内政大臣对这项研究反应不是很热烈。

english: causing great fear
to feel or show deep respect for
example_en: Most Italians venerate the name of Dante.
example_zh: 大多数意大利人崇拜但丁的名字。

english: morally good behavior or character
example_en: His virtue is patience.
example_zh: 耐心是他的美德。

english: fawning, obsequious
example_en: We heard the sound of sycophantic laughter.
example_zh: 我们听到了谄媚的笑声。

english: to steal things that are not very valuable or to steal a small amount of something
example_en: When food stores close, they go to work, pilfering food for resale on the black market.
example_zh: 食品店关门后，他们就行动起来，偷食品拿到黑市上出售。

english: doing something that has not been done before
example_en: The school has won awards for its pioneering work with the community.
example_zh: 该校因与社区开创性合作而获奖。

english: of or relating to the countryside or to the lives of people who live in the country
example_en: We watched from the train window as the pastoral landscapes of Burgundy unfolded.
example_zh: 透过火车车窗，勃艮第的乡村风光展示在我们眼前。

english: lacking sharpness or quickness of sensibility or intellect
not proud or haughty
example_en: He gave a great performance, but he was very humble.
example_zh: 他的表演非常出色，但他却很谦虚。

english: insulting or contemptuous action or speech
example_en: This action makes a mockery of the Government's continuing protestations of concern.
example_zh: 这一行动是对一再声明表示关注的政府的嘲弄。

english: not fresh or original
example_en: The movie is teeming with obvious and trite ideas.
example_zh: 这部电影充满着明显而陈腐的观点。

english: to no longer have any hope or belief that a situation will improve or change
example_en: He does despair at much of the press criticism.
example_zh: 面对媒体的诸多批评他的确感到绝望。

english: to make glorious by bestowing honor, praise, or admiration
example_en: Singing hymns is one of the ways to glorify God.
example_zh: 唱圣歌是赞美上帝的一种方式。

english: movement away from a place or situation especially because it is dangerous, unpleasant, etc.
example_en: The army was forced to retreat after suffering heavy losses.
example_zh: 部队因伤亡惨重被迫撤退。

english: imprison
carefully noticing problems or signs of danger
example_en: The dog kept a vigilant guard over the house.
example_zh: 这只狗警醒地守护着这所房屋。

english: to throw out especially by physical force, authority, or influence
example_en: Officials used guard dogs to eject the protesters.
example_zh: 官员们用警犬驱散抗议人群。

english: not forming a necessary part of something
example_en: We ought not to bring in extraneous m atters in trying to find a basis for a settl ement.
example_zh: 我们努力寻求解决问题的基础时，不应该牵扯进无关的事情。

english: having a gradual and cumulative effect
example_en: They focus on overt discrimination rather than insidious aspects of racism.
example_zh: 他们关注的是公开的歧视，而不是种族主义的一些潜在问题。

english: to make lucid especially by explanation or analysis
example_en: Haig went on to elucidate his personal principle of war.
example_zh: 海格继续解释他个人的战争原则。

english: to restore to a former state
example_en: Considerable efforts have been made to rehabilitate patients who have suffered in this way.
example_zh: 为使受这种苦的病人康复已经付出了相当大的努力。

english: friendly and easy to talk to
example_en: My boss is affable enough when she is not preoccupied with business problems.
example_zh: 我的老板不忙于公事的时候还是和蔼可亲的。

english: occurring, appearing, or changing at usually irregular intervals
example_en: My memories of childhood are hazy and episodic.
example_zh: 我儿时的回忆是一些朦朦胧胧的松散片段。

english: having or showing a slow and stolid temperament
example_en: Her phlegmatic response itself is now a driver in this financial crisis, and people will rightly blame her for any serious accident.
example_zh: 默克尔冷漠反应的本身，如今就是此次金融危机的舵手，如果出现重大事故，人们责备她也理所应当。

english: a group of retainers or attendants
example_en: Mind trainers are now part of a tennis star's retinue.
example_zh: 现在，网球明星的随行人员中有些是心理培训师。

english: very complicated and difficult to understand
example_en: Despite its length and convoluted plot, Asta's Book is a rich and rewarding re
example_zh: ad. 虽然篇幅很长，而且情节复杂，但是《阿斯塔的书》仍不失为一部内容丰富、值得一读的作品。

english: done in haste without regard for consequences
example_en: On stage she seems hard, brash and uncompromising.
example_zh: 在舞台上,她显得冷酷、自以为是而且不妥协。

english: to change to an opposite state or condition
example_en: Because the normal word order is reversed in passive sentences, they are sometimes hard to follow.
example_zh: 由于正常语序在被动句中被颠倒过来了，所以有时很难理解。

english: involving or having information that disagrees with other information
example_en: The contradictory statements are sym ptoms of disarray in the administration.
example_zh: 这些互相矛盾的说法反映了管理的混乱

english: to make unclear or difficult to see or remember
example_en: The writing blurred and danced before his eyes.
example_zh: 字迹变得一片模糊，在他眼前晃动。

english: a scheming or crafty action or artful design intended to accomplish some usually evil end
example_en: They are attempting to counter o enemy's machination.
example_zh: 他们在试图反击敌人的阴谋。

english: to praise highly
example_en: They kept extolling my managerial skill s.
example_zh: 他们不停地赞美我的管理技能。

english: absolutely
example_en: Staff are often discourteous and sometimes downright rude.
example_zh: 职员常常态度很不礼貌，有时候极其蛮横。

english: the place or point of entering or beginning
example_en: He stopped at the threshold of the bedroom.
example_zh: 他在卧室门口停住了。

english: to abuse or censure severely or abusively
example_en: Human is not God. God is reasoning, human isn't, human would rather vituperate than reasoning.
example_zh: 人不是上帝, 上帝是讲道理的, 人更易通过谩骂的方式而不是讲道理。

english: having or showing a desire to cause harm to someone
example_en: These are not necessarily hateful, malicious people.
example_zh: 这些人不一定心怀仇恨，恶意伤人。

english: in the past
example_en: Erstwhile workers may have become managers.
example_zh: 过去的工人可能已经成了经理。

english: to relate to someone or something
example_en: His remark did not pertain to the question.
example_zh: 他的话同这个问题不相干。

english: appealing to or expressing emotion
example_en: These comparisons are emotive rather than analytic.
example_zh: 这些比较带有个人感情色彩，而不是客观分析。

english: to set apart
example_en: This jury is expected to be sequestered for at least two months.
example_zh: 预计这个陪审团将至少被隔离两个月。

english: of or relating to an enemy
example_en: She fixed her questioner with a hostile glare.
example_zh: 她敌意地瞪着向她提问的人。

english: characterized by firmness or obduracy
example_en: The authorities proved unyielding on one crucial opposition demand.
example_zh: 面对反对党这一重大诉求，当局立场坚定。

english: the belief that your country, race, etc., is better than any other
example_en: It may also appeal to the latent chauvinism of many ordinary people.
example_zh: 它可能也迎合了许多普通人心中的沙文主义情结。

english: to use or change in a skillful way or for a particular purpose
example_en: The technology uses a pen to manipulate a computer.
example_zh: 这项技术使用笔来操控计算机。

english: to check by or as if by pressure
example_en: People who repress their emotions risk having nightmares...
example_zh: 压抑情感的人容易做噩梦。
