english: behaving in an unreasonably impatient and angry way, like a child
example_en: Bryant is often portrayed as petulant, selfish, and at times overbearing in newspaper coverage and magazine profiles.
example_zh: 科比常被媒体描述为脾气坏的、自私的球员，有时还在报纸封面和杂志外形中显得傲慢。

english: to move rapidly or forcefully
using too many words in speaking or writing
example_en: So much needless repetition makes the article long-winded.
example_zh: 这样叠床架屋，文章就太罗嗦了。

english: to subdue or reduce in intensity or severity
example_en: They are trying to allay public fears about the spread of the disease.
example_zh: 他们正竭力减轻公众对这种疾病传播的恐惧。

english: to flow or pass slowly through fine pores or small openings
example_en: Water seeped from a crack in the pipe.
example_zh: 水从管道的一个裂缝中渗出。

english: to cause to exist or continue without changing
example_en: The two countries have always maintained close relations.
example_zh: 这两个国家一直保持着密切关系。

english: annoying or irritating
example_en: She desired a fixed occupation-no matter how onerous, how irksome.
example_zh: 她希望有个固定的职业，不管这个职业多么繁重，多么令人厌倦。

english: to give and take mutually
example_en: He needs these people to fulfill his ambitions and reciprocates by bringing out the best in each of them.
example_zh: 他需要这些人去实现他的雄心壮志，作为回报，他也会让他们充分施展各自的才能。

english: to destroy or remove completely
example_en: The country must extirpate the evils of drug abuse.
example_zh: 这个国家必须根除毒品泛滥的罪恶。

english: to destroy completely so that nothing is left
example_en: There was time enough to obliterate memories of how things once were for him.
example_zh: 时间足以抹去他对过去经历的记忆。

english: producing young or fruit especially freely
example_en: She is a prolific writer of novels and short stories.
example_zh: 她是一位多产的作家，写了很多小说和短篇故事。

english: to gather into storage
example_en: His priceless collection of Chinese art and artefacts was garnered over three decades.
example_zh: 他那批价值连城的中国艺术品和手工艺品是花了30多年才收集起来的。

english: erect in carriage or posture
example_en: Helen sat upright in her chair.
example_zh: 海伦笔直地坐在椅子上。

english: a way of reaching agreement in which each person or group gives up something that was wanted in order to end an argument or dispute
example_en: His radicalism and refusal to compromi se isolated him.
example_zh: 他的激进主义与拒绝妥协使他受到孤立

english: a legal prohibition on commerce
example_en: The United Nations imposed an arms embargo against the country.
example_zh: 联合国对那个国家实施了武器禁运。

english: very easy to see or notice
example_en: The advertisements were all posted in a conspicuous place.
example_zh: 广告都贴在了显眼的地方。

english: a usually crude and temporary expedient
example_en: And it is a rational choice to modern society management pattern, not a makeshift.
example_zh: 它也不是一种权宜之计，而是对现代社会治理模式的理性选择。

english: not subject to control of the will
example_en: Another surge of pain in my ankle caused me to give an involuntary shudder.
example_zh: 踝关节的又一阵疼痛使我不由自主地颤抖了一下。

english: tending to remain calm
example_en: He was a man of the most equable temper.
example_zh: 他是个脾气非常好的人。

english: lasting or enduring through all time
a solemn oath
example_en: Her last adjuration to daughter was to escape from dinginess if she could.
example_zh: 她对女儿最后的叮嘱是要竭尽全力摆脱这种困难。

english: the act of providing money to create or support a school, organization, etc.
example_en: The hospital was founded on an endowment fund.
example_zh: 这所医院是用捐赠基金创办的。

english: brief and direct in a way that may see rude or unfriendly
example_en: The President issued a terse statement denying the charges.
example_zh: 总统发表了一份简短的声明，否认那些指控。

english: accepted as true or correct by most people
example_en: They are orthodox jews.
example_zh: 他们是正统的犹太教徒。

english: unsure or uncertain
example_en: This claim seems to us to be rather du bious.
example_zh: 在我们看来这种说法非常可疑。

english: of a serious mien
lavish or superfluous ornament especially in architecture
example_en: There is a high-gabled gingerbread house.
example_zh: 一幢有高高的山墙、外部装饰过分雕琢的房屋。

english: generally incompetent
example_en: He was inept and lacked the intelligence to govern.
example_zh: 他没有什么能力，缺乏管理才干。

english: repeating something else and therefore unnecessary
example_en: Changes in technology may mean that once-valued skills are now redundant.
example_zh: 技术上的革新可能意味着曾经被重视的技术现在已变得多余。

english: to try to be like
example_en: You must work hard to emulate your sister.
example_zh: 你必须努力工作, 赶上你姐姐。

english: expressing or characteristic of weariness
example_en: She was weary of being alone.
example_zh: 她厌倦了独处。

english: to regard or think of as
example_en: The sale has been held up because the price is reckoned to be too high.
example_zh: 销售陷入停滞，因为大家认为价格太高了。

english: likely to cause damage or have a bad effect
example_en: His methods are inimical to radical change.
example_zh: 他的方法不利于彻底的变革。

english: a condition of weariness or debility
example_en: Symptoms of anaemia include general fatigue and lassitude.
example_zh: 贫血症状包括全身疲劳和困乏。

english: to affirm or declare positively or earnestly
moving slowly or lazily
example_en: She suggests ways to jump-start the sluggish educational system.
example_zh: 她提出了几种方法来推动发展迟缓的教育体制。

english: marked by unusual delicacy or refinement
example_en: She's the prettiest, most ethereal roma ntic heroine in the movies.
example_zh: 她是所有电影中最美丽、最超凡的爱情女主角。

english: one who is an acknowledged leader or chief proponent
example_en: He was enthroned as the guru of the avant-garde.
example_zh: 他被推崇为先锋派的权威。

english: needless repetition of an idea, statement, or word
example_en: Modern logicians regard it as little more than tautology.
example_zh: 现代的逻辑学家仅仅把它看作同义反复.

english: attracting or seeking to attract attention, admiration, or envy often by gaudiness or obviousness
example_en: She's got a lovely way with language without ever sounding ostentatious.
example_zh: 她的语言优美，丝毫无装腔作势之感。

english: help bring about
example_en: Friendly contacts between different peoples facilitate the cultural and economic interchange.
example_zh: 各国人民的友好接触促进文化和经济交流。

english: to become impeded or stuck
example_en: Your car will bog down in the mud.
example_zh: 你的车会陷进泥沼的。

english: accustomed to dealing with fatigue or hardships
example_en: It should not surprise us that such an environment has produced a hardy and independent people.
example_zh: 这样的环境造就了一个吃苦耐劳、独立自主的民族，对此我们不应该感到意外

english: agreeably stimulating because of freshness or newness
example_en: People drink tea because of its variety and refreshing effect.
example_zh: 人们喝茶是因为茶的不同品种和提神的效果。

english: to make very weak or tired
example_en: Idleness enervates the will to succeed.
example_zh: 懒惰削弱了成功的决心。

english: having a frightening or threatening appearance
example_en: There was something forbidding on her face and I didn't dare to look at her.
example_zh: 她的脸上露出令人生畏的表情，令我不敢正眼看她。

english: compare
very thin
example_en: The cultural and historical links between the many provinces were seen to be very tenuous
example_zh: 许多省份之间的文化和历史纽带被认为是很脆弱的。

english: punctiliously exact
example_en: Both readers commend Knutson for his scrupulous attention to detail.
example_zh: 两位读者都称赞克努森对细节一丝不苟

english: dirty and in bad condition form being neglected
example_en: They took me to a sleazy back-street hotel.
example_zh: 他们把我带到一个肮脏的后街旅馆。

english: to avoid
example_en: From that time forward everybody shunned him.
example_zh: 从那时候起，每个人都有意回避他。

english: an idea or opinion that someone has before learning about or experiencing something directly
example_en: He did not allow his preconceptions to compromise his scientific work.
example_zh: 他不允许自己的先入之见破坏自己的科学工作。

english: having an erratic or intermittent character
example_en: The government is making slow and fitful progress in these negotiations.
example_zh: 政府从这些谈判中正取得缓慢的、间断性的进展。

english: appear disturbed and upset or they seem to be slightly crazy.
very serious about doing things in a direct and efficient way without any foolishness or nonsense
example_en: She saw herself as a direct, no- nonsense, modern woman.
example_zh: 她视自己为一个率直、高效干练的现代女性。

english: to cause to be upside down
example_en: Their results upend some of our basic assumptions.
example_zh: 研究结果颠覆了我们的一些基本假设。

english: to avoid giving a promise or direct answer
example_en: They hedged in answering various questions about the operation.
example_zh: 他们闪烁其词，不愿回答有关此次行动的各种问题。

english: to increase in amount
chinese: 有几个小时，紧张局势有所加剧。
example_en: For several hours, tension mounted.
example_zh: 有几个小时，紧张局势有所加剧。

english: having no meaning, purpose, or effect
example_en: Without an audience the performance is pointless.
example_zh: 没有观众，表演也就没有意义了。

english: perfectly typical or representative of a particular kind of person or thing
example_en: Chopstick is the quintessential cutlery choice throughout most of Asia.
example_zh: 筷子是亚洲大部分国家最典型的餐具选择。

english: to torment by or as if by constant attack
example_en: She has been harried by the press all week.
example_zh: 整个星期她都受到新闻界的不断烦扰。

english: to put things in an orderly form
example_en: The latest draft of the agreement codifi es the panel's decision.
example_zh: 最新的协议草案把专家小组的决定加以整理，形成了条文。

english: not capable of being affected or disturbed
example_en: She seems almost impervious to the criticism from all sides.
example_zh: 对于来自各方的指责，她似乎无动于衷

english: to lose turgor from lack of water
example_en: The roses wilted the day after she bought them.
example_zh: 她买的玫瑰第二天就凋谢了。

english: to make it work again after a period in which it has not been working
example_en: American government has launched a series of economic reforms to reactivate the economy.
example_zh: 美国政府推行了一系列旨在复苏经济的经济改革。

english: a feeling of uneasiness about a point especially of conscience or propriety
expressing opinions and feelings in an honest and sincere way
owing gratitude or recognition to another
to make powerless or ineffective
example_en: In combat they paralyze the enemy's will, and easily gain advantage over less experienced foes.
example_zh: 在战斗中他们能瘫痪敌人的意志，在对付经验相对较少的敌人时轻易地取得战斗优势。

english: self-evident
example_en: It is axiomatic that as people grow older they generally become less agile.
example_zh: 人年纪越大通常灵活性越差，这是不言而喻的。

english: something that comes before something else and that often leads to or influences its development
example_en: Westwood is always the precursor of the punk revolution after all, whose goal is to challenge the traditional raiment of the fashion world.
example_zh: 韦斯特伍德始终是朋克革命的先驱者，她的目标就是向时装界的传统服饰挑战

english: to make or adapt to suit a special need or purpose
example_en: Most travel agents are prepared to tailor travel arrangements to meet individual requirements.
example_zh: 为了满足个别需要，大多数旅行社都愿意做出专门的旅游安排。

english: a condition characterized by the excessive accumulation and storage of fat in the body
example_en: The study also demonstrated a direct link between obesity and mortality.
example_zh: 该研究还表明了肥胖症和死亡率之间存在直接的联系。

english: an animal or plant much below normal size
example_en: In most stories, dwarfs often have magical powers.
example_zh: 在大部分的故事中，小矮人有神奇魔法

english: marked by fast and nervous, disordered, or anxiety-driven activity
to make known to many people
example_en: The shipping industry promulgated a voluntary code.
example_zh: 航运业对自律守则进行了宣传。

english: completely unwilling to change
example_en: They put pressure on the Government to change its intransigent stance.
example_zh: 他们向政府施压以迫使其改变不妥协的立场。

english: dull or ordinary
example_en: His instructor offered a more prosaic explanation for the surge in interest.
example_zh: 他的老师对利率的急剧上升给出了一个更枯燥乏味的解释。

english: a confusing or difficult problem
secret or mysterious
example_en: Communities built around common goals and beliefs, rather than arcane licensing policies trying to protect a company's mobile market.
example_zh: 在群体里大家有着共同的目标和信仰，不会使用那些晦涩难懂的许可条款来保护某些公司的移动市场。

english: a comprehensive presentation of a subject
example_en: The tower offers a breathtaking panorama of Prague.
example_zh: 从塔上可看到壮丽的布拉格全景。

english: a place, employment, status, or activity for which a person or thing is best fitted
example_en: He eventually found his niche in sports journalism.
example_zh: 最后他在体育新闻界找到了理想的工作

english: to tell everyone about something that you are proud of, especially in an annoying way
example_en: Mark Morris, who is trumpeted as the dance talent of his generation…
example_zh: 马克·莫里斯，被吹捧为他那一代的舞蹈奇才

english: having a sickness that can be passed to someone else by touching
example_en: People with contagious diseases shoul d be isolated.
example_zh: 传染病患者应予以隔离。

english: seller
example_en: Kamal was a vendor in Egypt's open- air bazaar.
example_zh: 卡迈勒是埃及露天集市里的一个小贩。

english: a large amount of something
example_en: Irrigation is easy in the South because of the abundance of water.
example_zh: 南方多水,利于灌溉。

english: lacking remembrance, memory, or mindful attention
example_en: He was oblivious of what was happening.
example_zh: 他已经忘却发生什么事了。

english: a right or immunity granted as a peculiar benefit, advantage, or favor
example_en: The Russian Federation has issued a decree abolishing special privileges for government officials.
example_zh: 俄罗斯联邦已经颁布法令废除政府官员的特权。

english: the highest point of something
example_en: His work is considered the acme of cinematic art.
example_zh: 他的作品被认为是电影艺术的巅峰之作

english: to pay attention to
example_en: If Democrats want to get anything done this year, they must heed such fears.
example_zh: 如果民主党打算今年做出点实事，他们就应当注意这样的一些担忧。

english: requiring much time, effort, or attention
example_en: He described Morris as an excessively demanding and faultfinding tutor.
example_zh: 他将莫里斯描述为一个过度苛刻和挑剔的导师。

english: the smallest part or particle imaginable
example_en: There's not a whit of truth in the statement.
example_zh: 这声明里没有丝毫的真实性。

english: a feeling of closeness and understanding that someone has for another person because of their similar qualities, ideas, or interests
example_en: It's important that you share an affinity with your husband.
example_zh: 和丈夫有共同的爱好是十分重要的。

english: a disordered psychic or behavioral state resulting from severe mental or emotional stress or physical injury
example_en: He confronted his childhood trauma and tried to exorcise the pain.
example_zh: 他正视自己儿时所受的创伤，努力消除心中的痛苦。

english: to surprise or upset very much
example_en: They were stunned by the view from the summit.
example_zh: 在峰顶看到的景色使他们惊叹不已。

english: having a strong influence on ideas, works, events, etc., that come later
example_en: The reforms have been a seminal event in the history of the NHS.
example_zh: 这些改革已成为英国国民保健制度史上一件具有开创性的大事。

english: having or exhibiting self-importance
example_en: He was somewhat pompous and had a high opinion of his own capabilities.
example_zh: 他有些爱摆架子，并且高估自己的能力

english: to say or declare openly
a standard for making a critical judgment
example_en: Exam results are not the only yardstick of a school's performance.
example_zh: 考试结果不是衡量学校水平的唯一标准

english: not wavering or weakening
example_en: You will make it if you have unfaltering determination.
example_zh: 如果你有坚定的决心，你就一定会成功！

english: not able to be doubted
example_en: You should add honey to counterbalance the acidity.
example_zh: 你应该加点蜂蜜来调和酸味。

english: an original model on which something is patterned
example_en: Metal-wheeled chariots are the prototype of the tanks of modern warfare.
example_zh: 金属轮战车是现代战争中坦克的原型。

english: a surrounding area or district
example_en: Crowds gathered in the vicinity of Trafalgar Square.
example_zh: 成群结队的人聚集在特拉法尔加广场周围。

english: quickness of motion
example_en: Einstein's theory links energy with mass and velocity of light.
example_zh: 爱因斯坦的理论把能量同质量和光速联系起来.

english: accompanying especially in a subordinate or incidental way
example_en: Cultures that were better at trading sa w a concomitant increase in their wealt h.
example_zh: 比较擅长贸易的文明其财富也随之增长

english: a state of perplexity or doubt
example_en: The government appears to be in a quandary about what to do with so many people.
example_zh: 政府似乎陷入了左右为难的境地，不知道该拿这么多人怎么办。

english: absence of order
example_en: Economic anarchy scourged the post- war world.
example_zh: 经济混乱使得战后的世界陷入水深火热之中。

english: to completely suppress
example_en: The company increased its stake in the business, squelching rumours of a takeover bid.
example_zh: 该公司增加了其在生意中的股份，这样就压制住了被收购的谣言。

english: not usual or normal
example_en: Flying at 1,000 ft. he heard a peculiar noise from the rotors.
example_zh: 在1,000英尺的高度飞行时，他听到旋翼发出一种奇怪的噪音。

english: an act of bidding farewell
example_en: He gave a touching valediction at graduation.
example_zh: 他在毕业典礼上发表了动人的告别辞。

english: of or relating to centralized control by an autocratic leader or hierarchy
example_en: In totalitarian societies, art exists for didactic purposes.
example_zh: 在极权社会中，艺术是为教诲目的存在的。

english: not modern or current
example_en: Romania badly needs aid to modernize its outmoded industries.
example_zh: 罗马尼亚迫切需要援助以对其过时的产业进行现代化。

english: connection, link
example_en: The Prayer Book has provided a flexible enough nexus of beliefs to hold together the different church parties.
example_zh: 祈祷书为各信仰之间建起了足够灵活的联系纽带，以期将各个不同教派凝聚在一起。

english: to cause to seem inferior
example_en: Such conduct will derogate from your reputation.
example_zh: 那样的行为有损你的名誉。

english: to leave or get rid of quickly or without concern
example_en: The government declared that it did not dump radioactive waste at sea.
example_zh: 政府宣称并未将放射性废料倾倒在海里

english: of or relating to ancient times
example_en: Though social philosophy is an archaic concept, it really is an emerging field of investigation.
example_zh: 可以说社会哲学是一个古老的概念又是一个新兴的研究领域。

english: a cure or solution for any illness or problem
example_en: He said the introduction of market disci pline to the economy was not a magic cure-all for its problems.
example_zh: 他说把市场规范引入该国经济，并不是解决其经济问题的灵丹妙药。

english: exhibiting mature qualities at an unusually early age
example_en: Margaret was always a precocious child.
example_zh: 玛格丽特一直是个早熟的孩子。

english: construct, manufacture
example_en: The evidence was totally fabricated.
example_zh: 这个证据纯属伪造。

english: of, relating to, or arranged in a hierarchy
example_en: Congress is a collegial and not a hierarchical body.
example_zh: 国会是一个学院式的机构,而不是一个等级制度的机构。

english: willing to lie and trick people in order to get what is wanted
example_en: His devious nature was shown in half- lies and small dishonesties.
example_zh: 他不正直的天性表现在小谎话及细小的不诚实行为中。

english: the act of treating people in a way that does not favor some over others
example_en: The new document will guarantee fairness for blacks in Georgia.
example_zh: 新文件将保证佐治亚州的黑人受到公平对待。

english: of, relating to, or arranged in a particular order or sequence
example_en: In this way the children are introduced to sequential learning.
example_zh: 这样孩子们就会循序渐进地学习。

english: firmly established by long persistence
example_en: It is hard for an inveterate smoker to give up tobacco.
example_zh: 要一位有多年烟瘾的烟民戒烟是困难的

english: equal or similar to something in size, amount, or degree
example_en: He was given a job commensurate wit h his abilities.
example_zh: 他得到一份与他的能力相称的工作。

english: to change or alter greatly and often with grotesque or humorous effect
example_en: Almost overnight, that sweet, little child had transmogrified into an antisocial monster.
example_zh: 几乎是一夜之间，那个可爱的小孩彻底变成了一个反社会的魔王。

english: to increase in extent, volume, number, amount, intensity, or scope
example_en: The fighting escalated into a full-scale war.
example_zh: 这场交战逐步扩大为全面战争。

english: of or relating to an order of existence beyond the visible observable universe
example_en: Today, most people no longer believe in ghosts and witches. But these supernatural beings are still a part of Halloween.
example_zh: 在今天，很多人不再相信有幽灵和巫婆，但这些神奇的人物仍然是万圣节的一部分。

english: extremely excited
example_en: One overwrought member had to be restrained by friends.
example_zh: 一位成员过于激动，朋友们不得不进行拦阻。

english: extremely good or excellent
example_en: Derartu is an outstanding athlete and deserved to win.
example_zh: 德拉图是位杰出的运动员，他理应获胜

english: time to come
example_en: He predicts the tremendous shadows which futurity casts upon the present.
example_zh: 他预测到未来给当今世界蒙上的巨大阴影。

english: existing in every part of something
example_en: It is knowledge directed to the fundamental and pervasive concerns of existence.
example_zh: 它要回答的是人类生存的根本、普遍的问题。

english: to carry away with delight, wonder, or rapture
example_en: Her beauty entirely entrance him.
example_zh: 她的美丽完全使他出神了。

english: happening too soon or earlier than usual
example_en: His career was brought to a premature end by a succession of knee injuries.
example_zh: 他的职业生涯因连续的膝伤过早地结束了。

english: of or relating to a clerk or office worker
example_en: He was still attired in his clerical outfit.
example_zh: 他还穿着牧师的行头。

english: substantially real
example_en: The policy has not yet brought any tangible benefits.
example_zh: 这项政策还没有带来任何切实可行的好处。

english: to commit to a goal or way of life
example_en: Bessie has dedicated her life to caring for others.
example_zh: 贝茜一生都致力于照顾他人。

english: very smart or clever
example_en: The ingenious boy made a radio set for himself.
example_zh: 那个聪明的男孩自己组装了一台收音机

english: showing approval
example_en: We could have done better under more favorable conditions.
example_zh: 在更有利的条件下我们还可以做得更好

english: to accept, support or approve of
example_en: Your father won't countenance you goi ng abroad.
example_zh: 你父亲不会赞同你出国。

english: to vary between opposing beliefs, feelings, or theories
example_en: There have always been slight oscillations in world temperature.
example_zh: 全球气温一直在轻微波动。

english: to incite or rouse as if with a goad
example_en: His opposition acted as a goad to her determination to succeed.
example_zh: 他的反对反而刺激她坚定了取得成功的决心。

english: permitting or designed to permit spontaneous and unguided responses
example_en: Girls do better on open-ended tasks that require them to think for themselves.
example_zh: 女孩子更擅长需要独立思考的开放式任务。

english: to promote the growth or development of
example_en: The rebels know the truth and seek to foment revolution.
example_zh: 那些叛乱者知道真相,并且想办法来挑起革命。

english: belonging to the earliest period or state
example_en: The car is in pristine condition.
example_zh: 这辆汽车是全新的。

english: to plunder ruthlessly
example_en: The rebels went looting and pillaging.
example_zh: 叛乱者趁火打劫，掠夺财物。

english: causing feelings of anger and annoyance
example_en: The current situation is very frustrating for us.
example_zh: 当前的情形令我们十分灰心。

english: an interruption in time or continuity
example_en: There was a hiatus in his acting life.
example_zh: 他的演艺生涯曾一度中断。

english: moving in an awkward or clumsy way
to remove (something that is not wanted or needed)
vertical in position
example_en: He is a man of erect and soldierly bearing.
example_zh: 他是一个身姿挺拔、具有军人风度的男子。

english: full of lively activity
example_en: She was bustling around in the kitchen.
example_zh: 她在厨房里四处奔忙着。

english: a powerful often violent whirlpool sucking in objects within a given radius
example_en: Inside, she was a maelstrom of churning emotions.
example_zh: 她心中的情感似波涛汹涌，起伏不定。

english: not showing enough care and attention
to raise trivial and frivolous objection
example_en: Although his composition was flawless, the teacher was always cavil ling at his handwriting.
example_zh: 虽然他的作文写得完美无瑕，但老师对他的书法总是百般挑剔。

english: beyond what is needed
example_en: She gave him a look that made words superfluous.
example_zh: 她看了他一眼，这已表明一切，无须多言了。

english: naively innocent and trusting
example_en: She and Dan were still dewy-eyed enough to think that they would get full compensation.
example_zh: 她和丹仍然非常天真，以为他们可以得到全额的补偿。

english: to cause to feel very excited or happy
example_en: It gave me a big thrill to meet my favorite author in person.
example_zh: 能见到我最喜欢的作者本人使我感到兴奋不已。

english: to stir up
example_en: The Second World War kindled his enthusiasm for politics.
example_zh: 第二次世界大战激发了他的政治热情。

english: malicious or defamatory gossip
example_en: There has been no hint of scandal during his time in office.
example_zh: 他在任期间没有任何丑闻。

english: excessive or slavish admiration or flattery
example_en: Despite his performance at the Oscars ceremony and being caught up in all the glitz and adulation, Rahman is a low-key star.
example_zh: 尽管他在奥斯卡盛典上的表现及为奢华与恭维所包围，拉曼仍是个低调的明星

english: always right and accurate
example_en: She has an unerring instinct for people's weak spots.
example_zh: 她能准确地把握他人的弱点。

english: to cause to separate widely
example_en: The explosion scattered a flock of birds roosting in the trees.
example_zh: 爆炸声把栖息在树丛中的鸟群惊散了。

english: giving exact rules, directions, or instructions about how you should do something
example_en: The son of a mandarin has no prescriptive right to succeed his father.
example_zh: 高级官员的儿子没有法定的权力继承他的父亲。

english: tediously uniform or unvarying
example_en: It's monotonous work, like most factory jobs.
example_zh: 与工厂大部分工作一样，这份工作也很单调乏味。

english: to cause to happen or be created
to give, transfer or deliver into the hands or control of another
example_en: The father consigned the child to his sister's care.
example_zh: 那位父亲把孩子托付给他妹妹照看。

english: to fill or build up again
chinese: 政府正试图通过空投食品补充供应。
example_en: The government is trying to replenish supplies by airlifting food.
example_zh: 政府正试图通过空投食品补充供应。

english: pain or suffering affecting the body, a bodily part, or the mind
example_en: Marie felt her distress ebbing away.
example_zh: 玛丽感到她的痛苦渐渐减退了。

english: to present for acceptance
example_en: The army has not yet proffered an explanation of how and why the accident happened.
example_zh: 军队还没有对这次事件发生的经过和原因给出解释。

english: an arbitrary constant whose value characterizes a member of a system
example_en: Each input parameter should have the variable name and its value.
example_zh: 各输入参数应该有自己的变量名和值。

english: deliberately not obeying people in authority or rules of behavior
to obscure the existence or true state or character of
example_en: It is impossible to disguise the fact that finance is bad.
example_zh: 财政困难这一事实是无法隐瞒的。

english: having requisite or adequate ability or qualities
relating to a scientific experiment or to scientific experiments in general
example_en: The experimental results show that the syntaxic method is effective.
example_zh: 实验结果表明该综合性方法效果良好。

english: to check or control
having little value or importance
example_en: Outside California these difficulties may seem fairly trifling.
example_zh: 在别处，加利福尼亚的这些困难可能看起来相当微不足道。

english: characterized by resolute fearlessness, fortitude, and endurance
example_en: Intrepid rally-drivers meet in Beijing for the start of the Peking to Paris Motor Challenge.
example_zh: 无畏的拉力赛选手相聚北京，参加北京到巴黎赛车挑战赛的开赛。

english: to establish by legal and authoritative act
example_en: The king could not enact laws without the sanction of Parliament.
example_zh: 未经议会批准，国王不能制定法律。

english: having or showing an ability to notice and understand things that are difficult or not obvious
example_en: It was very perspicacious of you to find the cause of the trouble so quickly.
example_zh: 你真是明察秋毫，问题的原因这麽快就找出来了。

english: to make confused
example_en: Jokes about raccoon hunting in the book may bemuse international readers.
example_zh: 书中提到了捉浣熊的笑话或许会令海外读头雾水。

english: to fasten or restrain by or as if by a tether
example_en: The officer dismounted, tethering his horse to a tree.
example_zh: 这位军官下了马，把马拴在一棵树上。

english: awkward or inefficient in use or construction
example_en: He is still smarting over criticism of his victorious but clumsy performance.
example_zh: 别人批评他尽管最终胜出但表现笨拙，他为这样的批评感到闷闷不乐。

english: to evade the point of an argument by caviling about words
example_en: He quibbled about the price.
example_zh: 他为价格争论。

english: to offer for discussion or consideration
example_en: Zoologist Eugene Morton has propounded a general theory of the vocal sounds that animals make.
example_zh: 动物学家尤金·莫顿提出了一个有关动物发声的概括性理论。

english: to bring into peril
example_en: Conservationists say the oil leak could imperil the long-term survival of the creatures.
example_zh: 自然保护协会人士认为石油泄露将 长期 威胁海龟的生存。

english: existing in a state of intellectual, moral, or social darkness
example_en: Listen to both sides and you will be enlightened; heed only one side and you will be benighted.
example_zh: 听则明，偏信则暗。

english: making you feel less worried or frightened
example_en: They tried to reassure her, but she still felt anxious.
example_zh: 他们设法让她放心，可她还是焦虑不安

english: to stir to activity
example_en: The proposal would spark a storm of protest around the country.
example_zh: 这一提案将引发全国性的抗议浪潮。

english: not sincere
example_en: It was the first commercially available machine to employ artificial intelligence.
example_zh: 这是第一台作为商品出售的采用人工智能技术的机器。

english: an angry and usually long speech or piece of writing that strongly criticizes someone or something
example_en: The book is a diatribe against the acad emic left.
example_zh: 该书对学界左派进行了抨击。

english: the quality of a person who is completely honest
example_en: Her probity and integrity are beyond question.
example_zh: 她的诚实和正直是无可争辩的。

english: to catch
example_en: Allied troops captured over 300 enemy soldiers.
example_zh: 盟军俘虏了300多名敌方士兵。

english: irregular, unusual
example_en: Jamie is an atypical English schoolboy.
example_zh: 杰米跟一般的英国男学生不太一样。

english: requiring immediate attention
example_en: It has becoming an exigent task to find a "new continent" of species resource s.
example_zh: 寻找生物种质资源的“新大陆”已经成为了一个迫切的问题。

english: a narrow opening or crack of considerable length and depth usually occurring from some breaking or parting
example_en: Just ahead of us there was a huge fissure.
example_zh: 离我们不远处,出现一个大裂缝。

english: to free from or as if from a tether
example_en: Only better regulation can untether economies from the fickle fortunes of finance.
example_zh: 只有更好的监管，才能把经济体从金融业变幻无常的命运中解脱出来。

english: a model or pattern for something that may be copied
example_en: He had become the paradigm of the successful man.
example_zh: 他已经成为成功人士的典范。

english: incidental, indirect
example_en: Certainly, no all-round knowledge can be acquired merely by glancing this way and that and relying on hearsay.
example_zh: 东张西望，道听途说，绝然得不到什么完全的知识。

english: to twist out of the true meaning or proportion
example_en: The media distorts reality and categorizes people as all good or all b ad.
example_zh: 媒体会歪曲事实，将人说得不是完美无缺就是一无是处。

english: to leave out
example_en: Did you omit some small but vital factor from one of your Columns?
example_zh: 是不是你在某一列中遗漏了一些微小却关键的因素？

english: brilliantly or showily bright, colorful, or impressive
example_en: The evening was crowned by her dazzling performance.
example_zh: 她那令人炫目的表演把晚会的气氛推向高潮。

english: marked by extreme calm, impassivity, and steadiness
example_en: He remained imperturbable in spite of the hysteria and panic all around him.
example_zh: 尽管他周围的人歇斯底里地惊慌失措，但他仍保持冷静。

english: impossible to deny
example_en: It is an undeniable fact that crime is increasing.
example_zh: 犯罪在增加是无可争辩的事实。

english: to ignore in a deliberate and insulting way
example_en: He snubbed her in public and made her feel an idiot
example_zh: 他当众冷落她，让她觉得自己像一个白痴似的。

english: deeply felt
example_en: We would like to take this opportunity to convey our heartfelt condolences to the families of the victims.
example_zh: 我们谨此向受害人家属表达我们衷心的慰唁。

english: a combination or mixture of things
example_en: His previous fusions of jazz, pop and African melodies have proved highly successful.
example_zh: 事实证明他先前融合了爵士乐、流行乐和非洲旋律的作品非常成功。

english: to deprive of vital elements or resources, such as personnel, equipment or funding, for use elsewhere
example_en: Margins are eroding because new products cannibalize the market and customers of older products.
example_zh: 利润率也在下降，因为新产品侵占了老产品的市场和消费者。

english: alike or similar
dull, boring, and ordinary
example_en: They all appeared to be lost in the humdrum and routine of their work.
example_zh: 他们好像在一个个单调的工作中迷失了

english: to make a hole through
having no example or parallel
example_en: In recent years, with the rapid development of economic construction in our country, high-grade highway construction is evolving with unexampled speed.
example_zh: 近些年来，随着国民经济持续高速发展，高等级公路的建设正以前所未有的发展速度向前推进。

english: to damage or ruin the force or effectiveness of
example_en: If he becomes the major opposition leader, he could hamstring a conservative-led coalition.
example_zh: 如果他成为主要反对党的领袖，可能会导致保守党领导的联合政府陷于瘫痪。

english: a very small difference in color, tone, meaning, etc.
example_en: We can use our eyes and facial expressions to communicate virtually every subtle nuance of emotion.
example_zh: 我们可以用眼睛和面部表情来如实地传达情感上的每一丝细微差别。

english: to get secure usually lasting possession or control of
example_en: The team managed to secure a place in the finals.
example_zh: 球队拼得了决赛的一席之地。

english: to indulge oneself immoderately
marked by or calling for energy or stamina
example_en: Strenuous efforts had been made to improve conditions in the jail.
example_zh: 为改善那家监狱里的条件已做了艰苦的努力。

english: requiring maximum effort or ability
example_en: The most testing time is undoubtedly in the early months of your return to work.
example_zh: 最考验人的时候无疑是在你重返工作岗位的头几个月。

english: not willing to tell people about things
example_en: He was extremely reticent about his personal life.
example_zh: 他对自己的个人生活讳莫如深。

english: to gain or regain the favor or goodwill of
example_en: Sacrifices were made to propitiate the gods.
example_zh: 人们供奉祭品以求神灵息怒。

english: not lasting long
without deliberation
example_en: Do not leap headlong into decisions.
example_zh: 不要轻率地作决定。

english: to make fit, suitable, or congruous
example_en: The runway of this airport is undergoing expansion to accommodate large planes.
example_zh: 这个机场的跑道正在扩建以适应大型飞机起落。

english: not original or special
example_en: For god sake, this is a canned soap opera.
example_zh: 上帝啊，这简直就是一出千篇一律的肥皂剧。

english: to transfer (a sports team) to a lower ranking division
example_en: If Leigh lose, they'll be relegated.
example_zh: 如果利失球，他们将会降级。

english: notably or brilliantly outstanding because of dignity or achievements or actions
example_en: The composer was one of many illustrious visitors to the town.
example_zh: 那位作曲家是许多造访过这个城市的杰出人物之一。

english: a name that someone uses instead of his or her real name
example_en: Both plays were published under the pseudonym of Philip Dayre.
example_zh: 两个剧本都是以菲利普·戴尔的笔名出版的。

english: not to be endured: intolerable
example_en: The heat and humidity were insufferable.
example_zh: 高温和潮湿让人难以忍受。

english: to restrain from movement, progress, or action
example_en: He was manacled by the police.
example_zh: 他被警察上了镣铐。

english: to sing in a low soft voice
example_en: He would much rather have been croo ning in a smoky bar.
example_zh: 他宁愿在烟雾缭绕的酒吧里哼唱歌曲。

english: protracted excessively
designed to be used once or only a limited number of times and then thrown away
example_en: It's estimated that around 80 per cent of babies wear disposable nappies.
example_zh: 据估计约 80% 的婴儿使用一次性尿布

english: pretending to be morally better than other people
example_en: He writes smug, sanctimonious waffle.
example_zh: 他写的满篇都是自鸣得意、道貌岸然的废话。

english: having no relevant component removed or destroyed
example_en: The money was returned intact by its finder.
example_zh: 钱原封未动地被捡拾者送还。

english: very foolish or stupid
example_en: The president denounced the witless, nasty piece of journalism.
example_zh: 总统痛斥了那份极为肤浅、令人作呕的新闻报道。

english: having or showing the ability or desire to do new and difficult things
example_en: He invented the Nobel Prize for enterp rising scientists.
example_zh: 他为有进取心的科学家创设了诺贝尔奖

english: showing strong and often angry feelings
example_en: One vehement critic is Michael Howard.
example_zh: 其中一位言辞激烈的评论家是迈克尔·霍华德。

english: one that follows
example_en: He set out several principles that he hopes will guide his successors.
example_zh: 他制定出了几条原则,希望能指导其继任者。

english: to proceed slowly or with difficulty
the act of retaining
example_en: The company needs to improve its training and retention of staff.
example_zh: 公司需要改进对员工的培训和留用工作

english: self-proclaimed
example_en: Two of those arrested are said to be self-styled area commanders...
example_zh: 据说在那些被捕的人员中有两人自称是地区指挥官。

english: low in spirit
marked by or given to speech or writing that is given exaggerated importance by artificial or empty means
example_en: The once bombastic orator had himself lapsed into silence.
example_zh: 那个曾经夸夸其辞的演说家缄默不语。

english: to move in a confused or disordered manner
example_en: They had jumbled it all up into a heap.
example_zh: 他们把所有的东西胡乱堆成了一堆。

english: capable of becoming real
example_en: The meeting has the potential to be a watershed event.
example_zh: 这次会议有可能成为一次分水岭事件。

english: marked by inactivity or repose
example_en: The rapid development of the economy turns the quiescent town into a noisy city.
example_zh: 经济的迅速发展使这个宁静的小镇成为闹市。

english: accustomed, used
example_en: He was wont to fall asleep after supper.
example_zh: 他习惯吃完晚饭就打盹。

english: not limited in any way
example_en: His ambition is unbounded.
example_zh: 他的野心毫无止境。

english: to put into a state of agitated confusion
example_en: She was put in a fluster by the unexpected guests.
example_zh: 不速之客的到来弄得她很慌张。

english: disposed to arouse or take part in or guilty of sedition
example_en: He distributed a seditious pamphlet called The Rights of Man.
example_zh: 他散发了名叫《人的权利》的带有煽动性的小册子。

english: not easily governed, managed, or directed
example_en: The economy still faces intractable problems.
example_zh: 经济仍然面临着一些棘手的问题。

english: regulated or determined in size or degree with reference to proportions
example_en: The value of a fraction is inversely proportional to that of the denominator.
example_zh: 分数值与分母值成反比例。

english: the exact opposite of something or someone
to engage in argument
example_en: He disputed the allegations.
example_zh: 他对指控表示怀疑。

english: the power to produce a desired result or effect
example_en: There is little information on the efficacy of this treatment.
example_zh: 关于此法的疗效目前所知甚少。

english: not interesting or exciting
example_en: It tasted bland and insipid, like warmed cardboard.
example_zh: 这吃起来淡而无味，像加热过的纸板。

english: having or showing an ability to think clearly
example_en: It lies in the blend of clearheaded logic and powerful intuition.
example_zh: 它是清晰的逻辑和强有力的直觉的融合

english: a calculated move: stratagem
example_en: He sees the proposal as more of a diplomatic gambit than a serious defense proposal.
example_zh: 在他看来，与其说这是一项精心筹划的国防动议，倒不如说是外交上的一着妙棋。

english: to give evidence of displeasure or disapproval by or as if by facial expression
example_en: This practice is frowned upon as being wasteful
example_zh: 这种行为被认为是浪费而不获认可。

english: lacking originality, freshness, or novelty
example_en: The script is utterly banal. It is incredible that human minds can put such muck on to paper.
example_zh: 这个剧本是十足的平庸之作，难以想象有人会写出这样的垃圾。

english: capable of adapting to varying conditions
example_en: TV game show hosts with their banal remarks and plastic smiles.
example_zh: 语言陈腐、笑容刻板的电视竞赛节目主持人

english: to encroach upon in a way that violates law or the rights of another
example_en: The film exploited his image and infringed his copyright.
example_zh: 这部电影使用了他的形象，侵犯了他的肖像权。

english: to depart secretly and hide oneself
example_en: Unfortunately, his partners were crooks and absconded with the funds.
example_zh: 不幸的是，他的合伙人都是些骗子，已卷款逃之夭夭了。

english: to be a sign of
example_en: This decision signified a radical change in their policies.
example_zh: 这个决定表明了他们的政策发生了根本的变化。

english: not firm or stiff
having a mutual or reciprocal relation
example_en: All things are interrelated and interact on each other.
example_zh: 一切事物都互相联系并相互作用。

english: quick to react or respond
example_en: Harriet was an easy, responsive little girl.
example_zh: 哈丽雅特是一个随和机灵的小女孩。

english: to have an effect
example_en: Your political opinions will necessarily impinge on your public life.
example_zh: 你的政治观点必然会影响你的社会生活

english: to pay no attention to
example_en: He disregarded the advice of his exec utives.
example_zh: 他对主管层的建议置若罔闻。

english: not kind or sympathetic toward other people
example_en: He was branded an unfeeling bully.
example_zh: 他被说成冷酷的恶棍。

english: the degree or amount of strength or force that something has
example_en: Speech is made up of sound waves that vary in frequency and intensity.
example_zh: 语音是由不同频率和强度的声波组成的

english: an unfounded or mistaken impression or notion
example_en: Hallucination is common in patients who have suffered damage to the brain.
example_zh: 脑部受损的病人常会产生幻觉。

english: containing or giving large amounts of something
example_en: Rainfall is plentiful in the area.
example_zh: 这个地区雨量充足。

english: to cause to subside
example_en: The government tried to appease discontented workers.
example_zh: 政府试图安抚不满的工人们。

english: doing or requiring much sitting
example_en: People in sedentary jobs need to take exercise.
example_zh: 工作上要久坐的人需要做运动.

english: to make excessive claims for
example_en: He has a tendency to oversell himself.
example_zh: 他爱自我吹嘘。

english: attracting attention or notice through unusual or conspicuous qualities
example_en: The most striking feature of those statistics is the high proportion of suicides.
example_zh: 那些统计数据最引人注目之处是其极高的自杀率。

english: flippant, impertinent
example_en: Don't be flip with me.
example_zh: 不要对我油嘴滑舌。

english: to make free from guilt, responsibility, etc.
example_en: How can he be absolved of all responsibility for the accident?
example_zh: 他怎么能被免去所有的事故责任呢？

english: incapable of being fatigued
example_en: His indefatigable spirit helped him to cope with his illness
example_zh: 他不屈不挠的精神帮助他对抗病魔。

english: marked by capriciousness, recklessness, or foolishness
example_en: His fast-paced novels are full of bizarre situations and madcap antics.
example_zh: 他那些快节奏的小说里充满了怪诞的场景和荒唐的行为。

english: having a quality or characteristic that makes a person or thing different from others
example_en: Cooking with the lid on gives the food t hat distinctive smoky flavor.
example_zh: 盖上盖子做会让这种食物有一种熏制般的独特风味。

english: done in a secret way
example_en: He made a surreptitious entrance to the club through the little door in the brick wall.
example_zh: 他从砖墙的小门偷偷进入俱乐部。

english: not stopping or growing weaker
example_en: He watched her with unremitting attention.
example_zh: 他一直全神贯注地注视着她。

english: abnormal dread of being in closed or narrow spaces
example_en: He experienced feelings of claustrophobia from being in a small place.
example_zh: 他呆在一个狭小的地方，体验到了幽闭恐惧症的感觉。

english: very serious or formal in manner
more than is usual, necessary, or proper
example_en: Baking a whole cheese in pastry may seem extravagant.
example_zh: 烤点心时加一整块奶酪似乎太奢侈了。

english: not showing or having tact
example_en: His tactless words had always incurred his father’s deep displeasure.
example_zh: 他嘴笨，说话总是使他父亲感到十分不快。

english: to support, strengthen, or defend
example_en: You need more facts to buttress up your argument.
example_zh: 你需要有更多的事实来支持你的论据。

english: readily adaptable or responsive to new situations
to display conspicuously or abundantly
example_en: Nearby was a factory which exuded a pungent smell.
example_zh: 附近是一家散发出一种刺鼻气味的工厂

english: spend time only with other members of the group and seem unfriendly towards people who are not in the group
example_en: Wenzhou Christians tend to be cliquish and enjoy speaking their dialect among themselves.
example_zh: 在教会里温州基督徒总喜欢群聚讲自己的家乡话。

english: to declare or maintain with certainty
example_en: All entrants must warrant that their entry is entirely their own work.
example_zh: 所有参赛者必须保证其参赛作品完全是自己创作的。

english: familiar with something so that it seems normal or usual
example_en: The general is not accustomed to having his word questioned.
example_zh: 将军不习惯有人对他的命令提出质疑。

english: a state of temporary inactivity
example_en: The question is in abeyance until we know more about it.
example_zh: 问题暂时搁置，直到我们了解更多有关情况再行研究。

english: expressing suffering or sadness
example_en: They lay on the firm sands, listening to the plaintive cry of the seagulls.
example_zh: 他们躺在硬实的沙地上，听着海鸥的哀鸣。

english: to think about or discuss something very carefully in order to make a decision
example_en: She deliberated over the decision for a long time before she made up her min d.
example_zh: 她慎重考虑了好久才下定决心作出这一决定。

english: to move something or someone to another place nimbly and quickly
example_en: He whisked her across the dance floor.
example_zh: 他带着她飞快地穿过舞池。

english: marked by an impassive matter-of-fact manner, style, or expression
example_en: Some people don't catch his deadpan humor, that makes it even funnier.
example_zh: 有些人不能了解他那种无表情的幽默,因此更有趣。

english: to search out and publicly expose real or apparent misconduct of a prominent individual or business
example_en: The young reporter muckrakes at every opportunity.
example_zh: 这位年轻的记者不放过揭发丑闻的任何机会。

english: excite, stimulate
a stock of needed materials or supplies
example_en: The department is responsible for the provision of residential care services.
example_zh: 该部门负责提供家庭护理服务。

english: very clever or skillful
example_en: Jamie is a remarkably adroit and determined politician.
example_zh: 杰米是一位异常精明果断的政治家。

english: to assume or claim as true, existent, or necessary
example_en: They postulated a 500-year lifespan for a plastic container.
example_zh: 他们假定塑料容器的寿命为500年。

english: extremely poor or bad
example_en: The general standard of racing was abysmal.
example_zh: 竞赛总体水平极糟。

english: engrossing, fascinating
showing that something important is going to happen, especially something bad
example_en: The report contains numerous portentous references to a future environmental calamity.
example_zh: 报告里有很多地方预兆性地提到了将来的环境灾难。

english: refusing to do what other people want
example_en: Parts of the administration may be changing but others have been obdurate defenders of the status quo.
example_zh: 政府的一些部门可能正在作出改变，但是其他部门却执意维护现状。

english: concerned only with the obvious or apparent
example_en: This guy is a superficial yuppie with no intellect whatsoever.
example_zh: 这个家伙是个肤浅的雅皮士，没有什么头脑。

english: insufficient to pay all debts
example_en: The bank was declared insolvent.
example_zh: 银行被宣布破产。

english: to make great or greater
example_en: An enterprise shall not aggrandize itself at the expense of environment.
example_zh: 企业不应以环境为代价增强自身的实力

english: hopeful or romantic in a way that is not practical
example_en: He has always lived his life by a hopelessly quixotic code of honor.
example_zh: 他生活中一直遵循一种完全不切实际的堂吉诃德式的道德准则。

english: to take, receive, or obtain especially from a specific source
example_en: The cause of the difference may deriv e from different accounting standards used.
example_zh: 导致账目出现差异的原因可能是采用了不同的会计准则。

english: causing discussion, thought, argument, etc.
example_en: He has made a string of outspoken and sometimes provocative speeches in recent years.
example_zh: 他近些年发表了一连串直言不讳、有时带煽动性的演说。

english: a group of organisms that use the same ecological resource in a similar way
example_en: The current contract between the Directors Guild of America and production companies ends in June.
example_zh: 美国导演协会和制片公司当前的合同将于六月份截止。

english: dismal, gloomy
example_en: Many of them remained sullen and resentful.
example_zh: 他们中有许多人还是闷闷不乐，怀恨在心。

english: extremely important and necessary
example_en: Money is not essential to happiness.
example_zh: 金钱对于幸福并非必不可少。

english: a usually brief communication written for interoffice circulation
example_en: The delegation submitted a memorandum to the Commons on the blatant violations of basic human rights.
example_zh: 代表团向下院呈交了有关公然侵犯基本人权的备忘录。

english: an ardent supporter
example_en: Her mother was a dedicated apostle of healthy eating.
example_zh: 她母亲是健康饮食矢志不渝的倡导者。

english: to deprive of the benefit and protection of law
example_en: The German government has outlawed some fascist groups.
example_zh: 德国政府已经宣布一些法西斯团体为非法。

english: to give up the use or enjoyment of
example_en: No one was prepared to forgo their lunch hour to attend the meeting.
example_zh: 谁都不愿意放弃午餐时间出席会议。

english: being the same
one who takes part in dialogue or conversation
example_en: He was a more palatable interlocutor for the West than Mr Trump had been.
example_zh: 他相对于普京来说是一个更加合适和西方进行愉悦对话的总统。

english: produced, growing, living, or occurring naturally in a particular region or environment
example_en: Not all indigenous regimes were willing to accept the supposed benefits of British trade.
example_zh: 并非所有当地的政权都愿意接受与英国贸易的所谓好处。

english: to give off a sparkling or lustrous reflection of or as if of a moist or polished surface
example_en: Dewdrops glisten in the morning sun.
example_zh: 露珠在晨光下闪闪发光。

english: a person who criticizes or opposes beliefs and practices that are widely accepted
example_en: Cage was an iconoclast. He refused to be bound by western musical traditions of harmony and structure.
example_zh: 凯奇是个反传统的人。他拒绝接受西方有关和声和结构的音乐传统的束缚。

english: to tile to one side especially of a boat of ship
example_en: The ship listed again, and she was thrown back across the bunk.
example_zh: 船再次倾侧了，她又被甩回床铺的另一头。

english: a poem, discourse, or utterance of a character in a drama that has the form of a monologue or gives the illusion of being a series of unspoken reflections
example_en: Hamlet's soliloquy is probably the most famous in English drama.
example_zh: 哈姆雷特的独白在英国戏剧中大概是最出名的了。

english: done with great force and energy
example_en: He was a vigorous, handsome young man.
example_zh: 他是个精力充沛、年轻帅气的小伙子。

english: sully, soil
example_en: He has accused local people of trying to besmirch his reputation.
example_zh: 他指责当地人企图败坏他的名声。

english: marked by futility or ineffectualness
example_en: All our efforts were in vain.
example_zh: 我们的所有努力都付诸东流了。

english: violent and cruel in a way that hurts someone physically
example_en: He suffered a vicious attack by a gang of white youths
example_zh: 他遭到一帮白人青年的残暴袭击。

english: done or made quickly
example_en: Burke cast a cursory glance at the me nu, then flapped it shut.
example_zh: 伯克匆匆地瞥了一眼菜单，然后啪地合上了。

english: to greet with enthusiastic approval
example_en: US magazines hailed her as the greatest rock'n'roll singer in the world.
example_zh: 美国杂志把她奉为世界上最伟大的摇滚歌手。

english: arousing or deserving hatred or repugnance
example_en: Herr Schmidt is certainly the most odious man I have ever met.
example_zh: 赫尔·施密特无疑是我见过的最让人作呕的人。

english: marked by or showing reverence for deity and devotion to divine worship
example_en: Conti kneeled and crossed himself piously.
example_zh: 康蒂跪下来虔诚地用手在胸前画了个十字。

english: failing to take proper or normal care of something or someone
example_en: If the government is proved negligent, compensation will be payable.
example_zh: 如果证明是政府的疏忽，就应支付赔偿

english: the highest point of development or achievement
example_en: John Major has reached the pinnacle of British politics.
example_zh: 约翰·梅杰已攀上了英国政界的顶峰。

english: full of sadness or sorrow
example_en: He plays some passages so slowly that they become lugubrious.
example_zh: 有些段落他演奏得异常徐缓，听上去有些忧伤。

english: impressively direct and
to avoid doing something that you are supposed to do
causing horror or revulsion
example_en: She gave us a lurid description of the birth.
example_zh: 关于分娩，她向我们做了令人毛骨悚然的描述。

english: showing or done with great care and effort
example_en: They proved their theory by means of painstaking research.
example_zh: 他们证明的理论是经过苦心研究得来的

english: favoritism (as in appointment to a job) based on kinship
example_en: Cage changed his name to deflect accusations of nepotism.
example_zh: 凯奇改了名字以避免别人指责他搞裙带关系。

english: causing unrest, violence, or disturbance
example_en: The present international situation remains tense and turbulent.
example_zh: 当前的国际局势依然紧张动荡.

english: to yield or grant typically by treaty
example_en: Germany and Japan need to cede to the emerging economies industries in which they are no longer competitive.
example_zh: 德国和日本应该对新兴经济体让出他们不在占有优势的行业。

english: a hidden problem that makes something more complicated or difficult to do
example_en: After some technical hitches the show finally got under way.
example_zh: 一些小技术故障解决后，演出终于开始了。

english: done without any delay being purposely introduced
example_en: Death was instantaneous because both bullets hit the heart.
example_zh: 因为两颗子弹都击中了心脏，所以死亡是瞬间发生的。

english: inclined to ask questions
example_en: She is a inquisitive about everyone's affair.
example_zh: 她对每个人的事都好奇。

english: to interpret wrongly
example_en: An outsider might misconstrue the nature of the relationship.
example_zh: 外人可能会误解这种关系的本质。

english: to pretend or exaggerate incapacity or illness (as to avoid duty or work)
example_en: She was told by her doctor that she was malingering.
example_zh: 医生告诉她，她这是在装病。

english: to cover over completely
example_en: The army was overwhelmed by the rebels.
example_zh: 军队被叛乱者完全击败了。

english: obsequiously submissive
example_en: She is expected to be subservient to her uncle.
example_zh: 她被要求对叔叔恭敬顺从。

english: tending to excite or inflame
example_en: The latest scheme is much smaller but a lot more incendiary.
example_zh: 最新的定居点计划规模小很多 ，然而却具有更大的煽动性。

english: reserved, shy
very small or too small in amount
example_en: His influence on this matter is paltry .
example_zh: 他对这件事的影响是微不足道的。

english: dishonest or insincere behavior or speech that is meant to deceive someone
example_en: Emma saw his artifice, and returned to her first surmises.
example_zh: 爱玛看穿了他的伎俩后又回如最初的那样持怀疑态度。

english: designed or intended to teach people something
example_en: Most of the articles in the magazine ar e of a didactic nature.
example_zh: 杂志上大部分文章的本质都是说教性的

english: happening or done very often
example_en: She has become a regular visitor to Houghton Hall.
example_zh: 她已成为霍顿府邸的一名常客。

english: very small
example_en: She bought a diminutive toy for her da ughter.
example_zh: 她给女儿买了个小巧可爱的玩具。

english: something that shows what is coming
to grow well
example_en: Few businesses are flourishing in the present economic climate.
example_zh: 在目前的经济气候下，很少有企业兴旺发达。

english: arising unexpectedly
example_en: Bioengineering is an emergent branch of learning.
example_zh: 生物工程是一门新兴的学问。

english: not based on reason or evidence
example_en: It's difficult to say how likely such an arbitrary goal might be, but green leaders and others are optimistic.
example_zh: 很难去说这样一个武断的目标能有多靠谱，但环保领袖们和其他一些人却对此保持乐观。

english: not intended or planned
example_en: He became an unwitting accomplice in the crime.
example_zh: 他糊里糊涂地成了犯罪的帮凶。

english: a strong natural liking for something that is usually bad
example_en: His proclivity for alcohol was almost as well-known as his poetry.
example_zh: 他的酗酒倾向几乎和他的诗作一样有名

english: widely acclaimed and highly honored
made, done, or formed on or as if on the spur of the moment
example_en: The children put on an impromptu concert for the visitors.
example_zh: 孩子们为来访者即兴献上了一场音乐会

english: to take an oblique course
example_en: The ball skewed off at a right angle.
example_zh: 球呈直角偏离弹了出去。

english: to scold or condemn vehemently and at length
example_en: Marion berated Joe for the noise he made.
example_zh: 玛丽昂严厉斥责乔吵吵闹闹。

english: not affected by personal or emotional involvement
example_en: We, as prosecutors, try to be dispassi onate about the cases we bring.
example_zh: 作为检察官，我们对经手的案件会尽力做到不偏不倚。

english: to influence or gently urge by caressing or flattering
chinese: 他试图哄骗我说出秘方。
example_en: He tried to coax the secret from me.
example_zh: 他试图哄骗我说出秘方。

english: showing or demanding excessive delicacy or care
chinese: 挑剔的，极其注重细节的
example_en: He was fastidious about his appearance.
example_zh: 他非常讲究仪表。

english: clear and easy to read
example_en: This is an impeccably researched and very readable book.
example_zh: 这本书中的研究缜密透彻，可读性很强

english: to deny the existence or truth of
example_en: Alcohol negates the effects of the drug.
example_zh: 酒使药失去了效力。

english: bitingly sarcastic
example_en: Sodium and sulphur are highly corrosive.
example_zh: 钠和硫磺腐蚀性很强。

english: not like talking about themselves or drawing attention to themselves
example_en: My teacher is a very quiet modest self- effacing person.
example_zh: 我的老师是一个很沉默谦虚不爱出风头的人。

english: full or loud in sound
example_en: The sonorous voice of the speaker echoed round the room.
example_zh: 那位演讲人洪亮的声音在室内回荡.

english: an outbreak of a disease that occurs over a wide geographic area and affects an exceptionally high proportion of the population
example_en: They feared a new cholera pandemic.
example_zh: 他们担心一种新的霍乱流行病。

english: removed or distant either physically or emotionally
example_en: He seemed aloof and detached.
example_zh: 他看起来冷淡且超然。

english: capable of devising ways and means
example_en: He was amazingly inventive and resourceful, and played a major role in my career.
example_zh: 他极具创造力，而且足智多谋，在我的职业生涯中起到了重要的作用。

english: caring only about making money
example_en: Mercenary men lust for wealth.
example_zh: 唯利是图的人贪求财富。

english: having the power to horrify
example_en: The film showed the most horrific murder scenes.
example_zh: 那部影片有极恐怖的谋杀场面。

english: causing, marked by, or expressing misery or grief
example_en: He used dolorous tone, chaotic style of painting showing extreme grief of our life.
example_zh: 他以忧伤的色调，纷乱的笔触，表达出人生的最大悲痛。

english: lacking power or strength
example_en: He blazed with impotent rage.
example_zh: 他勃然大怒，但于事无补。

english: one that is eccentric
example_en: His mother and father thought Jim was a bit of an oddball too.
example_zh: 吉姆的父母也认为他有些古怪。

english: good-natured easy friendliness
example_en: He was full of bonhomie.
example_zh: 他非常友善。

english: not named or identified
example_en: An anonymous caller told police what had happened.
example_zh: 有人打匿名电话向警方报告了所发生的事。

english: to sing especially with a high or shaky voice
having or showing sad thoughts and feelings about something that you want to have or do and especially about something that made you happy in the past
carelessly and foolishly spending money, time, etc.

example_zh: 大手大脚的习惯很难改掉。

english: to get rid of
example_en: The crew jettisoned excess fuel and made an emergency landing.
example_zh: 机组人员丢弃了多余的燃料，紧急着陆

english: the use of few words to say something
example_en: Brevity is the soul of English.
example_zh: 简洁是英语的精华。

english: an expression of approval
example_en: His new book received accolade from the papers.
example_zh: 他的新书受到报纸的热烈赞扬.

english: using more words than are needed

example_zh: 他的文章很晦涩，而且往往篇幅冗长。

english: speak evil of
example_en: Either the managers have been maligned or they are not telling the truth.
example_zh: 要么是经理们受到了污蔑，要么就是他们在撒谎。

english: lacking dexterity or skill
example_en: Amy made an awkward gesture with her hands.
example_zh: 艾米笨拙地做了个手势。

english: able to change into many different forms or able to do many different things
example_en: He is a protean stylist who can move from blues to ballads and grand symphony.
example_zh: 他是一位多才多艺的艺术家，能从布鲁斯转换到民谣以及雄壮的交响乐。

english: to think carefully and deeply about something
example_en: As people grow older, they begin to ruminate on the uncertainty of life.
example_zh: 随着年龄的增长, 人们开始对生活的变化无常冥思苦想.

english: to lose freshness, strength, or vitality
example_en: All color had faded from the sky.
example_zh: 天上的颜色都退去了。

english: present in all places at all times
example_en: These days the media are omnipresent.
example_zh: 现在新闻媒体无处不在。

english: to give prominence to
chinese: 网站的其他部分将这个颜色用作强调色
example_en: These colors are used as accent colors in the rest of the website.
example_zh: 网站的其他部分将这个颜色用作强调色

english: having significant consequences
example_en: The report discusses a number of consequential matters that are yet to be decided.
example_zh: 这份报告讨论了许多有待决定的重大问题。

english: to take the place or position of
example_en: Hand tools are relics of the past that have now been superseded by the machine.
example_zh: 手工工具是历史的遗物，现在已经被机器所取代。

english: a businessperson of exceptional wealth, power, and influence
example_en: The tycoon is on the verge of bankruptcy.
example_zh: 那名大亨濒临破产的边缘。

english: disapproving
example_en: From frank's deprecatory remarks abo ut the money "people" owed him, she had imagined the sums to be small.
example_zh: 从弗兰克不愿意提起“人们”欠他钱的态度来看，她一直以为这笔钱为数不多。

english: any of the definable aspects that make up a
to exist or happen at an earlier time than

example_zh: 他的麻烦早在经济衰退前就出现了。
